swap.name: Swap
swap.text: Trade places with an adjacent hero.
swap.flavour: In the narrow ways, the company moves as one body.
swap.note: Two heroes trading ranks in a flooded nave, one ducking under the other's raised arm.

dread.name: Dread
dread.text: Unplayable. When drawn: lose 1 vigour and draw a replacement.
dread.flavour: It came back through the door with you.
dread.note: A hero frozen on a chapel threshold, one hand gripping the doorframe, unable to step through.

festering.name: Festering Wound
festering.text: Unplayable. When drawn: lose 2 HP and draw a replacement. Cured at the infirmary.
festering.flavour: "I've had worse in my bed than you. Most of them died."
festering.note: A bandaged forearm laid on Sister Wenna's table, the linen stained through and spreading.

aff_drowned.name: Drowning
aff_drowned.text: Unplayable. When drawn: gain 2 Soak, then draw a replacement.
aff_drowned.flavour: The water rises up the nave, pew by pew.
aff_drowned.note: A hero coughing brine into cupped hands, water to the knees in the drowned nave.

aff_mire.name: Fen Rot
aff_mire.text: Unplayable. When drawn: gain 2 Toxin, then draw a replacement.
aff_mire.flavour: The fen swells, and the stilts sink.
aff_mire.note: A hero peeling back a boot to find the skin beneath gone soft and bile green.

aff_baths.name: Fever
aff_baths.text: Unplayable. When drawn: lose 2 HP and gain 1 Burn, then draw a replacement.
aff_baths.flavour: The steam thickens, and the floors begin to scald.
aff_baths.note: A hero slumped against a tiled bath wall, skin flushed pink and blistering in the steam.

aff_pits.name: Black Lung
aff_pits.text: Unplayable. When drawn: gain 1 Toxin and 1 Burn, then draw a replacement.
aff_pits.flavour: Gas gathers in the drifts, and the lamps burn green.
aff_pits.note: A hero doubled over coughing yellow smoke in a mine gallery, a green lamp guttering above.

aff_foundry.name: Ringing
aff_foundry.text: Unplayable. When drawn: gain 2 Static, then draw a replacement.
aff_foundry.flavour: The storm sinks lower, and the anvils strike on their own.
aff_foundry.note: A hero with hands clamped over the ears, hair standing on end, beside a ringing anvil.

aff_coast.name: False Light
aff_coast.text: Unplayable. When drawn: discard a random card from this hand, then draw a replacement for this card.
aff_coast.flavour: More false lights burn on the rocks every hour.
aff_coast.note: A hero turning toward a lantern on the rocks while the company's real light falls behind.

aff_fleet.name: Frostbite
aff_fleet.text: Unplayable. When drawn: gain 2 Weaken, then draw a replacement.
aff_fleet.flavour: The ice closes in, hull by hull.
aff_fleet.note: A hero staring at fingertips gone white and grey, breath freezing on a ship's rail.

aff_rime.name: The Split
aff_rime.text: Unplayable. When drawn: become Vulnerable this round if you have no Armor; otherwise lose 1 Armor for the rest of the fight. Then draw a replacement.
aff_rime.flavour: The cracks widen, and seams of fire run uphill.
aff_rime.note: A hero's breastplate cracking down the middle, one half rimed, the other glowing at the seam.

aff_barrow.name: Barrow Sickness
aff_barrow.text: Unplayable. When drawn: gain 1 Toxin; this hero cannot be healed this round. Then draw a replacement.
aff_barrow.flavour: The barrow doors unseal, one by one.
aff_barrow.note: A hero pulling up a sleeve to find a grey-green plague sore spreading in the cold.

aff_hive.name: Venom Tremor
aff_hive.text: Unplayable. When drawn: this hero's next card keeps only its first effect. Then draw a replacement.
aff_hive.flavour: The hive wakes, and the spires hum louder.
aff_hive.note: A hero's sword hand shaking around a swollen sting, the weapon slipping from the fingers.

aff_spire.name: Stillness
aff_spire.text: Unplayable. When drawn: this hero acts last this round. Then draw a replacement.
aff_spire.flavour: The great clock's hand moves closer to twelve.
aff_spire.note: A hero caught mid-stride, rime creeping up one leg, while the company moves on around them.

aff_silence.name: The Hush
aff_silence.text: Unplayable. When drawn: gain 2 Erode, then draw a replacement.
aff_silence.flavour: The sound leaves: footsteps first, then voices, then heartbeats.
aff_silence.note: A hero shouting at a comrade across the snow with no sound coming out at all.

aff_pyre.name: Ash-Mark
aff_pyre.text: Unplayable. When drawn: lose 2 HP, ignoring Block and Armor, then draw a replacement.
aff_pyre.flavour: The black flame climbs the walls, and the candles stop giving light.
aff_pyre.note: A hero's palm branded with a black, lightless burn, smoke rising from it without a glow.

aff_garden.name: The Bloom
aff_garden.text: Unplayable. When drawn: gain 1 Toxin and 1 Erode, then draw a replacement.
aff_garden.flavour: The blooms open, and the eyes in the leaves turn toward you.
aff_garden.note: A hero brushing spores from a wrist where a small pale flower has taken root in the skin.

aff_sky.name: Seen
aff_sky.text: Unplayable. When drawn: become Vulnerable this round, then draw a replacement.
aff_sky.flavour: The tears in the sky widen, and something leans closer.
aff_sky.note: A hero looking up into a rent in the clouds, lit by a gaze too large to be seen whole.

step_through.name: Step Through
step_through.text: Advance 1. Gain 4 Block. Prime 2, or 4 if this is first in the Ordo.

up.text: Advance 1. Gain 5 Block. Prime 3, or 5 if this is first in the Ordo.

step_through.flavour: The order keeps the doors. The company goes through them.
step_through.note: A hero stepping across a broken doorway into the front rank, a comrade's blow coming in behind.

fall_back.name: Fall Back
fall_back.text: Retreat 1. Gain 4 Block, and 3 more if a foe means to hit you.

up.text: Retreat 1. Gain 5 Block, and 4 more if a foe means to hit you.

fall_back.flavour: Give ground, keep breath. There are more doors after this one.
fall_back.note: A hero backing into the rear rank as a foe's blow falls short on the stones.

shoulder_aside.name: Shoulder Aside
shoulder_aside.text: Push the target back 1. Deal 2, and 3 more if it is Marked.

up.text: Push the target back 1. Deal 3, and 4 more if it is Marked.

shoulder_aside.flavour: The marked one goes down first. Everyone in the company knows it.
shoulder_aside.note: A hero driving a shoulder into a marked foe's chest, knocking it into the rank behind.

vinegar_cloth.name: Vinegar Cloth
vinegar_cloth.text: Shed 5 stress, plus 2 per ailment on you.

up.text: Shed 7 stress, plus 2 per ailment on you.

vinegar_cloth.flavour: Sister Wenna's remedy for the smell, and for most other things.
vinegar_cloth.note: A course-stained hero pressing a vinegar-soaked cloth to the face between blows.

off_key_hymn.name: Off-Key Hymn
off_key_hymn.text: A hero sheds 6 stress, plus 3 per card you have played this round.

up.text: A hero sheds 8 stress, plus 4 per card you have played this round.

off_key_hymn.flavour: Mother Hild hums it over the anvil, badly. It helps anyway.
off_key_hymn.note: Two heroes back to back mid-fight, one humming under the breath, the other's shoulders easing.

bandage_roll.name: Bandage Roll
bandage_roll.text: A hero heals 6. If no vigour is left unspent this round, it also gains 3 stress.

up.text: A hero heals 7. If no vigour is left unspent this round, it also gains 3 stress.

bandage_roll.note: A hero winding linen round a comrade's forearm, the roll unspooling into the mud.

candle_bundle.name: Candle Bundle
candle_bundle.text: Next round, draw 1 more, and 1 more if you have played 2 or more other cards this round.

up.text: Gain 3 Block. Next round, draw 1 more, and 1 more if you have played 2 or more other cards this round.

candle_bundle.flavour: "Twelve candles. I counted. I'll count again when you're back."
candle_bundle.note: A hero lighting a cellar candle from another, the rest tied in a bundle at the belt.

into_the_gap.name: Into the Gap
into_the_gap.text: Deal 3. If the action before this hit the same foe, deal 3 more and push it back 1.

up.text: Deal 4. If the action before this hit the same foe, deal 4 more and push it back 1.

into_the_gap.flavour: Hired hands, not chosen ones. They fight like it.
into_the_gap.note: A hero stepping into the gap a comrade's blow just opened, driving the foe back a rank.

rope_and_hook.name: Rope and Hook
rope_and_hook.text: Deal 5 if the target was moved this round. Pull it forward 2.

up.text: Deal 7 if the target was moved this round. Pull it forward 2.

rope_and_hook.flavour: What hides at the back comes to the front, one way or another.
rope_and_hook.note: A rope snaking over the front rank to hook a staggered back-rank foe and haul it forward.

change_of_watch.name: Change of Watch
change_of_watch.text: Trade places with an adjacent hero. Each of you gains 3 Block. If this is first in the Ordo, that hero gains 1 Thrift.

up.text: Trade places with an adjacent hero. Each of you gains 4 Block. If this is first in the Ordo, that hero gains 1 Thrift.

change_of_watch.flavour: Someone always keeps the door. Tonight it is your turn.
change_of_watch.note: Two heroes passing in the line, shields overlapping as they trade ranks.

the_vigil.name: The Vigil
the_vigil.text: Spend all your Block. Every hero sheds 1 stress per Block spent.

up.text: Spend all your Block. Every hero sheds 2 stress, plus 1 per Block spent.

the_vigil.flavour: Somewhere behind you, the Abbot still kneels at the sealed door, listening.
the_vigil.note: A hero lowering a shield for one breath while the company bows heads round a single candle.

round_the_brazier.name: Round the Brazier
round_the_brazier.text: Every hero sheds 4 stress. Every hero at Death's Door heals 4.

up.text: Every hero sheds 5 stress. Every hero at Death's Door heals 5.

round_the_brazier.flavour: In the garth, one iron brazier burns by the broken cross. Remember it.
round_the_brazier.note: The company crouched round a guttering brazier, a fallen hero dragged close to the coals.

cellar_bread.name: Cellar Bread
cellar_bread.text: Shed 4 stress. Bank 1, or 2 if you stand in rank 3 or 4.

up.text: Shed 4 stress. Bank 1, or 2 if you stand in rank 2, 3 or 4.

cellar_bread.note: A back-rank hero tearing dark bread from the cellar stores and passing it forward.

codex_page.name: Codex Page
codex_page.text: Next round, draw 1 more, and 1 more if the target bears 2 or more courses.

up.text: Next round, draw 1 more, and 1 more if the target bears any course.

codex_page.flavour: "I have written you down. Try to stay legible."
codex_page.note: A hero reading a torn Codex page mid-fight, the course-stained foe ahead inked on it.

wennas_herbs.name: Wenna's Herbs
wennas_herbs.text: A hero heals 1 per ailment they carry (up to 5; Toxin cuts it as usual), then is cleansed of 3 ailments.

up.text: A hero heals 1, plus 1 per ailment they carry (up to 6; Toxin cuts it as usual), then is cleansed of 4 ailments.

wennas_herbs.flavour: Herbs from the Infirmarium, bound in twine and smelling of vinegar.
wennas_herbs.note: A hero pressing a crushed herb bundle to a comrade's course-stained wound.

touch_the_relic.name: Touch the Relic
touch_the_relic.text: A hero gains 2 Ward, then 2 Block per Ward they have (up to 8).

up.text: A hero gains 3 Ward, then 2 Block per Ward they have (up to 10).

touch_the_relic.flavour: "This one is still cold. It has not forgiven you."
touch_the_relic.note: A hero's bare fingertips on a small cold reliquary, frost spreading into a raised shield.

into_the_doorway.name: Into the Doorway
into_the_doorway.text: Trade places with an adjacent hero and Guard them this round. Gain 2 Block, and 3 more if a foe means to hit them.

up.text: Trade places with an adjacent hero and Guard them this round. Gain 3 Block, and 4 more if a foe means to hit them.

into_the_doorway.flavour: Every door needs someone standing in it.
into_the_doorway.note: A hero stepping in front of a threatened comrade to fill a doorway, shield raised.

chalk_the_names.name: Chalk the Names
chalk_the_names.text: Every hero sheds 6 stress, and 6 more if any hero is at Death's Door.

up.text: Every hero sheds 8 stress, and 8 more if any hero is at Death's Door.

chalk_the_names.flavour: The names of the dead are chalked on the cross. Not yours. Not today.
chalk_the_names.note: A hero chalking a name onto a stone step while a comrade lies at Death's Door beside them.

fenns_alms.name: Fenn's Alms
fenns_alms.text: Gain 4 stress. Bank 2. Next round, +1 vigour. Exhaust.

up.text: Bank 2. Next round, +1 vigour. Exhaust.

fenns_alms.flavour: "Alms are free, friend. The handling is extra."
fenns_alms.note: A fat purse pressed into a hero's gauntlet, a red entry blotting in a ledger behind.

red_strip.name: The Red Strip
red_strip.text: A hero gains 1 Grit. If they are at Death's Door, they also heal 6.

up.text: A hero gains 1 Grit. If they are at Death's Door, they also heal 8.

red_strip.flavour: A strip of red rubric cloth, tied where it shows: the company's only uniform.
red_strip.note: A hero knotting a red rubric strip round the arm of a comrade at Death's Door.

fl_firepot.name: Fire Pot

up.text: Deal 4. Apply 3 Fire. Exhaust.

fl_firepot.flavour: Pitch in a clay pot, a lit rag for a cork.
fl_firepot.note: A hero takes a smoking clay pot from the belt and lobs it at a drowned thrall on the stair.

fl_brinejar.name: Brine Jar
fl_brinejar.text: Apply 3 Water to the target and 1 to the foes beside it. Exhaust.

up.text: Apply 4 Water to the target and 2 to the foes beside it. Exhaust.

fl_brinejar.flavour: Sea salt boiled down in the abbey kitchen. It clings.
fl_brinejar.note: A waxed jar bursts on a crab's shell in the brine grotto, spraying its neighbours.

fl_draught.name: Small Beer
fl_draught.text: A hero heals 3 and sheds 3 stress. Exhaust.

up.text: A hero heals 4 and sheds 5 stress. Exhaust.

fl_draught.flavour: Small beer, honey and willow bark. It does what it can.
fl_draught.note: The Duelist uncorks a plain brown bottle from the belt and drinks without looking away from the foe.

fl_fire.name: Fire Flask

up.text: Deal 2. Apply 5 Fire. Exhaust.

fl_fire.flavour: Amber glass, warm to the touch even when the fire is out.
fl_fire.note: An amber flask shatters on a barnacle knight's helm and runs burning down the plate.

fl_brine.name: Brine Flask

up.text: Apply 6 Water. Exhaust.

fl_brine.flavour: Drawn from the Drowned Kingdom's own tide. It remembers.
fl_brine.note: A green bottle of seawater breaks over an eelkin in the nave and soaks it through.

fl_heal.name: Wineskin

up.text: A hero heals 6. Exhaust.

fl_heal.flavour: Sister Wenna's recipe. She will not say what is in it.
fl_heal.note: The Bulwark lifts his helm an inch and drinks a red draught from the belt.

fl_salts.name: Smelling Salts

up.text: A hero sheds 14 stress. Exhaust.

fl_salts.flavour: Hartshorn and vinegar. Nobody faints twice.
fl_salts.note: The Alchemist holds a small open vial under the Oracle's nose in the dark ossuary.

fl_acid.name: Acid Flask

up.text: Apply 5 Toxin. The target loses 1 Armor. Exhaust.

fl_acid.flavour: Green vitriol. Keep the cork waxed and the flask upright.
fl_acid.note: A green flask smokes as it eats into an anchor brute's chain mail.

fl_blast.name: Blasting Powder
fl_blast.text: Deal 3 to each foe in ranks 1 and 2. Exhaust.

up.text: Deal 4 to each foe in ranks 1 and 2. Exhaust.

fl_blast.flavour: Saltpetre, charcoal and sulphur, packed tight. Throw it far.
fl_blast.note: A powder flask bursts between two hooklines at the front, throwing them apart.

fl_frost.name: Frost Phial

up.text: Apply 6 Frost. Exhaust.

fl_frost.flavour: Packed in snow from the Icebound Fleet. Frost blooms on the glass.
fl_frost.note: A pale blue phial cracks on a siren and rime spreads across her scales.

fl_iron.name: Ironbark Tincture

up.text: A hero gains 8 Block. Exhaust.

fl_iron.flavour: Oak bark steeped in iron water. It tastes like a door.
fl_iron.note: The Bulwark drinks a dark tincture and sets his feet behind the church door.

fl_rage.name: Mead

up.text: A hero gains Empower 4. Exhaust.

fl_rage.flavour: Red wine, black pepper and something from a bull. It burns going down.
fl_rage.note: The Duelist throws back a red draught and grins, sword already lifting.

fl_steam.name: Steam Flask

up.text: Apply 3 Water and 2 Fire. Exhaust.

fl_steam.flavour: Two chambers and a wax wall between them. Do not shake it.
fl_steam.note: A double flask breaks on a bloated foe, soaking it in hot brine and burning oil at once.

fl_haste.name: Quicksilver

up.text: A hero gains 4 Momentum. Exhaust.

fl_haste.flavour: Strong coffee from the south and a pinch of something worse.
fl_haste.note: The Bladedancer bites the cork out of a small flask mid-step.

fl_focus.name: Eyebright
fl_focus.text: A hero gains 4 Focus, plus 1 for each vigour left unspent, up to 6. Exhaust.

up.text: A hero gains 6 Focus, plus 1 for each vigour left unspent, up to 8. Exhaust.

fl_focus.flavour: Rosemary and cold water. The scholars drink it by the jug.
fl_focus.note: The Elementalist sips a clear flask, stained fingers steady on the glass.

fl_simple.name: Garden Simple
fl_simple.text: A hero heals 2, gains 2 Block and sheds 2 stress. Exhaust.

up.text: A hero heals 3, gains 3 Block and sheds 3 stress. Exhaust.

fl_simple.flavour: One herb, one use. Simples are what the garden gives.
fl_simple.note: A small green bottle tied with a sprig of sage hangs from the Apothecary's belt.

al_brew.name: Brew

up.text: Brew a Fire Pot. Gain 2 Block.

al_brew.flavour: The still-coil on the back is never quite cold.
al_brew.note: The Alchemist kneels at rank 4 and decants a bubbling coil into a fresh bottle.

al_transmute.name: Transmute
al_transmute.text: Deal 3. Turn all Fire on the target into Frost.

up.text: Deal 5. Turn all Fire on the target into Frost.

al_transmute.flavour: Quench the burning thing and it hardens. Iron knows this. So do foes.
al_transmute.note: The Transmuter swings a crucible on its chain and the fire on a thrall goes white with frost.

al_lance_the_boil.name: Lance the Boil
al_lance_the_boil.text: Deal 2. Copy 1 of the target's Toxin onto each foe beside it.

up.text: Deal 3. Copy up to 2 of the target's Toxin onto each foe beside it.

al_lance_the_boil.flavour: What is let out must go somewhere.
al_lance_the_boil.note: The Plaguewright jabs the pointer cane into a swollen foe; green mist leaks to its neighbours.

al_refill.name: Refill

up.text: Refill 1 flask. Gain 3 Block.

al_refill.flavour: Rinse, steep, cork, wax. The hands know it in the dark.
al_refill.note: The Apothecary refills an empty bottle from a herb-stuffed jar at the back of the line.

al_hurled_pitch.name: Hurled Pitch

up.text: Deal 5. Apply 2 Fire.

al_hurled_pitch.flavour: Pitch, a rag and a steady arm. The rest is aim.
al_hurled_pitch.note: An overarm throw from rank 3: a burning pot arcs over the Bulwark's door at a thrall.

al_brine_splash.name: Brine Splash
al_brine_splash.text: Deal 2. Apply 2 Water to the target and 1 to the foes beside it.

up.text: Deal 3. Apply 3 Water to the target and 1 to the foes beside it.

al_brine_splash.flavour: Wet things burn badly and boil well.
al_brine_splash.note: A jar of brine bursts against a crab and showers the two foes beside it.

al_quicklime.name: Quicklime
al_quicklime.text: Deal 2. Apply 1 Volatile Fire, or 2 on a Handoff.

up.text: Deal 3. Apply 2 Volatile Fire, or 3 on a Handoff.

al_quicklime.flavour: Burnt lime flares when it meets water. Soak them first.
al_quicklime.note: A paper twist of white lime bursts into flame on a soaked pearl diver.

al_clean_linen.name: Clean Linen
al_clean_linen.text: A hero heals 4 and sheds 2 stress.

up.text: A hero heals 5 and sheds 4 stress.

al_clean_linen.flavour: Boiled twice, rolled tight. Most of medicine is clean cloth.
al_clean_linen.note: The Alchemist binds the Duelist's forearm with a fresh linen roll between blows.

al_decant.name: Decant

up.text: Brew a Brine Jar. Gain 3 Block.

al_decant.flavour: Pour slow. The sediment stays in the bottom.
al_decant.note: The Alchemist pours brine from a stoneware jug into a waxed jar on the bandolier.

al_greek_fire.name: Greek Fire
al_greek_fire.text: Deal 3. If the target has Water, deal 3 more. Apply 1 Fire.

up.text: Deal 4. If the target has Water, deal 4 more. Apply 1 Fire.

al_greek_fire.flavour: It burns on water. The old recipe says so, and the old recipe is right.
al_greek_fire.note: Fire runs across the soaked flank of an eelkin in the brine grotto.

al_salt_spray.name: Salt Spray
al_salt_spray.text: Apply 3 Water to the target and 2 to the foe behind it.

up.text: Apply 4 Water to the target and 3 to the foe behind it.

al_salt_spray.flavour: Throw it high and the second rank gets the worst of it.
al_salt_spray.note: A long arc of brine soaks a hookline and the bellringer standing behind him.

al_lye_splash.name: Lye
al_lye_splash.text: The target loses 1 Armor. Apply 1 Water.

up.text: The target loses 2 Armor. Apply 2 Water.

al_lye_splash.flavour: Wood ash and water. It eats rust, leather and the skin beneath.
al_lye_splash.note: Caustic grey water hisses on a barnacle knight's plate and the barnacles let go.

al_base_to_gold.name: Crucible
al_base_to_gold.text: Deal 4. Turn all Water on the target into Lightning.

up.text: Deal 6. Turn all Water on the target into Lightning.

al_base_to_gold.flavour: Lead to gold, they promised the abbot. This is the gold you get.
al_base_to_gold.note: Water on a drowned thrall crackles yellow as the Alchemist's alembic flashes.

al_reagent.name: Dropper

up.text: Conjoin 3.

al_reagent.flavour: One drop of the right thing and the whole flask goes.
al_reagent.note: A single drop from a pipette falls on a foe layered in courses, and it erupts.

al_powder_pot.name: Powder Pot
al_powder_pot.text: Deal 3 and apply 1 Fire to each foe in ranks 1 and 2.

up.text: Deal 4 and apply 2 Fire to each foe in ranks 1 and 2.

al_powder_pot.flavour: Aim for the front line. The front line is always there.
al_powder_pot.note: A fat clay pot lands between the two front foes on the nave stair and bursts in flame.

al_plague_flask.name: Plague Flask
al_plague_flask.text: Deal 2. Apply 3 Toxin, and 1 to the foes beside it.

up.text: Deal 2. Apply 4 Toxin, and 2 to the foes beside it.

al_plague_flask.flavour: Corked with wax, sealed with pitch, labelled with a skull for the careless.
al_plague_flask.note: A green flask bursts on a lamprey and a sick mist drifts over the foes on either side.

al_miasma_jar.name: Miasma Jar
al_miasma_jar.text: Deal 1 and apply 2 Toxin to each foe in ranks 1 and 2.

up.text: Deal 2 and apply 3 Toxin to each foe in ranks 1 and 2.

al_miasma_jar.flavour: Bad air sinks. Lob it at the front and let it settle.
al_miasma_jar.note: A jar of grey fog breaks at the feet of the two front foes in the ossuary.

al_sour_wick.name: Sour Wick
al_sour_wick.text: Deal 1. Apply 3 Volatile Fire if the target has Toxin, or 1 if it has none.

up.text: Deal 2. Apply 4 Volatile Fire if the target has Toxin, or 1 if it has none.

al_sour_wick.flavour: Marsh gas in a bottle and a wick soaked in it. Stand back.
al_sour_wick.note: A wick-stoppered bottle spits green flame against a bloated foe and it goes up.

al_black_bile.name: Black Bile
al_black_bile.text: Deal 1, plus 2 per Toxin on the target, up to 21.

up.text: Deal 3, plus 2 per Toxin on the target, up to 23.

al_black_bile.flavour: The melancholy humour. Too much of it and the body turns on itself.
al_black_bile.note: The beaked Plaguewright points the cane; a sick foe doubles over, black at the mouth.

al_fume_hood.name: Fume Hood
al_fume_hood.text: Gain 3 Ward, and 4 Block if you are in rank 3 or 4.

up.text: Gain 4 Ward, and 5 Block if you are in rank 3 or 4.

al_fume_hood.flavour: Cloth over the mouth, vinegar in the cloth, distance from the pot.
al_fume_hood.note: The Alchemist ties the cloth over the mouth at the back of the line as green fog rolls in.

al_fen_water.name: Fen Water

up.text: Apply 2 Volatile Water, then 4 Toxin.

al_fen_water.flavour: Rotmire water, bottled warm. The ground it lands on remembers.
al_fen_water.note: Brown fen water splashes around a foe's feet and the flagstones of the nave go green.

al_infect_the_wound.name: Foul Basin
al_infect_the_wound.text: Apply 1 Toxin, plus 1 per Bleed on the target.

up.text: Apply 2 Toxin, plus 1 per Bleed on the target.

al_infect_the_wound.flavour: An open cut is a door. Plague doctors know every door.
al_infect_the_wound.note: The Plaguewright flicks green dust into the gash the Bloodletter just opened.

al_field_dressing.name: Field Dressing
al_field_dressing.text: A hero heals 4. Dosed: they heal 2 more.

up.text: A hero heals 5. Dosed: they heal 3 more.

al_field_dressing.flavour: Pad, bind, tie. Then the draught, while they are still listening.
al_field_dressing.note: The Apothecary kneels by the Bulwark, packing a wound under the gambeson.

al_tincture.name: Tincture
al_tincture.text: A hero gains 2 Block and sheds 3 stress. Dosed: they gain 1 Thrift.

up.text: A hero gains 3 Block and sheds 4 stress. Dosed: they gain 1 Thrift.

al_tincture.flavour: Three drops under the tongue. Not four.
al_tincture.note: The Alchemist counts drops from a brown dropper onto the Oracle's tongue.

al_steady_hand.name: Steady Hand
al_steady_hand.text: Costs 1 less if you have already acted this round. Improve 1 flask on the belt.

up.text: Retain. Costs 1 less if you have already acted this round. Improve 1 flask on the belt.

al_steady_hand.flavour: Hired for a steady hand. Paid for it, too.
al_steady_hand.note: Spectacles down, the Alchemist adds one careful drop to a flask held up to the light.

al_bandolier.name: Bandolier
al_bandolier.text: Costs 1 less if 3 or more cards are already in the Ordo. Brew a Fire Pot and a Small Beer.

up.text: Costs 1 less if 3 or more cards are already in the Ordo. Brew a Fire Pot and a Small Beer. Gain 3 Block.

al_bandolier.flavour: Every loop filled before the door opens. Every loop.
al_bandolier.note: The Alchemist slots two fresh bottles into the bandolier, corks still warm.

al_poultice.name: Poultice
al_poultice.text: A hero gains Regen 1, plus 1 per ailment on them. Remove 1 ailment from them.

up.text: A hero gains Regen 2, plus 1 per ailment on them. Remove 2 ailments from them.

al_poultice.flavour: Bread, milk and comfrey, hot as they can bear. It draws the bad out.
al_poultice.note: The Apothecary presses a steaming cloth onto the Hexweaver's blackened arm.

al_hartshorn.name: Hartshorn
al_hartshorn.text: A hero sheds 3 stress. Brew Smelling Salts.

up.text: A hero sheds 6 stress. Brew Smelling Salts.

al_hartshorn.flavour: Shavings of stag's horn, distilled. The sharpest thing in the bag.
al_hartshorn.note: The Alchemist grinds horn in a brass mortar while the company holds the stair.

al_quench.name: Quench
al_quench.text: Remove all Fire and Frost from a hero. They heal 1, plus 1 per stack removed.

up.text: Remove all Fire and Frost from a hero. They heal 3, plus 1 per stack removed.

al_quench.flavour: Cold for the burn, warm for the frost. Old advice. Still good.
al_quench.note: The Alchemist pours cool water over the Elementalist's scorched, rimed hands.

al_chaser.name: Chaser

up.text: Deal 6. Dosed: deal 4 more.

al_chaser.flavour: One for the hero, one for the foe. Both thrown hard.
al_chaser.note: Right after the Duelist drinks, the Alchemist hurls the empty bottle at the same foe.

al_waxed_apron.name: Waxed Apron
al_waxed_apron.text: Gain 5 Block, and 3 more if a foe means to strike you.

up.text: Gain 6 Block, and 5 more if a foe means to strike you.

al_waxed_apron.flavour: Waxed leather to the shin. Acid runs off it. So do most things.
al_waxed_apron.note: The Alchemist turns a shoulder and a claw skids off the long waxed apron.

al_overarm_throw.name: Overarm Throw
al_overarm_throw.text: Deal 4. If the target was moved this round, deal 4 more.

up.text: Deal 5. If the target was moved this round, deal 5 more.

al_overarm_throw.flavour: A foe dragged into the open is a foe in range.
al_overarm_throw.note: The Executioner hauls a foe forward and the Alchemist's bottle meets it on arrival.

al_cauterize.name: Cauterize
al_cauterize.text: A hero heals 5 and gains 1 Fire.

up.text: A hero heals 7 and gains 1 Fire.

al_cauterize.flavour: A hot iron closes what a bandage cannot. It leaves its own mark.
al_cauterize.note: The Apothecary presses a glowing spatula to the Duelist's cut; smoke rises from the sleeve.

al_rectify.name: Retort
al_rectify.text: Improve 1 flask on the belt. Apply 2 Fire and 1 Water.

up.text: Improve 1 flask on the belt. Apply 3 Fire and 2 Water.

al_rectify.flavour: Distil it again. And again. Purity is patience.
al_rectify.note: The Transmuter runs a flask back through the alembic while flicking the dregs at a foe.

al_putrefaction.name: Toadstool
al_putrefaction.text: Deal 2. Turn all Water on the target into Toxin. Apply 2 Fire.

up.text: Deal 3. Turn all Water on the target into Toxin. Apply 3 Fire.

al_putrefaction.flavour: Every great work begins in rot. The books agree on that much.
al_putrefaction.note: The water soaking a foe turns green and sour as the Transmuter's crucible smokes.

al_fulminating_gold.name: Fulminating Gold
al_fulminating_gold.text: Deal 2. If a Conjunction has been set off this round, deal 3 more. Apply 2 Volatile Lightning.

up.text: Deal 3. If a Conjunction has been set off this round, deal 4 more. Apply 3 Volatile Lightning.

al_fulminating_gold.flavour: Gold that explodes. The Transmuter is very proud of it.
al_fulminating_gold.note: A pinch of yellow powder cracks like a bolt over a soaked choirboy; the spark leaps foe to foe.

al_aqua_fortis.name: Aqua Fortis
al_aqua_fortis.text: Strip the target's Block and Ward. Apply 2 Water, plus 1 per point stripped (8 at most).

up.text: Strip the target's Block and Ward. Apply 3 Water, plus 1 per point stripped (10 at most).

al_aqua_fortis.flavour: Strong water. It parts silver from gold and wards from the warded.
al_aqua_fortis.note: Fuming acid eats through the abbess's shimmering ward and runs down her robes.

al_boiling_flood.name: Boiling Flood
al_boiling_flood.text: If 3 or more vigour was spent before this card this round, deal 3 to every foe. Apply 1 Volatile Fire to each foe that has Water, then 2 Water to every foe.

up.text: If 3 or more vigour was spent before this card this round, deal 4 to every foe. Apply 1 Volatile Fire to each foe that has Water, then 3 Water to every foe.

al_boiling_flood.flavour: A cauldron's worth, tipped from the high step.
al_boiling_flood.note: The Alchemist tips a cauldron down the belfry stair and steam swallows the foes below.

al_alkahest.name: Alkahest
al_alkahest.text: Deal 1, plus 3 per course on the target (its Spectrum).

up.text: Deal 2, plus 4 per course on the target (its Spectrum).

al_alkahest.flavour: The universal solvent. Nothing holds it, so it is kept in nothing.
al_alkahest.note: A clear drop lands on a foe striped in six courses and each colour bites at once.

al_rat_bag.name: Rat Bag
al_rat_bag.text: Apply 2 Toxin. Rite: whenever a foe with Toxin dies, the foe in rank 1 gains its Toxin. Exhaust.

up.text: Apply 4 Toxin. Rite: whenever a foe with Toxin dies, the foe in rank 1 gains its Toxin. Exhaust.

al_rat_bag.flavour: The rats leave the dead first. Then they go next door.
al_rat_bag.note: A sack of plague rats splits open on a lamprey and the rats pour along the line.

al_fester.name: Blowfly
al_fester.text: Apply 1 Toxin, plus 1 for each vigour left unspent, up to 3. Then double the target's Toxin.

up.text: Apply 2 Toxin, plus 1 for each vigour left unspent, up to 4. Then double the target's Toxin.

al_fester.flavour: Leave it a day and see. Leave it two and stand back.
al_fester.note: The Plaguewright watches through glass eyes as a foe's sores swell and split.

al_foul_bellows.name: Foul Bellows
al_foul_bellows.text: Apply 3 Toxin, then copy the target's Toxin onto the foes beside it.

up.text: Apply 4 Toxin, then copy the target's Toxin onto the foes beside it.

al_foul_bellows.flavour: Pump the sick air sideways. Nobody in the line is spared.
al_foul_bellows.note: The Plaguewright works a leather bellows and green fog rolls out from one foe to the next.

al_flash_pan.name: Flash Pan
al_flash_pan.text: Apply 2 Volatile Fire, or 4 on a Handoff.

up.text: Apply 3 Volatile Fire, or 5 on a Handoff.

al_flash_pan.flavour: Sulphur on a brass pan. The flash is the point.
al_flash_pan.note: A brass pan of powder flares white against a foe already green with sickness.

al_leech_jar.name: Leeches
al_leech_jar.text: Deal 1. Apply 2 Toxin. Move every ailment from the hero with the most onto the target.

up.text: Deal 3. Apply 3 Toxin. Move every ailment from the hero with the most onto the target.

al_leech_jar.flavour: The leeches take the sickness. Then you throw the leeches.
al_leech_jar.note: The Plaguewright lifts a fat leech off the Oracle and flings the jar at a weeping nun.

al_wormwood.name: Wormwood
al_wormwood.text: Deal 2. Apply 2 Toxin, and 2 more if the target has Hex.

up.text: Deal 3. Apply 3 Toxin, and 3 more if the target has Hex.

al_wormwood.flavour: The bitterest herb in the bag. Cursed flesh drinks it gladly.
al_wormwood.note: A bitter grey draught spatters a hexed foe and the cunning-sign on it blackens.

al_restock.name: Hamper

up.text: Refill 1 flask. Bank 1. Gain 3 Block.

al_restock.flavour: The empty ones go back in the bag. Nothing is wasted that can be boiled.
al_restock.note: The Apothecary snatches an empty bottle from the floor and fills it at the coil.

al_alembic.name: Alembic
al_alembic.text: Brew an Ironbark Tincture. Gain 2 Block.

up.text: Brew an Ironbark Tincture. Gain 4 Block.

al_alembic.flavour: Copper, glass and patience. The front rank will need it by the third round.
al_alembic.note: An alembic drips dark tincture into a flask while the Bulwark holds the door ahead.

al_liquid_courage.name: Aqua Vitae
al_liquid_courage.text: A hero sheds 4 stress. Brew a Mead.

up.text: A hero sheds 7 stress. Brew a Mead.

al_liquid_courage.flavour: For the one who has to go first. Drink it on the way.
al_liquid_courage.note: The Alchemist presses a red bottle into the Duelist's free hand at the foot of the stair.

al_round_of_tonic.name: Wassail Bowl
al_round_of_tonic.text: Every hero gains 2 Block. Dosed: every hero sheds 3 stress.

up.text: Every hero gains 3 Block. Dosed: every hero sheds 4 stress.

al_round_of_tonic.flavour: One bottle passed down the line. Everyone takes a mouthful.
al_round_of_tonic.note: A single brown bottle goes hand to hand down the company in the dark nave.

al_tasting_spoon.name: Tasting Spoon
al_tasting_spoon.text: Draw 1 more card next round. Dosed: draw 1 more.

up.text: Draw 1 more card next round. Dosed: draw 1 more. Gain 3 Block.

al_tasting_spoon.flavour: Taste every batch. The one you skip is the one that kills.
al_tasting_spoon.note: The Alchemist touches a horn spoon to the lip of a used flask and frowns, thinking.

al_ironbark_rub.name: Ironbark Rub
al_ironbark_rub.text: A hero gains 4 Block, and 4 more if they have Taunt.

up.text: A hero gains 5 Block, and 6 more if they have Taunt.

al_ironbark_rub.flavour: Rubbed into the joints of the one who calls the blows.
al_ironbark_rub.note: The Apothecary works dark salve into the Bulwark's shoulder as he roars at the foes.

al_stink_pot.name: Stinkpot
al_stink_pot.text: Deal 2. Apply 2 Toxin. Push the target back 1.

up.text: Deal 3. Apply 3 Toxin. Push the target back 1.

al_stink_pot.flavour: Nothing stands in that smell. Not even the drowned.
al_stink_pot.note: A foe in rank 1 reels back from a cracked pot of yellow reek, gagging.

al_powder_charge.name: Powder Charge
al_powder_charge.text: Deal 4, plus 3 for each primed action this round.

up.text: Deal 6, plus 3 for each primed action this round.

al_powder_charge.flavour: The Oracle says when. The Alchemist only lights the fuse.
al_powder_charge.note: On the Fatebinder's word, the Alchemist throws a packed charge into the bellringer's tower.

al_superheat.name: Superheat
al_superheat.text: Double the Fire and Water on the target.

up.text: Deal 4. Double the Fire and Water on the target.

al_superheat.flavour: Water above its boiling, held there by the glass alone.
al_superheat.note: The Transmuter heats a sealed flask until it glows, then hurls it at a steaming foe.

al_athanor.name: Athanor
al_athanor.text: Bank 1. Rite: at the start of each round, apply 1 Fire and 1 Water to the foe in rank 1, plus 1 more of each for each vigour carried into this round, up to 3 of each. Exhaust.

up.text: Bank 1. Rite: at the start of each round, apply 1 Fire and 1 Water to each foe in ranks 1 and 2, plus 1 more of each for each vigour carried into this round, up to 3 of each. Exhaust.

al_athanor.flavour: The philosopher's furnace. Once lit it is never let go out.
al_athanor.note: The Transmuter sets a squat brass furnace on the flagstones; its mouth faces the front foe.

al_prima_materia.name: Cauldron
al_prima_materia.text: Conjoin 1, plus 1 per course on the target (its Spectrum).

up.text: Conjoin 2, plus 1 per course on the target (its Spectrum).

al_prima_materia.flavour: The first matter, from which all six courses came. A spoonful is plenty.
al_prima_materia.note: A spoon of grey paste hits a foe striped in courses and every colour on it flares at once.

al_catalytic_still.name: Catalytic Still
al_catalytic_still.text: Rite: the first time each round the company sets off a Conjunction, Brew a Steam Flask. Exhaust.

up.text: Rite: the first two times each round the company sets off a Conjunction, Brew a Steam Flask. Exhaust.

al_catalytic_still.flavour: Every reaction gives off heat. The still catches it.
al_catalytic_still.note: A coil on the Transmuter's back fogs and drips each time a foe across the nave bursts.

al_miasmatic_cloud.name: Miasmatic Cloud
al_miasmatic_cloud.text: Deal 1 and apply 3 Toxin to every foe, and 2 more Toxin to each foe that has Water. If another hero acted before this, apply 1 more Toxin to every foe.

up.text: Deal 2 and apply 4 Toxin to every foe, and 2 more Toxin to each foe that has Water. If another hero acted before this, apply 1 more Toxin to every foe.

al_miasmatic_cloud.flavour: Damp air carries plague best. Every physician knows it.
al_miasmatic_cloud.note: A cloud of green fog sinks over the brine grotto and clings to every wet foe.

al_black_rot.name: Plague Pit
al_black_rot.text: Double the Toxin on every foe. Exhaust.

up.text: Apply 1 Toxin to every foe, then double the Toxin on every foe. Exhaust.

al_black_rot.flavour: It was green yesterday. It is black today. Tomorrow there is no tomorrow.
al_black_rot.note: Every sick foe in the ossuary darkens at once as the Plaguewright taps the cane.

al_buboes_burst.name: Buboes Burst
al_buboes_burst.text: Every foe takes 1, plus 2 per Toxin on it, up to 21.

up.text: Every foe takes 1, plus 2 per Toxin on it, up to 21.

al_buboes_burst.flavour: The swellings ripen together and break together.
al_buboes_burst.note: Along the line every sick foe convulses as its swellings split.

al_draw_the_venom.name: Bezoar
al_draw_the_venom.text: Remove all Toxin from the target. It takes 1 and the most wounded hero heals 1 per stack removed.

up.text: Remove all Toxin from the target. It takes 2 and the most wounded hero heals 1 per stack removed.

al_draw_the_venom.flavour: Every venom is a cure in the right glass. Theriac begins with vipers.
al_draw_the_venom.note: The Plaguewright draws green smoke out of a foe into a flask and hands it to the wounded Duelist.

al_magnum_opus.name: Medicine Chest
al_magnum_opus.text: Brew Blasting Powder, a Wineskin and a Mead. Dosed: Improve 1 flask on the belt.

up.text: Brew Blasting Powder, a Wineskin and a Mead. Dosed: Improve 2 flasks on the belt.

al_magnum_opus.flavour: The whole bandolier in one sitting. The coil glows red.
al_magnum_opus.note: Three new flasks stand steaming in a row on the flagstones beside the kneeling Alchemist.

al_elixir_of_life.name: Gold Ampoule
al_elixir_of_life.text: A hero gains 1 Grit and heals 3. Dosed: they heal 3 more. Exhaust.

up.text: A hero gains 1 Grit and heals 5. Dosed: they heal 4 more. Exhaust.

al_elixir_of_life.note: A golden flask tipped to the lips of a hero at Death's Door on the throne room floor.

al_hippocras.name: Hippocras
al_hippocras.text: Rite: whenever a hero uses a flask, they gain 3 Block, and 2 Thorns if they have Taunt. Exhaust.

up.text: Rite: whenever a hero uses a flask, they gain 4 Block, and 3 Thorns if they have Taunt. Exhaust.

al_hippocras.flavour: Spiced wine through a sleeve of cloth. Courage for the ones in front.
al_hippocras.note: The company drinks from the belt and each bottle leaves a hero squarer behind the door.

al_panacea.name: Unicorn Horn
al_panacea.text: Remove 5 ailments from a hero. They heal 6 and shed 5 stress.

up.text: Remove 5 ailments from a hero. They heal 6 and shed 5 stress.

al_panacea.flavour: The cure for all things. It cures most of them.
al_panacea.note: The Apothecary kneels and tips a blue phial into a poisoned, burning hero's mouth.

al_red_work.name: Pelican
al_red_work.text: Apply 1 Fire, then Conjoin 2. If this is last in the Ordo, deal 2.

up.text: Apply 2 Fire, then Conjoin 3. If this is last in the Ordo, deal 3.

al_red_work.flavour: Rubedo, the last stage. The matter reddens and is done.
al_red_work.note: The Transmuter's crucible glows red on its chain as a foe flares from within.

al_white_work.name: Rosewater
al_white_work.text: Apply 2 Water to the target and 1 to the foes beside it, then Conjoin 1, or 2 if another hero acted before this.

up.text: Apply 3 Water to the target and 2 to the foes beside it, then Conjoin 2, or 3 if another hero acted before this.

al_white_work.flavour: Albedo. The washing. What is left afterwards is ready to change.
al_white_work.note: The Transmuter pours a silvery stream across the front of the line from the alembic.

al_black_work.name: Death's Head
al_black_work.text: Deal 4. Turn all Water on the target into Void. Handoff: apply 2 Void.

up.text: Deal 6. Turn all Water on the target into Void. Handoff: apply 2 Void.

al_black_work.flavour: Nigredo. First the matter must be blackened, then it can be made.
al_black_work.note: The water on a foe goes black as ink while the Transmuter's crucible smokes.

al_quintessence.name: Fifth Phial
al_quintessence.text: Brew a Eyebright. Improve 1 flask on the belt.

up.text: Brew a Eyebright. Improve 2 flasks on the belt.

al_quintessence.flavour: The fifth essence, drawn off the top. It sharpens whoever drinks it.
al_quintessence.note: The Transmuter lifts a thin clear flask from the alembic's beak and holds it to the light.

al_calcination.name: Calcination
al_calcination.text: Remove every course from the target. Deal 2, plus 1 per stack removed. If 3 or more vigour was spent before this card this round, deal 1 more per stack removed. Exhaust.

up.text: Remove every course from the target. Deal 3, plus 2 per stack removed. If 3 or more vigour was spent before this card this round, deal 1 more per stack removed. Exhaust.

al_calcination.flavour: Burn it to ash and the ash tells you what it was.
al_calcination.note: Every colour on a foe boils off at once into white ash as the crucible swings.

al_spagyric_rain.name: Spagyric Rain
al_spagyric_rain.text: Apply X Fire and X Water to every foe. If another hero acted before this, apply 1 more of each. X counts up to 5.

up.text: Apply X Fire and X Water to every foe, plus 1 of each. If another hero acted before this, apply 1 more of each. X counts up to 5.

al_spagyric_rain.flavour: Separate, then rejoin. Rain and ember fall together.
al_spagyric_rain.note: A rain of hot droplets and brine falls from the belfry ropes onto every foe below.

al_beak_mask.name: Beak Mask
al_beak_mask.text: Gain 3 Ward. Remove 1 ailment from every hero.

up.text: Gain 4 Ward. Remove 2 ailments from every hero.

al_beak_mask.flavour: Herbs in the beak, glass in the eyes. The plague never sees your face.
al_beak_mask.note: The Plaguewright pulls the beaked mask down; dried herbs crumble from the beak.

al_diagnosis.name: Diagnosis
al_diagnosis.text: Deal 3. Apply 2 Toxin. If the target has 5 or more Toxin, it is Vulnerable 1 round.

up.text: Deal 4. Apply 3 Toxin. If the target has 5 or more Toxin, it is Vulnerable 1 round.

al_diagnosis.flavour: The cane points. The company follows it.
al_diagnosis.note: The Plaguewright points the cane at the sickest foe and the company turns to it.

al_ripen.name: Pomegranate
al_ripen.text: Double the target's Toxin. If any vigour is left unspent, copy 1 of it onto each foe beside it.

up.text: Double the target's Toxin. If any vigour is left unspent, copy up to 2 of it onto each foe beside it.

al_ripen.flavour: Patience. A plague is a harvest.
al_ripen.note: A foe's sores bloom and its neighbours begin to cough.

al_kindle_the_rot.name: Brimstone
al_kindle_the_rot.text: Deal 1 per Toxin on the target, then apply 1 Volatile Fire, or 2 on a Handoff.

up.text: Deal 1 per Toxin on the target, then apply 2 Volatile Fire, or 3 on a Handoff.

al_kindle_the_rot.flavour: Rot burns. Ask anyone who has lived near a fen.
al_kindle_the_rot.note: The Plaguewright touches a lit taper to a foe's green breath and it ignites.

al_rat_swarm.name: Rat Swarm
al_rat_swarm.text: Apply 1 Toxin to every foe, then 3 more to the target, and 2 more if it was moved this round.

up.text: Apply 1 Toxin to every foe, then 4 more to the target, and 2 more if it was moved this round.

al_rat_swarm.flavour: One rat finds them all. The rest follow.
al_rat_swarm.note: Black rats boil out of the Plaguewright's coat and run the length of the enemy line.

al_marsh_lights.name: Marsh Lights
al_marsh_lights.text: Apply 2 Volatile Fire to every foe that has Toxin. If this is last in the Ordo, deal 1 to every foe. Exhaust.

up.text: Apply 3 Volatile Fire to every foe that has Toxin. If this is last in the Ordo, deal 2 to every foe. Exhaust.

al_marsh_lights.flavour: Marsh lights rise over the dead. Here they rise over the dying.
al_marsh_lights.note: Pale flames gutter up from every sick foe in the line at once.

al_herb_bag.name: Herb Pouch
al_herb_bag.text: A hero heals 3. Brew a Small Beer.

up.text: A hero heals 5. Brew a Small Beer.

al_herb_bag.flavour: Yarrow, sage, willow, comfrey. Picked at dawn, dried in the cellarium.
al_herb_bag.note: The Apothecary pulls a bundle of dried herbs from the belt and crushes it into a bottle.

al_triage.name: Triage
al_triage.text: The most wounded hero heals 8. Every hero heals 2.

up.text: The most wounded hero heals 8. Every hero heals 2.

al_triage.flavour: The worst first. Then everyone. Then the worst again.
al_triage.note: The Apothecary moves down the line, kneeling longest by the hero who is bleeding most.

al_snatch_from_the_door.name: Cordial
al_snatch_from_the_door.text: A hero heals 3. If they are at Death's Door, they heal 5 more.

up.text: A hero heals 4. If they are at Death's Door, they heal 8 more.

al_snatch_from_the_door.flavour: Not yet. Not on my watch, and not on this floor.
al_snatch_from_the_door.note: The Apothecary drags a fallen hero back from the edge of the throne room dais.

al_measured_dose.name: Dram
al_measured_dose.text: A hero gains 5 Block. Dosed: put a Fire Pot into their next hand.

up.text: A hero gains 7 Block. Dosed: put a Fire Pot into their next hand.

al_measured_dose.flavour: The right amount at the right time. That is the whole of the craft.
al_measured_dose.note: The Apothecary marks a line on a flask with a thumbnail and hands it forward.

al_war_tonics.name: Stirrup Cup
al_war_tonics.text: Brew a Mead and a Quicksilver. Improve 1 flask on the belt, or 2 on a Handoff.

up.text: Brew a Mead and a Quicksilver. Improve 1 flask on the belt, or 2 on a Handoff.

al_war_tonics.flavour: For the killers. Keep them fed and keep them standing.
al_war_tonics.note: A red flask and a black one go into the bandolier loops nearest the Duelist.

al_second_dose.name: Spoonful

up.text: Refill 1 flask. Dosed: refill 1 more. Gain 3 Block.

al_second_dose.flavour: If it worked once it will work again. Fill it.
al_second_dose.note: The Apothecary catches an empty bottle tossed back down the line and fills it.

al_the_great_work.name: Philosopher's Egg
al_the_great_work.text: Rite: the first two times each round the company sets off a Conjunction, Conjoin that foe 2 and Improve 1 flask on the belt. Exhaust.

up.text: Rite: the first two times each round the company sets off a Conjunction, Conjoin that foe 2, Improve 1 flask on the belt, then apply 1 Fire and 1 Water to that foe. Exhaust.

al_the_great_work.flavour: The stone is not a thing you find. It is a thing that keeps happening.
al_the_great_work.note: In the throne room the Transmuter's crucible blazes gold as one reaction births the next.

al_solve_et_coagula.name: Solve et Coagula
al_solve_et_coagula.text: Remove every course from every foe. Apply that many Fire to the target. Prime 1 for every 2 stacks removed. Exhaust.

up.text: Remove every course from every foe. Apply that many Fire to the target, then 1 Volatile Water. Prime 1 for every 2 stacks removed. Exhaust.

al_solve_et_coagula.flavour: Dissolve, then bind. Everything they carry, poured into one.
al_solve_et_coagula.note: Every colour streams off the line of foes into the Transmuter's crucible, then onto one.

al_black_death.name: Black Death
al_black_death.text: Rite: at the end of each round, every foe with Toxin gains 1 Toxin. Then, from rank 1 back, each foe with Toxin copies 1 onto each foe beside it, so one sick foe can pass it down the line. Exhaust.

up.text: Apply 2 Toxin to every foe. Rite: at the end of each round, every foe with Toxin gains 1 Toxin. Then, from rank 1 back, each foe with Toxin copies 1 onto each foe beside it, so one sick foe can pass it down the line. Exhaust.

al_black_death.flavour: It does not end. It only moves on.
al_black_death.note: The Plaguewright stands still among the dying as the black spreads foe to foe.

al_firedamp.name: Firedamp
al_firedamp.text: Rite: whenever a foe with Toxin dies, every foe takes 1 per Toxin it had. Exhaust.

up.text: Rite: whenever a foe with Toxin dies, every foe takes 1 per Toxin it had, then the foe in rank 1 gains its Toxin. Exhaust.

al_firedamp.flavour: Mine gas gathers in the dead. A spark finds it.
al_firedamp.note: A dying foe bursts in green flame and the blast rolls down the whole line.

al_the_physick_garden.name: Physick Garden
al_the_physick_garden.text: Rite: at the start of each round, Brew a Garden Simple and Improve 1 flask on the belt. Exhaust.

up.text: Rite: at the start of each round, Brew a Garden Simple, Improve 1 flask on the belt and every hero sheds 2 stress. Exhaust.

al_the_physick_garden.flavour: Every bed a cure. The garden grows faster than the company can bleed.
al_the_physick_garden.note: Pots of herbs sprout along the back rank as the Apothecary waters them between blows.

al_theriac.name: Theriac
al_theriac.text: Rite: whenever a hero uses a flask, Prime 3. Exhaust.

up.text: Rite: whenever a hero uses a flask, Prime 3 and they shed 2 stress. Exhaust.

al_theriac.flavour: Sixty-four ingredients and a viper. It cures everything, including hesitation.
al_theriac.note: Each hero drinks in turn and strikes harder, the Apothecary pouring for the next.

bw_k_bar_the_door.name: Bar the Door
bw_k_bar_the_door.text: Guard another hero this round. If a foe means to strike them, they shed 2 stress.

up.text: Guard another hero this round. If a foe means to strike them, they shed 3 stress and you gain 2 Block.

bw_k_bar_the_door.flavour: A door is for keeping things out. He keeps it shut.
bw_k_bar_the_door.note: The Bulwark steps across the nave and sets the church door in front of the Oracle.

bw_k_come_on_then.name: War Drum

up.text: Taunt. Shed 7 stress.

bw_k_come_on_then.flavour: He has been hit by worse. He says so, through the slit.
bw_k_come_on_then.note: The bandaged Bulwark bangs the mace on the cracked door, calling the drowned to him.

bw_k_bank_the_cold.name: Ice Over

up.text: Gain 3 Block. Fortify. Bank 1.

bw_k_bank_the_cold.flavour: In the north they let the snow drift high against the wall. It holds.
bw_k_bank_the_cold.note: Frost creeps across the pine door's windward planks as the Ironwarden settles behind it.

bw_k_scourge.name: Scourge
bw_k_scourge.text: Lose 1 HP. Gain 3 Thorns, plus 1 for each HP lost this way.

up.text: Lose 1 HP. Gain 5 Thorns, plus 1 for each HP lost this way.

bw_k_scourge.flavour: One stroke for the tower. One for the ones inside it.
bw_k_scourge.note: The Thornguard lashes his own shoulder with the flagellant's cord; the barbs on his arms stand up.

bw_brace.name: Brace

up.text: Gain 8 Block.

bw_brace.flavour: Feet wide, knees bent, weight into the door.
bw_brace.note: The Bulwark settles behind the church door on the drowned stair, mace resting on its rim.

bw_mace_blow.name: Mace Blow

up.text: Deal 8.

bw_mace_blow.flavour: Short step. Over the top edge. Again.
bw_mace_blow.note: The flanged mace comes over the door's top edge onto a Drowned Thrall's skull.

bw_interpose.name: Interpose
bw_interpose.text: Guard another hero this round. Gain 2 Block.

up.text: Guard another hero this round. Gain 4 Block.

bw_interpose.flavour: Get behind the door. All of you.
bw_interpose.note: The Bulwark shoulders in front of the Elementalist as a spear comes out of the dark.

bw_hold_the_line.name: Pillar

up.text: Taunt. Gain 6 Block.

bw_hold_the_line.flavour: He stood in the gate once. He is standing in it still.
bw_hold_the_line.note: The Bulwark plants the door in the nave aisle; every drowned head turns toward him.

bw_over_the_rim.name: Overhand
bw_over_the_rim.text: Deal 7, plus half your Block, up to 15.

up.text: Deal 10, plus half your Block, up to 18.

bw_over_the_rim.flavour: The door takes the blow. The mace gives it back.
bw_over_the_rim.note: Braced behind the door, the Bulwark brings the mace down over the rim in a full overhead blow.

bw_draw_their_eyes.name: Clamour
bw_draw_their_eyes.text: Taunt. Gain 4 stress. First in the Ordo: gain 2 Block.

up.text: Taunt. Gain 3 stress. First in the Ordo: gain 4 Block.

bw_draw_their_eyes.flavour: Look at me. Not at them.
bw_draw_their_eyes.note: The Bulwark raps the mace on the door's ring handle; the belfry's foes turn from the back rank.

bw_scar_tissue.name: Great Helm
bw_scar_tissue.text: Gain 3 Block, plus 1 for every 3 Scars.

up.text: Gain 4 Block, plus 1 for every 2 Scars.

bw_scar_tissue.flavour: Every scar on him is a place where something failed to finish the job.
bw_scar_tissue.note: Blood runs from under the Bulwark's helm as he sets his shoulder harder into the door.

bw_toll_of_the_tower.name: Alarum
bw_toll_of_the_tower.text: Echo. Deal 4, plus 1 for every 3 Scars. If this kills the target, shed 4 stress.

up.text: Echo. Deal 6, plus 1 for every 3 Scars. If this kills the target, shed 6 stress.

bw_toll_of_the_tower.flavour: The tower fell. He did not. Someone has to pay for that.
bw_toll_of_the_tower.note: A bloodied Bulwark swings the mace two-handed, the door hanging from his forearm, in the ossuary.

bw_blood_for_iron.name: Tempering
bw_blood_for_iron.text: Lose 2 HP. If you lost 2, gain 1 Armor for the fight. Gain 3 Block, plus 1 for each HP lost this way. Exhaust.

up.text: Lose 2 HP. If you lost 2, gain 1 Armor for the fight. Gain 6 Block, plus 1 for each HP lost this way. Exhaust.

bw_blood_for_iron.flavour: The garrison oath: my blood for the wall, the wall for the ones behind it.
bw_blood_for_iron.note: The Bulwark draws his palm across the breastplate's lead patch, leaving a red smear.

bw_still_standing.name: Still Standing
bw_still_standing.text: Retain. Gain 3 Block. At Death's Door, gain 7 more.

up.text: Retain. Gain 4 Block. At Death's Door, gain 10 more.

bw_still_standing.flavour: He should be dead. He has been told so, by better men than you.
bw_still_standing.note: On one knee behind the door, the Bulwark pushes himself back up on the mace haft.

bw_grit_your_teeth.name: Iron Gauntlet
bw_grit_your_teeth.text: Shed 6 stress. Gain 2 Block. Dosed: gain 4 more Block.

up.text: Shed 8 stress. Gain 3 Block. Dosed: gain 5 more Block.

bw_grit_your_teeth.flavour: Breathe. Count the hinges. Three. Still three.
bw_grit_your_teeth.note: Behind the door, the Bulwark lays his gauntlet on the iron hinges and breathes.

bw_rime_coat.name: Rime Coat
bw_rime_coat.text: Gain 5 Block. Apply 1 Frost to each foe that means to strike you.

up.text: Gain 6 Block. Apply 2 Frost to each foe that means to strike you.

bw_rime_coat.flavour: Strike the door and the cold goes up your arm.
bw_rime_coat.note: White rime races across the door's face as two foes raise their weapons at it.

bw_hold_through_the_night.name: Nightwatch
bw_hold_through_the_night.text: Gain 4 Block, plus 1 per vigour left unspent, up to 6. Fortify.

up.text: Gain 5 Block, plus 1 per vigour left unspent, up to 8. Fortify.

bw_hold_through_the_night.flavour: In the north the watch is all night, and the night is half the year.
bw_hold_through_the_night.note: The Ironwarden stands his door in the snow and does not move as the light goes.

bw_hoarfrost_blow.name: Rimed Mace
bw_hoarfrost_blow.text: Deal 5. Apply 1 Frost. If this follows an action on the same foe, apply 1 more.

up.text: Deal 6. Apply 2 Frost. If this follows an action on the same foe, apply 1 more.

bw_hoarfrost_blow.flavour: The mace hangs on the windward side. It comes off cold.
bw_hoarfrost_blow.note: A frost-furred mace head strikes a foe's shoulder and leaves a white star of rime.

bw_windward_shield.name: Windward Shield
bw_windward_shield.text: Another hero gains 5 Block. Apply 1 Frost to the front foe.

up.text: Another hero gains 7 Block. Apply 1 Frost to the front foe.

bw_windward_shield.flavour: Stand on my lee side. The wind is mine to take.
bw_windward_shield.note: The Ironwarden turns the pine door into the wind so the Duelist stands in its lee.

bw_cold_iron.name: Cold Iron
bw_cold_iron.text: Gain 4 Block, plus 1 for each Frost on all foes, up to 10.

up.text: Gain 6 Block, plus 1 for each Frost on all foes, up to 12.

bw_cold_iron.flavour: Iron in the cold does not bend. It waits.
bw_cold_iron.note: Frost climbs the door's iron straps while the foes beyond it slow and stiffen.

bw_break_the_ice.name: Brunt
bw_break_the_ice.text: Deal 2, plus half your Block, up to 10.

up.text: Deal 3, plus half your Block, up to 12. If a Conjunction has gone off this round, deal 3 more.

bw_break_the_ice.flavour: The door is the weight. The mace only tells it where to go.
bw_break_the_ice.note: The Ironwarden drives the rimed door's edge into a frozen foe and the ice cracks.

bw_barbed_plate.name: Spiked Buckler

up.text: Gain 4 Thorns and 4 Block.

bw_barbed_plate.flavour: He welded every barb himself. One for each name.
bw_barbed_plate.note: The Thornguard braces his barbed forearm across the door's face.

bw_hair_shirt.name: Hair Shirt
bw_hair_shirt.text: Lose 3 HP. Gain 4 Thorns, plus 1 for each HP lost this way.

up.text: Lose 3 HP. Gain 6 Thorns, plus 1 for each HP lost this way.

bw_hair_shirt.flavour: Penance is worn against the skin, where only he can feel it.
bw_hair_shirt.note: The Thornguard tugs the hair shirt tight at his neck; blood spots the collar.

bw_come_and_take_it.name: Bristle

up.text: Taunt. Gain 4 Thorns.

bw_come_and_take_it.flavour: Strike me. I want you to.
bw_come_and_take_it.note: The Thornguard spreads his barbed arms wide from behind the door, inviting the blow.

bw_spiked_boss.name: Spiked Boss
bw_spiked_boss.text: Deal 4. Gain 1 Thorns, plus 1 for each foe that means to strike you.

up.text: Deal 5. Gain 2 Thorns, plus 1 for each foe that means to strike you.

bw_spiked_boss.flavour: The ring handle is still on the door. Now there is a spike through it.
bw_spiked_boss.note: The Thornguard rams the spiked door into the front foe from rank 1.

bw_thorn_hedge.name: Thorn Hedge
bw_thorn_hedge.text: Another hero gains 2 Thorns, and their next hit deals 3 more.

up.text: Another hero gains 3 Thorns, and their next hit deals 4 more.

bw_thorn_hedge.flavour: He ties a barbed cord round the scholar's wrist. Just in case.
bw_thorn_hedge.note: The Thornguard knots a strip of barbed cord around the Hexweaver's arm.

bw_penitents_blow.name: Penance

up.text: Deal 5, plus your Thorns.

bw_penitents_blow.flavour: Every barb he wears, he puts into you.
bw_penitents_blow.note: The Thornguard swings his barbed forearm and mace together into a foe's ribs.

bw_keep_the_back_rank.name: Rearguard
bw_keep_the_back_rank.text: Guard another hero this round. If they stand in rank 3 or 4, put a Cut Palm into their next hand.

up.text: Guard another hero this round. If they stand in rank 3 or 4, they gain 3 Block and put a Cut Palm into their next hand.

bw_keep_the_back_rank.flavour: The ones at the back are the ones who know what we are fighting.
bw_keep_the_back_rank.note: The Bulwark backs up the stair to stand over the kneeling Oracle.

bw_hook_and_drag.name: Billhook
bw_hook_and_drag.text: Pull the target forward 1, then deal 4.

up.text: Pull the target forward 1, then deal 6.

bw_hook_and_drag.flavour: The flanges catch. Whatever they catch comes forward.
bw_hook_and_drag.note: The Bulwark hooks the mace's flanges into a caster's robe and hauls it out of the back rank.

bw_shield_rim.name: Shield Rim
bw_shield_rim.text: Deal 4. If the target means to strike you, gain 3 Block.

up.text: Deal 4. If the target means to strike you, gain 4 Block, plus 1 for each Hex on it, up to 9.

bw_shield_rim.flavour: Meet the blow with the edge, not the face. A cursed arm swings slow.
bw_shield_rim.note: The door's iron-bound edge cracks into a foe's raised arm mid-swing.

bw_ring_the_helm.name: Ring the Helm
bw_ring_the_helm.text: Deal 9. Stun the target if it is Marked or was moved this round. Exhaust.

up.text: Deal 12. Stun the target if it is Marked or was moved this round. Exhaust.

bw_ring_the_helm.flavour: Strike a helm hard enough and the head inside rings like a bell.
bw_ring_the_helm.note: The mace lands on a dragged foe's helm and the belfry bell answers it.

bw_hunker.name: Hunker
bw_hunker.text: Gain 3 Block. You cannot be moved this round. Bank 1.

up.text: Gain 5 Block. You cannot be moved this round. Bank 1.

bw_hunker.flavour: Sabatons in the mud. Let them try.
bw_hunker.note: The Bulwark drops his weight low, iron sabatons sunk in the stair's silt.

bw_into_the_breach.name: Muddy Boot
bw_into_the_breach.text: Swap with an adjacent hero. Gain 4 Block. Handoff: gain 3 more.

up.text: Swap with an adjacent hero. Gain 6 Block. Handoff: gain 4 more.

bw_into_the_breach.flavour: Something came through the breach once. He was not standing in it. Never again.
bw_into_the_breach.note: The Bulwark shoulders past the Duelist to put the door back in the front rank.

bw_unbroken.name: Unbroken
bw_unbroken.text: Gain 5 Block. At Death's Door, gain 1 Might.

up.text: Gain 7 Block. At Death's Door, gain 1 Might.

bw_unbroken.flavour: On his knees, he is still taller than the door.
bw_unbroken.note: At the foot of the throne, the Bulwark rises from a kneel with the door before him.

bw_bleed_for_them.name: Lifeblood
bw_bleed_for_them.text: Lose 4 HP. Another hero heals 2, plus 1 for each HP lost this way. If you lost 4, they gain 1 Thrift. Dosed: they heal 3 more.

up.text: Lose 4 HP. Another hero heals 4, plus 1 for each HP lost this way, and gains 3 Block. If you lost 4, they gain 1 Thrift. Dosed: they heal 3 more.

bw_bleed_for_them.flavour: He has more blood than the scholar. He has done the sums.
bw_bleed_for_them.note: The Bulwark presses his own bandage to the Duelist's wound and takes the cut meant for her.

bw_answer_the_blow.name: Reprisal
bw_answer_the_blow.text: Deal 3, plus 1 for each foe that means to strike you. At Death's Door, hit it again for 6.

up.text: Deal 4, plus 2 for each foe that means to strike you. At Death's Door, hit it again for 8.

bw_answer_the_blow.flavour: The last thing the tower's breakers saw was a dead man getting up.
bw_answer_the_blow.note: A bloodied Bulwark, down to his last breath, brings the mace up from the floor.

bw_shoulder_their_burden.name: Yoke
bw_shoulder_their_burden.text: Take up to 8 stress from every other hero onto yourself. Gain 1 Block, plus 1 for each other hero who acted before this.

up.text: Take up to 12 stress from every other hero onto yourself. Gain 2 Block, plus 2 for each other hero who acted before this.

bw_shoulder_their_burden.flavour: Give it here. He has carried a door this far.
bw_shoulder_their_burden.note: The Bulwark lays a gauntlet on the trembling Alchemist's shoulder at the nave's edge.

bw_tithe_of_blood.name: Tithe of Blood
bw_tithe_of_blood.text: Lose 2 HP. If you lost 2, next round +1 vigour. Shed 2 stress. Exhaust.

up.text: Lose 2 HP. If you lost 2, next round +1 vigour. Shed 4 stress. Exhaust.

bw_tithe_of_blood.flavour: The abbey pays in ostia. He pays in what he has.
bw_tithe_of_blood.note: The Bulwark tightens the bandage under his helm until it reddens through.

bw_winter_vigil.name: Winter Vigil
bw_winter_vigil.text: Costs 1 less if 2 or more heroes are already in the Ordo. Every hero gains 3 Block, and you gain 2 more. Apply 1 Frost to every foe.

up.text: Costs 1 less if 2 or more heroes are already in the Ordo. Every hero gains 4 Block, and you gain 2 more. Apply 2 Frost to every foe.

bw_winter_vigil.flavour: The chapel bell rang through the long night. None of them slept. All of them lived.
bw_winter_vigil.note: The company huddles in the lee of the pine door as frost sweeps over the foes.

bw_shed_the_rime.name: Icicle Fringe
bw_shed_the_rime.text: Lose all your Block. Apply 1 Frost to every foe for every 2 Block lost, up to 4.

up.text: Lose all your Block. Apply 1 Frost to every foe for every 2 Block lost, up to 6.

bw_shed_the_rime.flavour: Everything the door has taken, thrown back as cold.
bw_shed_the_rime.note: The Ironwarden shakes the rime off his door and it scatters over the foes as frost.

bw_glacier_wall.name: Ice Shard
bw_glacier_wall.text: Gain 8 Block, plus 1 for each Frost on all foes, up to 14. Gain 3 Block for each Conjunction set off this round, up to 6. Fortify.

up.text: Gain 11 Block, plus 1 for each Frost on all foes, up to 17. Gain 3 Block for each Conjunction set off this round, up to 9. Fortify.

bw_glacier_wall.flavour: A glacier does not hurry. It does not stop, either.
bw_glacier_wall.note: Ice thickens in layers over the pine door until it stands like a wall of the north.

bw_numbing_cold.name: Numbing Cold
bw_numbing_cold.text: Apply 2 Frost to every foe, and 1 more to each foe with Water.

up.text: Apply 3 Frost to every foe, and 1 more to each foe with Water.

bw_numbing_cold.flavour: The chapel's cold came with the door. Wet things freeze first.
bw_numbing_cold.note: The Ironwarden breathes out behind the door and frost spreads across the floor to every foe.

bw_brittle.name: Brittle
bw_brittle.text: Handoff: apply 1 Frost first. Deal 1, plus 2 for each Frost on the target, up to 12.

up.text: Handoff: apply 1 Frost first. Deal 3, plus 2 for each Frost on the target, up to 14.

bw_brittle.flavour: Cold iron breaks. So does everything else.
bw_brittle.note: The mace strikes a rimed foe and frost-cracks spider across its armour.

bw_rake_of_thorns.name: Rake
bw_rake_of_thorns.text: Lose all your Thorns. Deal 2, plus 1 for each Thorns lost, up to 14. Prime 1 for every 2 Thorns lost, up to 4.

up.text: Lose all your Thorns. Deal 4, plus 1 for each Thorns lost, up to 16. Prime 1 for every 2 Thorns lost, up to 5.

bw_rake_of_thorns.flavour: Penance ends. The barbs come out. Not gently.
bw_rake_of_thorns.note: The Thornguard drags his barbed forearm across a foe, tearing every spike loose.

bw_barbs_left_in.name: Wrench
bw_barbs_left_in.text: Lose all your Thorns. Deal 1 for each Thorns lost, up to 12. If you lost 4 or more, the target becomes Vulnerable.

up.text: Lose all your Thorns. Deal 2, plus 1 for each Thorns lost, up to 14. If you lost 3 or more, the target becomes Vulnerable.

bw_barbs_left_in.flavour: The barber-surgeons taught him this one. He did not ask how they knew.
bw_barbs_left_in.note: The Thornguard snaps his barbs off in a foe's hide and leaves them there.

bw_spiteful_guard.name: Caltrop
bw_spiteful_guard.text: Guard another hero this round. Gain 3 Thorns.

up.text: Guard another hero this round. Gain 5 Thorns.

bw_spiteful_guard.flavour: Go on. Reach past him for the scholar.
bw_spiteful_guard.note: The barbed door swings in front of the Elementalist; a foe's claw catches on the spikes.

bw_flagellants_cord.name: Flagellant's Cord
bw_flagellants_cord.text: Lose 3 HP. Taunt. Gain 2 Thorns, plus 1 for each HP lost this way.

up.text: Lose 3 HP. Taunt. Gain 4 Thorns, plus 1 for each HP lost this way.

bw_flagellants_cord.flavour: Every stroke is a name. He is not near the end of the list.
bw_flagellants_cord.note: The Thornguard lashes the cord across his back in full view of the foes.

bw_bramble_wall.name: Thicket
bw_bramble_wall.text: Taunt. Gain 8 Block, and 2 Thorns for each foe that means to strike you.

up.text: Taunt. Gain 10 Block, and 3 Thorns for each foe that means to strike you.

bw_bramble_wall.flavour: Come at the door and the door comes at you.
bw_bramble_wall.note: Three foes close on the barbed door at once; the Thornguard does not step back.

bw_under_the_door.name: Saint's Banner
bw_under_the_door.text: A hero gains 2 Block and 1 Ward, plus 1 Ward for each ailment on them.

up.text: A hero gains 3 Block and 2 Ward, plus 1 Ward for each ailment on them.

bw_under_the_door.flavour: The rubric strip on the ring handle was blessed. He has never asked by whom.
bw_under_the_door.note: The Bulwark tilts the door over the Alchemist; the red rubric strip flutters on its ring.

bw_weight_of_the_door.name: Battering Ram
bw_weight_of_the_door.text: Deal 6, plus your Block, up to 24. Lose all your Block. If 6 or more vigour was spent this round, push the target back 1.

up.text: Deal 9, plus your Block, up to 27. Lose all your Block. If 6 or more vigour was spent this round, push the target back 1.

bw_weight_of_the_door.flavour: Oak, three hinges and a man behind it. Enough to break a gate.
bw_weight_of_the_door.note: The Bulwark charges behind the door and slams its full face into a foe.

bw_counterweight.name: Counterweight

up.text: Pull the target forward 2. Prime 5.

bw_counterweight.flavour: Out of the back rank. Into the blade's reach.
bw_counterweight.note: The Bulwark hauls a back-rank caster forward on the mace's flanges, straight onto the Duelist's line.

bw_close_ranks.name: Oak Settle
bw_close_ranks.text: Every hero gains 2 Block, and 1 more if they have an ailment.

up.text: Every hero gains 3 Block, and 1 more if they have an ailment.

bw_close_ranks.flavour: Shoulder to shoulder. The garrison way.
bw_close_ranks.note: The company presses in behind the church door, shoulder to shoulder on the stair.

bw_dig_in.name: Dig In
bw_dig_in.text: Gain 4 Block per X. At X 4 or more, gain 6 more. If you have not moved this round, Fortify.

up.text: Gain 5 Block per X. At X 4 or more, gain 8 more. If you have not moved this round, Fortify.

bw_dig_in.flavour: The front rank is his. It has been since the tower.
bw_dig_in.note: The Bulwark grinds the door's lower edge into the flagstones at the front of the line.

bw_undying_watch.name: Undying Watch
bw_undying_watch.text: Gain 1 Grit, and 1 Block for every 3 Scars. Every other hero sheds 2 stress. Exhaust.

up.text: Gain 2 Grit, and 1 Block for every 3 Scars. Every other hero sheds 3 stress. Exhaust.

bw_undying_watch.flavour: The last watch of the tower never ended. He is still standing it.
bw_undying_watch.note: The Bulwark stands alone in the ossuary doorway, plate patched with lead, as bones stir.

bw_martyrdom.name: Catherine Wheel
bw_martyrdom.text: Taunt. Gain Block equal to half the damage the foes mean to deal this round, up to 20. Gain 2 stress.

up.text: Taunt. Gain 4 Block, plus half the damage the foes mean to deal this round, up to 24. Gain 2 stress.

bw_martyrdom.flavour: All of it. Send all of it to me.
bw_martyrdom.note: Every foe in the throne room turns its weapon on the Bulwark at once.

bw_vengeance.name: Vengeance
bw_vengeance.text: Costs 1 less if you have 15 or more Scars. Deal 1 for each Scar, up to 30. If this kills the target, gain 1 Grit.

up.text: Costs 1 less if you have 15 or more Scars. Deal 5, plus 1 for each Scar, up to 34. If this kills the target, gain 1 Grit.

bw_vengeance.flavour: He keeps a tally on the door. This is where he settles it.
bw_vengeance.note: Beside the kill tally scratched into the planks, the Bulwark's mace falls on a ruler's guard.

bw_deep_winter.name: Deep Winter
bw_deep_winter.text: Gain 9 Block. Fortify. Apply 3 Frost to each foe that means to strike you. Bank 1.

up.text: Gain 12 Block. Fortify. Apply 4 Frost to each foe that means to strike you. Bank 1.

bw_deep_winter.flavour: The northern chapel stood in snow to its eaves, and the door still held.
bw_deep_winter.note: Snow drifts against the Ironwarden's door as the foes before it slow to a crawl.

bw_shatterguard.name: Shatterguard
bw_shatterguard.text: Deal damage equal to your Block, up to 20. Hit it again for 3 per Frost on it, up to 15. Lose all your Block.

up.text: Deal damage equal to your Block, up to 20. Hit it again for 4 per Frost on it, up to 20. Lose all your Block.

bw_shatterguard.flavour: The wall comes down on you. All of the winter with it.
bw_shatterguard.note: The Ironwarden brings the ice-thick door down on a frozen foe and both shatter white.

bw_frozen_bulwark.name: Ice Rampart
bw_frozen_bulwark.text: Every hero gains 1 Block for each Frost on all foes, up to 10.

up.text: Every hero gains 2 Block, plus 1 for each Frost on all foes, up to 12.

bw_frozen_bulwark.flavour: The cold on them is a wall around us.
bw_frozen_bulwark.note: A ring of frost spreads from the Ironwarden's feet and rimes the company's shields.

bw_iron_maiden.name: Iron Maiden
bw_iron_maiden.text: Gain 3 Thorns, plus 1 for every 2 Bleed on all foes.

up.text: Gain 5 Thorns, plus 1 for every 2 Bleed on all foes.

bw_iron_maiden.flavour: He has made himself into the thing they lock sinners in. Their blood feeds it.
bw_iron_maiden.note: The Thornguard closes his barbed arms around himself; spikes stand from every plate.

bw_rose_of_iron.name: Iron Rose
bw_rose_of_iron.text: Lose 1 HP. If you lost it, double your Thorns. Gain 1 Thorns. Exhaust.

up.text: Lose 1 HP. If you lost it, double your Thorns. Gain 3 Thorns. Exhaust.

bw_rose_of_iron.note: New barbs split open along the Thornguard's arms like iron petals.

bw_hedge_of_spikes.name: Palisade
bw_hedge_of_spikes.text: Every hero gains 2 Thorns and 2 Block, and 2 more Thorns if a foe means to strike them.

up.text: Every hero gains 3 Thorns and 3 Block, and 2 more Thorns if a foe means to strike them.

bw_hedge_of_spikes.flavour: He hands out penance like bread. Everyone gets some.
bw_hedge_of_spikes.note: The Thornguard lashes barbed cord around the whole company's arms in the nave.

bw_aegis_of_the_door.name: Church Door
bw_aegis_of_the_door.text: Every hero gains 2 Ward and 4 Block, and 1 more Ward if they have an ailment. Exhaust.

up.text: Every hero gains 3 Ward and 6 Block, and 1 more Ward if they have an ailment. Exhaust.

bw_aegis_of_the_door.flavour: It was a church door before it was a shield. It remembers.
bw_aegis_of_the_door.note: The church door stands upright in the nave and its keyhole plate glows faintly over the company.

bw_vanguard.name: Vanguard
bw_vanguard.text: Move to rank 1. Taunt. Gain 3 Block. First in the Ordo: Prime 2.

up.text: Move to rank 1. Taunt. Gain 6 Block. First in the Ordo: Prime 3.

bw_vanguard.flavour: Whatever pushed him back, he walks back through it.
bw_vanguard.note: The Bulwark wades back to the front of the line through the brine grotto's shallows.

bw_the_door_swings.name: Stave In
bw_the_door_swings.text: Deal 8, plus 2 for each Armor on the target. Stun the target. Exhaust.

up.text: Deal 11, plus 2 for each Armor on the target. Stun the target. Exhaust.

bw_the_door_swings.flavour: A door opens both ways. This way hurts, and the heavier you are, the worse.
bw_the_door_swings.note: The Bulwark swings the whole church door on its hinge side into an armoured foe's face.

bw_deathless.name: Deathless
bw_deathless.text: Gain 4 Block, plus 1 for each Scar, up to 30. At Death's Door, Fortify.

up.text: Gain 4 Block, plus 1 for each Scar, up to 30. At Death's Door, Fortify.

bw_deathless.flavour: Lead in the plate and rope round the door. Still here.
bw_deathless.note: The Last Bastion, roped door and lead-patched plate, stands in a ring of fallen foes.

bw_patched_with_lead.name: Lead Patch
bw_patched_with_lead.text: Gain 1 Armor for the fight. If you have 15 or more Scars, gain 1 more. Exhaust.

up.text: Gain 1 Armor for the fight. If you have 10 or more Scars, gain 1 more. Exhaust.

bw_patched_with_lead.flavour: Where the plate broke, he poured lead. Where he broke, he did the same.
bw_patched_with_lead.note: The Last Bastion hammers a lead patch over a fresh breach in his breastplate.

bw_bound_with_rope.name: Grapnel
bw_bound_with_rope.text: Heal 3. Gain 2 Block, plus 1 per vigour left unspent, up to 5.

up.text: Heal 5. Gain 3 Block, plus 1 per vigour left unspent, up to 7.

bw_bound_with_rope.flavour: Rope for the door, linen for the man. Both hold, mostly.
bw_bound_with_rope.note: The Last Bastion lashes the cracked door together with rope between blows.

bw_still_here.name: Endure
bw_still_here.text: Gain 5 Block. At Death's Door, gain 1 Grit, and the hero behind you gains 1 Thrift. Exhaust.

up.text: Gain 8 Block. At Death's Door, gain 1 Grit, and the hero behind you gains 1 Thrift. Exhaust.

bw_still_here.flavour: Sister Wenna gave him a week. That was eleven doors ago.
bw_still_here.note: The Last Bastion, on his feet with no right to be, raises the roped door again.

bw_come_and_finish_it.name: Last Stand

up.text: Deal 1 for every 2 Scars. Taunt.

bw_come_and_finish_it.flavour: You have nearly killed him. Nearly is the worst place to stop.
bw_come_and_finish_it.note: Blood running from the helm's slit, the Last Bastion beckons the ruler on with the mace.

bw_defiance.name: Drawn Sword
bw_defiance.text: Shed 1 stress for every 2 Scars, rounded up. At Death's Door, gain 1 Might.

up.text: Shed 1 stress for each Scar. At Death's Door, gain 1 Might.

bw_defiance.flavour: Pain is only the body's argument. He stopped listening at the tower.
bw_defiance.note: The Last Bastion laughs behind his split helm as blood pools at his feet.

bw_pine_and_iron.name: Ironbound
bw_pine_and_iron.text: Gain 8 Block, plus 1 per vigour left unspent, up to 11. Fortify. Apply 1 Frost to every foe.

up.text: Gain 8 Block, plus 1 per vigour left unspent, up to 11. Fortify. Apply 1 Frost to every foe.

bw_pine_and_iron.flavour: The northern chapel's door: iron-bound pine, and colder than the snow it kept out.
bw_pine_and_iron.note: The Ironwarden sets the iron-bound pine door down and frost runs out across the floor.

bw_frostbite_bash.name: Hailstone
bw_frostbite_bash.text: Deal 5. Apply 2 Frost, and 1 more if the target has Water.

up.text: Deal 7. Apply 3 Frost, and 1 more if the target has Water.

bw_frostbite_bash.flavour: The frost in his beard is on the mace now. Soon it is in you.
bw_frostbite_bash.note: The Ironwarden's rimed mace strikes and frost blooms across the foe's face.

bw_shatter_the_line.name: Shatter
