bw_shatter_the_line.text: Deal 3 to every foe, plus 1 for each Frost on it. Last in the Ordo: then apply 1 Frost to every foe.

up.text: Deal 5 to every foe, plus 1 for each Frost on it. Last in the Ordo: then apply 1 Frost to every foe.

bw_shatter_the_line.flavour: Cold makes a line of foes into a line of glass.
bw_shatter_the_line.note: The Ironwarden sweeps the door across the frozen front rank and ice flies.

bw_fur_mantle.name: Fur Mantle

up.text: Gain 6 Block and 2 Ward. Fortify.

bw_fur_mantle.flavour: The north gave him the mantle and the cold under it.
bw_fur_mantle.note: The Ironwarden pulls the fur mantle tight over his rimed windward shoulder.

bw_breath_of_the_north.name: North Wind
bw_breath_of_the_north.text: Apply 3 Frost to each foe that means to strike you. Gain 3 Block.

up.text: Apply 4 Frost to each foe that means to strike you. Gain 4 Block.

bw_breath_of_the_north.flavour: He breathes out. Whatever raised a hand to him feels it in the bone.
bw_breath_of_the_north.note: The Ironwarden's breath smokes white through the helm slit; the foes facing him rime over.

bw_windbreak.name: Windbreak
bw_windbreak.text: Guard another hero this round. Apply 1 Frost to every foe that means to attack.

up.text: Guard another hero this round. Apply 2 Frost to every foe that means to attack.

bw_windbreak.flavour: Behind him the wind drops. In front of him it bites.
bw_windbreak.note: The Ironwarden stands his door before the Oracle as a gale of frost meets the foes.

bw_briar_mail.name: Briar Mail
bw_briar_mail.text: Gain 3 Thorns and 3 Block. Handoff: gain 1 more Thorns.

up.text: Gain 4 Thorns and 4 Block. Handoff: gain 2 more Thorns.

bw_briar_mail.flavour: Barbs out, hair shirt in. Penance on both sides of the plate.
bw_briar_mail.note: The Thornguard's penitent armour, barbs welded outward, catches the torchlight.

bw_barbed_haft.name: Barbed Haft
bw_barbed_haft.text: If the target has Hex, gain 2 Thorns first. Deal damage equal to your Thorns, twice.

up.text: If the target has Hex, gain 3 Thorns first. Deal 1, plus your Thorns, twice.

bw_barbed_haft.flavour: He wrapped the mace haft in barbed wire. His palms remember.
bw_barbed_haft.note: The Thornguard's wire-wrapped mace strikes twice, the second blow tearing.

bw_welded_barbs.name: Welded Barbs
bw_welded_barbs.text: Lose 4 HP. Gain 5 Thorns, plus 1 for each HP lost this way.

up.text: Lose 2 HP. Gain 7 Thorns, plus 1 for each HP lost this way.

bw_welded_barbs.flavour: Mother Hild welded the first barb. He did the rest, still wearing the plate.
bw_welded_barbs.note: Sparks fly as the Thornguard welds a new barb to his arm, the plate still on him.

bw_scourged_back.name: Stained Bandage
bw_scourged_back.text: Gain 2 Thorns, plus 1 for every 3 Scars.

up.text: Gain 4 Thorns, plus 1 for every 3 Scars.

bw_scourged_back.flavour: His back is a ledger of penance. Every line of it bites.
bw_scourged_back.note: Through the torn gambeson, the Thornguard's scourged back is a lattice of old cuts.

bw_punishing_wall.name: Portcullis

up.text: Taunt. Gain 6 Block and 5 Thorns.

bw_punishing_wall.flavour: Strike the door if you must. It was made for sinners.
bw_punishing_wall.note: The barbed door fills the nave's aisle and every foe turns on it.

bw_barbed_shove.name: Repel
bw_barbed_shove.text: Deal 4. Push the target back 1. Gain 2 Thorns.

up.text: Deal 5. Push the target back 1. Gain 3 Thorns.

bw_barbed_shove.flavour: Back. Back, and take some of the barbs with you.
bw_barbed_shove.note: The Thornguard drives the spiked door forward and the front foe stumbles back.

bw_the_door_does_not_fall.name: Lion Knocker
bw_the_door_does_not_fall.text: Gain 1 Grit. Rite: the first two times each round a foe strikes you while you are at Death's Door, gain 1 Might and 4 Block. Exhaust.

up.text: Gain 1 Grit and 8 Block. Rite: the first two times each round a foe strikes you while you are at Death's Door, gain 1 Might and 4 Block. Exhaust.

bw_the_door_does_not_fall.flavour: The tower fell. The door did not. It never will again.
bw_the_door_does_not_fall.note: At the throne's foot the Last Bastion stands with no HP left, door raised, and the ruler hesitates.

bw_the_ledger_of_wounds.name: Reckoning
bw_the_ledger_of_wounds.text: Retain. Deal 2 for each Scar, up to 60. If this kills the target, +2 vigour next round. Exhaust.

up.text: Retain. Deal 2 for each Scar, up to 60. Gain 1 Block for each Scar, up to 30. If this kills the target, +2 vigour next round. Exhaust.

bw_the_ledger_of_wounds.flavour: Brother Lucan writes down every death. He keeps the other ledger, and it is due.
bw_the_ledger_of_wounds.note: The Last Bastion swings once, and every scar on the door's planks seems to open with the blow.

bw_winter_without_end.name: Midwinter
bw_winter_without_end.text: Gain 8 Block. Fortify. Bank 2. Rite: at the start of each round, Fortify and gain 1 Block for each Frost on all foes, up to 12. Exhaust.

up.text: Gain 8 Block. Fortify. Bank 2. Apply 1 Frost to every foe. Rite: at the start of each round, Fortify and gain 1 Block for each Frost on all foes, up to 12. Exhaust.

bw_winter_without_end.flavour: Spring does not come to the northern chapel. He brought the winter with him.
bw_winter_without_end.note: The Ironwarden's door is a cliff of blue ice; the foes before it are rimed to the knee.

bw_the_long_night.name: The Long Night
bw_the_long_night.text: Gain 5 Block. Apply 1 Frost to each foe that means to strike you. Rite: each time a foe strikes you, apply 1 Frost to it; then, if it has 4 or more Frost, apply 1 Volatile Water to it. Exhaust.

up.text: Gain 5 Block. Fortify. Apply 1 Frost to each foe that means to strike you. Rite: each time a foe strikes you, apply 1 Frost to it; then, if it has 4 or more Frost, apply 1 Volatile Water to it. Exhaust.

bw_the_long_night.flavour: The night in the north lasts half the year. Whatever strikes him stays in it.
bw_the_long_night.note: One by one the foes that struck the Ironwarden stand frozen solid before his door.

bw_crown_of_iron_thorns.name: Crown of Thorns
bw_crown_of_iron_thorns.text: Gain 4 Thorns. Every other hero gains 1 Thorns. Rite: the first 3 times each round a foe strikes another hero, deal damage equal to your Thorns to it. Exhaust.

up.text: Gain 6 Thorns. Every other hero gains 2 Thorns. Rite: the first 3 times each round a foe strikes another hero, deal damage equal to your Thorns to it. Exhaust.

bw_crown_of_iron_thorns.flavour: He wears the crown for all of them. Strike any one of them and it bites.
bw_crown_of_iron_thorns.note: A crown of welded barbs sits on the Thornguard's helm; a foe that struck the Duelist reels, torn.

bw_the_scourged_hand.name: The Scourged Hand
bw_the_scourged_hand.text: Gain 5 Thorns. Rite: each time you play a card on a foe that means to attack, deal damage equal to your Thorns to it. Exhaust.

up.text: Gain 5 Thorns and 6 Block. Rite: each time you play a card on a foe that means to attack, deal damage equal to your Thorns to it. Exhaust.

bw_the_scourged_hand.flavour: Penance was the wound. Now it is the weapon.
bw_the_scourged_hand.note: The Thornguard's mace hand, wrapped in barbed cord to the elbow, comes down bloody.

du_find_the_gap.name: Rapier

up.text: Mark the target for 2 rounds. Gain 1 Momentum.

du_find_the_gap.flavour: Every guard has a gap. The trade is seeing it first.
du_find_the_gap.note: The Duelist's blade tip stops circling and settles on one foe's open flank.

du_quickstep.name: Quickstep
du_quickstep.text: Swap with an adjacent hero. Gain 1 Momentum. Handoff: gain 1 more.

up.text: Swap with an adjacent hero. Gain 1 Momentum. Handoff: gain 1 more. Dodge the next hit this round.

du_quickstep.flavour: Never where the blow lands. Always where the next one starts.
du_quickstep.note: The Bladedancer spins past the Bulwark's door-shield, both blades trailing.

du_drag_to_the_block.name: Headsman's Block
du_drag_to_the_block.text: Pull the target forward 1. Mark it.

up.text: Pull the target forward 1. Mark it for 2 rounds.

du_drag_to_the_block.flavour: The condemned do not walk to the block. They are brought.
du_drag_to_the_block.note: The hooded Executioner hooks a back-rank foe by the collar and hauls it up the nave.

du_staunch.name: Staunch
du_staunch.text: The most wounded hero heals 1 per Bleed on the target (not spent), up to 6.

up.text: The most wounded hero heals 1 per Bleed on the target (not spent), up to 9.

du_staunch.flavour: What runs out of them can be put back into us. Barber's arithmetic.
du_staunch.note: The Bloodletter tips the bloodied bowl over a hero's wound; the cut closes.

du_first_touch.name: First Touch

up.text: Deal 2. Gain 1 Momentum. First in the Ordo: gain 1 more.

du_first_touch.flavour: The first touch is never meant to kill. It is meant to be answered.
du_first_touch.note: The Duelist flicks the rapier's point against a foe's guard; a white-gold spark jumps.

du_lunge.name: Lunge

up.text: Advance 1. Deal 7.

du_lunge.flavour: Back foot, front foot, and the blade arrives before the body.
du_lunge.note: The Duelist lunges almost flat across the flooded stair, sash streaming behind.

du_sighting_cut.name: Sighting Cut

up.text: Deal 6. Mark the target.

du_sighting_cut.flavour: A nick on the wrist. Now the whole company knows where to look.
du_sighting_cut.note: A thin red line opens on a foe's sword arm; the Duelist's eyes stay on it.

du_parry.name: Parry
du_parry.text: Gain Riposte 2. Dodge the next hit this round.

up.text: Gain Riposte 3. Dodge the next hit this round.

du_parry.flavour: Steel meets steel, and the answer is already on its way.
du_parry.note: The swept hilt turns a hook aside; the rapier's point is back in line at once.

du_close_the_measure.name: Close the Measure
du_close_the_measure.text: Finisher. Deal 4, plus 1 per Momentum spent. If the target is Marked, hit it again for the same.

up.text: Finisher. Deal 4, plus 1 per Momentum spent. If the target is Marked, hit it again for the same.

du_close_the_measure.flavour: Distance is the whole art. Close it once, and finish.
du_close_the_measure.note: The Duelist steps inside a foe's reach and drives the rapier home to the swept hilt.

du_feather_cut.name: Flourish

up.text: Deal 2. Gain 1 Momentum.

du_feather_cut.flavour: Held back for the beat when it matters. Then light as a feather.
du_feather_cut.note: The Duelist's point barely grazes a foe's cheek in passing.

du_two_step.name: Two-Step

up.text: Deal 4 twice. Follow-up: gain 1 Momentum.

du_two_step.flavour: One for the guard, one for what the guard was hiding.
du_two_step.note: Two quick cuts cross on a foe's chest in the belfry's light.

du_light_feet.name: Light Feet
du_light_feet.text: Dodge the next hit this round. Gain 1 Momentum. First in the Ordo: gain 1 more.

up.text: Dodge the next 2 hits this round. Gain 1 Momentum. First in the Ordo: gain 2 more.

du_light_feet.flavour: The floor is wet, the foe is heavy, and neither matters to the feet.
du_light_feet.note: The Duelist skips back from a falling boat hook on the balls of the feet.

du_turn_of_the_wrist.name: Supple Wrist
du_turn_of_the_wrist.text: Deal 1, plus 2 per Momentum (not spent), up to 13.

up.text: Deal 3, plus 2 per Momentum (not spent), up to 15.

du_turn_of_the_wrist.flavour: The cut is in the wrist. The wrist is in the rhythm.
du_turn_of_the_wrist.note: A small circle of the rapier's tip, and a foe's guard comes apart.

du_sweep.name: Sweep
du_sweep.text: Deal 4 to each foe in ranks 1 and 2.

up.text: Deal 5 to each foe in ranks 1 and 2.

du_sweep.flavour: Two foes in reach is one foe too many. For them.
du_sweep.note: The Duelist's blade cuts a flat arc across the front of the nave.

du_arc_cut.name: Arc Cut

up.text: Deal 6. Apply 2 Lightning.

du_arc_cut.flavour: The lightning-touched schools leave the spark in the steel.
du_arc_cut.note: A white-gold spark runs down the scorched blade into the foe it cuts.

du_pronounce_sentence.name: Verdict

up.text: Mark the target for 2 rounds. Prime 1.

du_pronounce_sentence.flavour: The sentence is spoken once. It does not need repeating.
du_pronounce_sentence.note: The Executioner points the square-tipped sword down the nave at one foe.

du_measure_the_neck.name: Measure the Neck
du_measure_the_neck.text: Deal 2, or 5 if the target is Marked. If it was moved this round, hit it again for 3.

up.text: Deal 3, or 6 if the target is Marked. If it was moved this round, hit it again for 4.

du_measure_the_neck.flavour: Dragged in, stumbling, neck bare. The headsman has waited for exactly this.
du_measure_the_neck.note: The Bulwark's hook drags a foe forward and the Executioner's blade is already falling.

du_haul_forward.name: Haul Forward
du_haul_forward.text: Deal 2. Pull the target forward 1 and Mark it.

up.text: Deal 2. Pull the target forward 2 and Mark it.

du_haul_forward.flavour: No one hides at the back of a queue for the block.
du_haul_forward.note: The Executioner reaches past the front rank and drags a caster out by its robe.

du_heading_stroke.name: Two-Hander
du_heading_stroke.text: Deal 11, plus 1 per vigour left unspent, up to 14.

up.text: Deal 14, plus 1 per vigour left unspent, up to 18.

du_heading_stroke.flavour: Both hands, full swing. The old way.
du_heading_stroke.note: The broad heading sword comes down two-handed in the ossuary's gloom.

du_the_crowd_watches.name: Spectacle
du_the_crowd_watches.text: Deal 4. If it kills, every hero sheds 3 stress.

up.text: Deal 6. If it kills, every hero sheds 4 stress.

du_the_crowd_watches.flavour: A clean kill is a mercy to everyone watching.
du_the_crowd_watches.note: A foe falls under the black hood's stroke; behind it the company breathes out.

du_weigh_the_wound.name: Weigh the Wound
du_weigh_the_wound.text: Deal 3, plus 1 per 4 HP the target is missing, up to 12.

up.text: Deal 5, plus 1 per 4 HP the target is missing, up to 15.

du_weigh_the_wound.flavour: The worse the wound, the lighter the work.
du_weigh_the_wound.note: The Executioner sizes up a staggering foe before the stroke.

du_lancet.name: Lancet

up.text: Deal 4. Apply 3 Bleed.

du_lancet.flavour: A barber's first lesson: a small blade in the right place.
du_lancet.note: The Bloodletter's short curved blade flicks out and a thin red line follows.

du_open_the_vein.name: Open the Vein

up.text: Apply 5 Bleed.

du_open_the_vein.flavour: Let it run. The bowl is patient.
du_open_the_vein.note: A lancet from the belt case flies to a back-rank foe and sticks in its arm.

du_letting_cut.name: Letting Cut

up.text: Deal 4. Follow-up: apply 4 Bleed.

du_letting_cut.flavour: Someone else opened the door. The barber only widens it.
du_letting_cut.note: The Bloodletter cuts into the wound the Bulwark's mace has just made.

du_bloodmist.name: Blood Cup
du_bloodmist.text: Apply X Bleed to every foe. At X 4 or more, apply 2 more.

up.text: Apply X+1 Bleed to every foe. At X 4 or more, apply 2 more.

du_bloodmist.flavour: A spray of cuts, too quick to count. They will count them later.
du_bloodmist.note: The Bloodletter whirls through the line and a red mist hangs over the nave.

du_cupping_glass.name: Cupping Glass
du_cupping_glass.text: The most wounded hero heals 1, plus 1 per Bleed on the target (not spent).

up.text: The most wounded hero heals 3, plus 1 per Bleed on the target (not spent).

du_cupping_glass.flavour: Draw the bad blood out of them. Put the good back into us.
du_cupping_glass.note: A warm glass cup set on a hero's wound fills with light while a foe bleeds.

du_deep_cut.name: Long Blade
du_deep_cut.text: Apply 2 Bleed. Then, if the target has 6 or more Bleed, it becomes Vulnerable.

up.text: Apply 3 Bleed. Then, if the target has 6 or more Bleed, it becomes Vulnerable.

du_deep_cut.flavour: Past a certain depth the body stops defending itself.
du_deep_cut.note: The Bloodletter's curved blade sinks to the hilt in an already bloodied foe.

du_follow_through.name: Press
du_follow_through.text: Deal 3. Follow-up: hit it again for 4.

up.text: Deal 4. Follow-up: hit it again for 5.

du_follow_through.flavour: Strike where the last blow landed. It is still open.
du_follow_through.note: The Duelist's rapier enters the gap the Elementalist's frost just cracked open.

du_en_garde.name: En Garde

up.text: Gain Riposte 4. Gain 4 Block.

du_en_garde.flavour: Come, then. The blade is waiting for you.
du_en_garde.note: The Duelist sinks into the side-on stance, rapier level, rear arm back.

du_give_ground.name: Give Ground

up.text: Retreat 1. Gain 5 Block. Bank 1.

du_give_ground.flavour: A fencing master yields a step to keep the measure. Never more.
du_give_ground.note: The Duelist steps back behind the Bulwark's door, blade still up.

du_slip_and_cut.name: Slip
du_slip_and_cut.text: Dodge the next hit this round. Deal 2. If the target means to attack you, hit it again for 3.

up.text: Dodge the next hit this round. Deal 3. If the target means to attack you, hit it again for 4.

du_slip_and_cut.flavour: Let it come. Be somewhere else. Cut what is left reaching.
du_slip_and_cut.note: A drowned thrall's swing passes through the space the Duelist just left.

du_thunder_lunge.name: Thunderbolt

up.text: Advance 1. Deal 4. Apply 3 Lightning.

du_thunder_lunge.flavour: The schools teach the lunge and the strike as one thing.
du_thunder_lunge.note: The Duelist crosses two ranks in one lunge, sparks branching up the blade.

du_second_intention.name: Second Intention
du_second_intention.text: Deal 3. Gain 1 Momentum. Handoff: gain 1 more.

up.text: Deal 5. Gain 1 Momentum. Handoff: gain 1 more.

du_second_intention.flavour: The first attack is a question. The second is the point.
du_second_intention.note: A feint at the face; the real line goes low while the foe is still answering.

du_closing_whirl.name: Closing Whirl
du_closing_whirl.text: Costs 1 less if you have played 3 or more cards this round. Finisher. Deal 2 per Momentum spent to each foe in ranks 1 and 2.

up.text: Costs 1 less if you have played 3 or more cards this round. Finisher. Deal 2, plus 2 per Momentum spent, to each foe in ranks 1 and 2.

du_closing_whirl.flavour: Every step of the dance was the windup. This is the swing.
du_closing_whirl.note: The Bladedancer turns a full circle at the front of the nave, both blades out.

du_quick_hands.name: Quick Hands
du_quick_hands.text: Twice: deal 1, plus 1 per vigour spent before it this round, up to 6.

up.text: Twice: deal 2, plus 1 per vigour spent before it this round, up to 7.

du_quick_hands.flavour: Two cuts in the time of one. Three, when the blood is up.
du_quick_hands.note: The Duelist's sword hand blurs; two red lines appear on a foe's guard.

du_catch_the_rhythm.name: Cadence
du_catch_the_rhythm.text: Gain 2 Momentum. If you have played 2 or more cards this round, gain 2 more and Dodge the next hit this round.

up.text: Gain 2 Momentum. If you have played a card this round, gain 2 more and Dodge the next hit this round.

du_catch_the_rhythm.flavour: One. Two. Now the feet know the tune.
du_catch_the_rhythm.note: The Duelist's blade tip circles faster, keeping time with the bell overhead.

du_serrated_rhythm.name: Bonesaw
du_serrated_rhythm.text: Apply 1 Bleed to the foe in rank 1. Rite: for the rest of the fight, each physical card you play on a foe also applies 1 Bleed to it, up to 3 times a round. Exhaust.

up.text: Apply 1 Bleed to the foe in rank 1. Rite: for the rest of the fight, each physical card you play on a foe also applies 1 Bleed to it, up to 5 times a round. Exhaust.

du_serrated_rhythm.flavour: Notch the edge. Every touch after that leaves something behind.
du_serrated_rhythm.note: The Bladedancer draws a file along the second blade; its edge comes up toothed.

du_shatter_point.name: Shiver
du_shatter_point.text: Deal 4, plus 1 per Frost on the target, up to 8.

up.text: Deal 5, plus 2 per Frost on the target, up to 11.

du_shatter_point.flavour: Cold steel, colder foe. Strike the frost and it breaks.
du_shatter_point.note: The rapier's point cracks the rime on a frozen foe and the ice falls away in plates.

du_carry_out_the_sentence.name: Behead
du_carry_out_the_sentence.text: Finisher. Deal 3. Then, if the target is Marked, Execute 4, plus 3 per Momentum spent.

up.text: Finisher. Deal 5. Then, if the target is Marked, Execute 4, plus 3 per Momentum spent.

du_carry_out_the_sentence.flavour: Sentence was passed. All that remains is the stroke.
du_carry_out_the_sentence.note: The black hood bows once over a kneeling, Marked foe; the heading sword rises.

du_condemned.name: Noose
du_condemned.text: Mark every foe below half HP for 2 rounds.

up.text: Mark every foe below half HP for 2 rounds. Gain 1 Momentum.

du_condemned.flavour: The wounded are named first. It saves time.
du_condemned.note: The Executioner walks the line and taps each bleeding foe with the flat of the blade.

du_second_stroke.name: Hew
du_second_stroke.text: Costs 1 less if 2 or more attacks are already in the Ordo. Deal 5, plus 1 per 2 HP the target is missing, up to 16.

up.text: Costs 1 less if 2 or more attacks are already in the Ordo. Deal 7, plus 1 per 2 HP the target is missing, up to 20.

du_second_stroke.flavour: A bad headsman needs a second stroke. A good one plans for it.
du_second_stroke.note: The heading sword falls again on a foe the company has already broken.

du_next_in_line.name: Notch
du_next_in_line.text: Deal 4. If it kills, gain 1 Thrift.

up.text: Deal 6. If it kills, gain 1 Thrift.

du_next_in_line.flavour: One down. The block is cleaned. Next.
du_next_in_line.note: The Executioner steps over a fallen foe toward the one behind it.

du_bled_pale.name: Pallor
du_bled_pale.text: Deal 3. Then Execute 2, plus 2 per Bleed on the target.

up.text: Deal 4. Then Execute 3, plus 2 per Bleed on the target.

du_bled_pale.flavour: White as linen, light as straw. The stroke barely needs the sword.
du_bled_pale.note: A foe stands grey-faced over a red pool; the hood leans in and finishes it.

du_drain_the_bowl.name: Bleeding Bowl
du_drain_the_bowl.text: Consume the target's Bleed. Deal 2 per stack. The most wounded hero heals 1 per stack.

up.text: Consume the target's Bleed. Deal 3 per stack. The most wounded hero heals 1 per stack.

du_drain_the_bowl.flavour: Every barber's bowl is emptied in the end. Into someone.
du_drain_the_bowl.note: The Bloodletter tips the full bowl; the red runs from the foe to a wounded hero.

du_haemorrhage.name: Blood Pail
du_haemorrhage.text: Apply 2 Bleed, then double the target's Bleed. Exhaust.

up.text: Apply 3 Bleed, then double the target's Bleed. Exhaust.

du_haemorrhage.flavour: There is a vessel in the thigh no barber touches. This barber does.
du_haemorrhage.note: A foe looks down at the dark spreading flood under its legs.

du_foul_blood.name: Foul Blood
du_foul_blood.text: Deal 3. Apply Bleed equal to the target's Toxin.

up.text: Deal 3. Apply 1 Bleed, plus 1 per Toxin on the target.

du_foul_blood.flavour: Poisoned blood wants out. The barber obliges.
du_foul_blood.note: The Plaguewright's toxin blackens a foe's veins; the Bloodletter's blade opens them.

du_red_hands.name: Gore
du_red_hands.text: Deal 2 per Bleed on the target (not spent), up to 20.

up.text: Deal 3, plus 2 per Bleed on the target (not spent), up to 23.

du_red_hands.flavour: The barber does not wash between patients. It saves time.
du_red_hands.note: The Bloodletter's striped sleeve is red to the elbow as the blade goes in.

du_barbers_trade.name: Barber-Surgeon
du_barbers_trade.text: Apply 2 Bleed. The most wounded hero heals 2, plus 1 per vigour left unspent, up to 4.

up.text: Apply 3 Bleed. The most wounded hero heals 3, plus 1 per vigour left unspent, up to 6.

du_barbers_trade.flavour: Cut here, bind there. The trade has always run both ways.
du_barbers_trade.note: One hand lances a foe, the other presses a bandage to a hero's side.

du_charged_point.name: Charged Point
du_charged_point.text: Deal 2, plus 2 per Lightning on the target (not spent).

up.text: Deal 4, plus 2 per Lightning on the target (not spent).

du_charged_point.flavour: Where the storm has already been, the blade finds the way.
du_charged_point.note: Branching scorch marks on a foe flare white as the rapier's point touches them.

du_forked_blade.name: Forked Blade
du_forked_blade.text: Deal 3. Apply 2 Lightning to the target and 1 to each foe beside it.

up.text: Deal 4. Apply 2 Lightning to the target and 2 to each foe beside it.

du_forked_blade.flavour: The spark does not stop at one. It never has.
du_forked_blade.note: Lightning forks from the Duelist's blade into the foes on either side.

du_answering_steel.name: Answering Steel
du_answering_steel.text: Gain Riposte 1. Deal 3 per Riposte you hold (not spent), up to 15.

up.text: Gain Riposte 2. Deal 3 per Riposte you hold (not spent), up to 18.

du_answering_steel.flavour: A parry held long enough becomes an attack.
du_answering_steel.note: The Duelist uncoils from a deep guard, the rapier striking from where it parried.

du_open_guard.name: Invitation
du_open_guard.text: Lose 2 HP. Taunt. Gain Riposte 3, plus 1 for each HP lost this way.

up.text: Lose 2 HP. Taunt. Gain Riposte 5, plus 1 for each HP lost this way.

du_open_guard.flavour: Here. Right here. Aim for it.
du_open_guard.note: The Duelist lowers the blade in rank 1 and beckons the drowned forward.

du_in_the_wake.name: Flurry
du_in_the_wake.text: Deal 4. Follow-up: hit it again for 4. Handoff: gain 1 Momentum.

up.text: Deal 5. Follow-up: hit it again for 5. Handoff: gain 1 Momentum.

du_in_the_wake.flavour: The Bulwark knocks the guard aside. The point is already there.
du_in_the_wake.note: The Duelist's lunge lands in the dent the Bulwark's mace has just left.

du_hundred_touches.name: Bout
du_hundred_touches.text: Finisher. Deal 3, once plus once per Momentum spent. If 6 or more vigour was spent this round, hit once more for 3.

up.text: Finisher. Deal 4, once plus once per Momentum spent. If 6 or more vigour was spent this round, hit once more for 4.

du_hundred_touches.flavour: No single cut matters. That is the point. All of them do.
du_hundred_touches.note: The Bladedancer is a blur of two blades; a foe's coat comes apart in ribbons.

du_ride_the_lightning.name: Lightning Step
du_ride_the_lightning.text: Advance 1. Apply 2 Volatile Lightning. Gain 2 Momentum.

up.text: Advance 1. Apply 3 Volatile Lightning. Gain 2 Momentum.

du_ride_the_lightning.flavour: The schools say the bolt chooses the blade. Some blades choose back.
du_ride_the_lightning.note: The Duelist comes down the stair inside a fork of lightning, point first.

du_counter_time.name: Counter-Time
du_counter_time.text: Dodge the next hit this round. Gain Riposte 2, plus 2 per foe that means to attack you.

up.text: Dodge the next hit this round. Gain Riposte 3, plus 2 per foe that means to attack you.

du_counter_time.flavour: Read the attack, step through it, and be the answer it did not expect.
du_counter_time.note: Three foes swing at once; the Duelist is already behind the first of them.

du_duellists_eye.name: Master's Eye
du_duellists_eye.text: Mark every foe. Each foe with Bleed also becomes Vulnerable. Gain 2 Momentum.

up.text: Mark every foe. Each foe with Bleed also becomes Vulnerable. Gain 2 Momentum.

du_duellists_eye.flavour: Every wound is a lesson in where the next one goes.
du_duellists_eye.note: The Duelist stands still in the nave and looks along the whole bleeding line.

du_final_judgment.name: Final Judgment
du_final_judgment.text: Finisher. Execute 5, plus 4 per Momentum spent.

up.text: Finisher. Execute 7, plus 4 per Momentum spent.

du_final_judgment.flavour: No appeal is heard on this side of the door.
du_final_judgment.note: The Doomsayer's bell tolls and the Executioner's sword falls on the same beat.

du_make_an_example.name: Gibbet
du_make_an_example.text: Deal 4. If it kills, Mark every foe and Prime 2.

up.text: Deal 6. If it kills, Mark every foe and Prime 3.

du_make_an_example.flavour: One falls in front of the others. Now they all know their turn is coming.
du_make_an_example.note: A foe drops at the Executioner's feet; the rest of the line flinches.

du_open_every_vein.name: Fleam
du_open_every_vein.text: Apply 2 Bleed to every foe. Then each foe with 5 or more Bleed becomes Vulnerable.

up.text: Apply 3 Bleed to every foe. Then each foe with 5 or more Bleed becomes Vulnerable.

du_open_every_vein.flavour: The whole line is one patient now.
du_open_every_vein.note: The Bloodletter runs the length of the line, the curved blade touching every foe once.

du_bowl_passed_round.name: Leechcraft
du_bowl_passed_round.text: Every hero heals 1 per 2 Bleed on all foes. Exhaust.

up.text: Every hero heals 3, plus 1 per 2 Bleed on all foes. Exhaust.

du_bowl_passed_round.flavour: Drink. It was theirs. Now it is ours.
du_bowl_passed_round.note: The bloodied bowl goes hand to hand around the company in the brine grotto.

du_echo_of_steel.name: Reprise
du_echo_of_steel.text: Echo. Deal 2 twice. Follow-up: apply 1 Bleed.

up.text: Echo. Deal 3 twice. Follow-up: apply 2 Bleed.

du_echo_of_steel.flavour: Strike, and strike, and the stone walls strike back with the sound of it.
du_echo_of_steel.note: The Bladedancer's two blades ring in the belfry and the ringing cuts again.

du_oath_of_the_salle.name: Salute
du_oath_of_the_salle.text: Finisher. Gain 1 Might per 2 Momentum spent. Exhaust.

up.text: Finisher. Gain 1 Might, plus 1 per 2 Momentum spent. Exhaust.

du_oath_of_the_salle.flavour: Sworn on the blade at the fencing hall. Every cut since keeps the vow.
du_oath_of_the_salle.note: The Duelist kisses the swept hilt, and the scorch lines on the sword hand glow.

du_fall_back_in_guard.name: Buckler
du_fall_back_in_guard.text: Retreat 1. Dodge the next hit this round. The hero in front of you then gains 1 Thrift.

up.text: Retreat 1. Dodge the next 2 hits this round. The hero in front of you then gains 1 Thrift and 4 Block.

du_fall_back_in_guard.flavour: Retreat is a step of the dance. The blade never leaves the line.
du_fall_back_in_guard.note: The Duelist backs up the stair, parrying two blows on the way.

du_killing_thrust.name: Killing Thrust
du_killing_thrust.text: Finisher. Deal 3, plus 3 per Momentum spent. Then Execute 6 if the target is Marked.

up.text: Finisher. Deal 3, plus 3 per Momentum spent. Then Execute 10 if the target is Marked.

du_killing_thrust.flavour: The whole fight was spent arriving at this one inch of steel.
du_killing_thrust.note: The rapier goes through a Marked foe to the swept hilt; the Duelist does not look back.

du_second_blade.name: Main-Gauche
du_second_blade.text: Deal 2 three times. Gain 1 Momentum. Follow-up: gain 1 more.

up.text: Deal 3 three times. Gain 1 Momentum. Follow-up: gain 1 more.

du_second_blade.flavour: The off hand was never idle. It was waiting for its turn.
du_second_blade.note: The Bladedancer draws the second blade mid-turn and both cut together.

du_encore.name: Encore
du_encore.text: Echo. Deal 2, plus 1 for every 3 vigour spent this round, up to 5. Gain 1 Momentum.

up.text: Echo. Deal 3, plus 1 for every 3 vigour spent this round, up to 7. Gain 1 Momentum.

du_encore.flavour: The crowd is dead and drowned. The dancer bows anyway, and goes again.
du_encore.note: The Bladedancer finishes a pass, bows, and comes straight back through.

du_blade_wheel.name: Blade Wheel
du_blade_wheel.text: Finisher. Deal 2, plus 1 per Momentum spent, to every foe. Hit each Marked foe again for 2.

up.text: Finisher. Deal 2, plus 1 per Momentum spent, to every foe. Hit each Marked foe again for 2.

du_blade_wheel.flavour: Two blades, one turn, and nobody in the room is out of reach.
du_blade_wheel.note: The Bladedancer spins down the whole line, open shirt flaring, blades flat out.

du_untouchable.name: Sidestep
du_untouchable.text: Dodge the next 2 hits this round. Gain 1 Momentum.

up.text: Dodge the next 2 hits this round. Gain 2 Momentum.

du_untouchable.flavour: They have been swinging at the dancer all night. They are tired. The dancer is not.
du_untouchable.note: Two blows close on the Bladedancer and meet only each other.

du_drink_and_dance.name: Bravado

up.text: Deal 7. Dosed: gain 2 Momentum.

du_drink_and_dance.flavour: The Alchemist's Haste goes down like cold wine and comes out through the feet.
du_drink_and_dance.note: The Bladedancer catches a thrown flask, drinks, and is already moving.

du_cut_between_beats.name: Tempo
du_cut_between_beats.text: Deal 1, plus 1 per card you played before it this round.

up.text: Deal 2, plus 1 per card you played before it this round.

du_cut_between_beats.flavour: There is always room for one more cut between two others.
du_cut_between_beats.note: A third blade-flash lands between the Bladedancer's first two.

du_square_tip.name: Square Tip
du_square_tip.text: Deal 11, or 15 if the target is Marked. Last in the Ordo: then Execute 6.

up.text: Deal 15, or 20 if the target is Marked. Last in the Ordo: then Execute 8.

du_square_tip.flavour: A heading sword has no point. It was never made to fight. Only to finish.
du_square_tip.note: The broad square-tipped blade comes down two-handed on a Marked foe.

du_drag_them_up.name: Shackle
du_drag_them_up.text: Pull the target forward 2. Mark it for 2 rounds.

up.text: Pull the target forward 2. Mark it for 3 rounds.

du_drag_them_up.flavour: Up the steps. Kneel. Hood or no hood, they all kneel.
du_drag_them_up.note: The Executioner drags a back-rank foe by the hair to the front of the throne room.

du_hanging_day.name: Hanging Day
du_hanging_day.text: Finisher. Execute 4, plus 2 per Momentum spent, on every Marked foe.

up.text: Finisher. Execute 6, plus 2 per Momentum spent, on every Marked foe.

du_hanging_day.flavour: Not one sentence today. All of them, in a row.
du_hanging_day.note: The Executioner walks the Marked line and the sword falls once for each.

du_wipe_the_blade.name: Sheathe
du_wipe_the_blade.text: Gain 3 Block. Every hero sheds 2 stress. Bank 1.

up.text: Gain 5 Block. Every hero sheds 3 stress. Bank 1.

du_wipe_the_blade.flavour: The apron takes the blood. The company takes a breath.
du_wipe_the_blade.note: The Executioner wipes the heading sword on the leather apron, unhurried.

du_mercy_stroke.name: Mercy Stroke
du_mercy_stroke.text: Deal 5. Then, if the target is Marked, Execute 6, plus 1 per Hex on it, up to 12.

up.text: Deal 6. Then, if the target is Marked, Execute 8, plus 1 per Hex on it, up to 15.

du_mercy_stroke.flavour: A headsman's kindness is a single stroke.
du_mercy_stroke.note: A Marked foe sags to its knees; the hooded figure ends it cleanly.

du_heavy_sentence.name: Forfeit
du_heavy_sentence.text: Deal 4, plus 1 per Doom on the target, up to 20.

up.text: Deal 6, plus 1 per Doom on the target, up to 22.

du_heavy_sentence.flavour: The bell has rung for it. The sword only keeps the appointment.
du_heavy_sentence.note: The Doomsayer's handbell rings and the Executioner strikes on the toll.

du_nick_the_vein.name: Thorn

up.text: Apply 2 Bleed. Follow-up: apply 1 more.

du_nick_the_vein.flavour: A barber can bleed a man without him feeling it.
du_nick_the_vein.note: A lancet's tip touches a foe's wrist in passing; a bead of red follows.

du_bleed_the_line.name: Lacerate
du_bleed_the_line.text: Apply 3 Bleed to the target and 2 to each foe beside it.

up.text: Apply 4 Bleed to the target and 3 to each foe beside it.

du_bleed_the_line.flavour: One cut, and the bowl fills from three sides.
du_bleed_the_line.note: The Bloodletter's curved blade passes through one foe and catches the two beside it.

du_let_the_fever_out.name: Purge
du_let_the_fever_out.text: If the target hero has 3 or more ailment stacks, they gain 1 Thrift. They lose 2 ailment stacks and heal 2.

up.text: If the target hero has 3 or more ailment stacks, they gain 1 Thrift. They lose 3 ailment stacks and heal 4.

du_let_the_fever_out.flavour: Bad humours out, good blood in. The oldest cure there is.
du_let_the_fever_out.note: The Bloodletter opens a vein in a fevered hero's arm over the bowl, gently.

du_arterial_cut.name: Jugular
du_arterial_cut.text: Deal 6. Apply 4 Bleed, plus 1 for every 2 vigour spent this round, up to 8.

up.text: Deal 6. Apply 4 Bleed, plus 1 for every 2 vigour spent this round, up to 8.

du_arterial_cut.flavour: There is a place on every body where the barber stops being gentle.
du_arterial_cut.note: A bright red arc leaps from a foe's throat across the nave's flagstones.

du_turn_the_parry.name: Round Shield
du_turn_the_parry.text: Spend all your Riposte. Apply 1 Bleed, plus 1 per Riposte spent.

up.text: Spend all your Riposte. Apply 3 Bleed, plus 1 per Riposte spent.

du_turn_the_parry.flavour: Every blade it sent at you comes back as a cut it cannot close.
du_turn_the_parry.note: The Bloodletter turns a foe's blade along its own arm and opens it to the elbow.

du_full_letting.name: Bleeding Basin
du_full_letting.text: Finisher. Apply 2 Bleed, plus 2 per Momentum spent.

up.text: Finisher. Apply 2 Bleed, plus 2 per Momentum spent.

du_full_letting.flavour: Not a nick. Not a lancing. The full letting, the way the old barbers did it.
du_full_letting.note: The Bloodletter's blade moves in a long practised line and the bowl overflows.

du_the_endless_measure.name: Danse Macabre
du_the_endless_measure.text: Gain 1 Momentum. Rite: for the rest of the fight, each physical card you play on a foe after your second card in a round also deals 3 to it. Exhaust.

up.text: Gain 1 Momentum. Rite: for the rest of the fight, each physical card you play on a foe after your second card in a round also deals 3 to it and applies 1 Bleed to it. Exhaust.

du_the_endless_measure.flavour: The music never stops. The dancer stopped counting long ago.
du_the_endless_measure.note: The Bladedancer moves through the whole throne room in one unbroken phrase of cuts.

du_two_blades_one_heart.name: Two Blades
du_two_blades_one_heart.text: Gain 2 Momentum. Rite: for the rest of the fight, each Finisher you play also deals 5 to each foe in ranks 1 and 2, and you Dodge the next hit this round. Exhaust.

up.text: Gain 2 Momentum. Rite: for the rest of the fight, each Finisher you play also deals 5 to each foe in ranks 1 and 2, you Dodge the next hit this round, and you gain 1 Momentum. Exhaust.

du_two_blades_one_heart.flavour: One blade to guard, one to answer, and one heart keeping time for both.
du_two_blades_one_heart.note: The Bladedancer stands untouched in rank 1 as both blades sweep the front of the line.

du_the_headsmans_round.name: Headsman
du_the_headsmans_round.text: Mark the target. Rite: for the rest of the fight, each time an Execute kills or breaks a foe, +1 vigour next round and deal 6 to every Marked foe, at most twice a round. Exhaust.

up.text: Mark the target. Rite: for the rest of the fight, each time an Execute kills or breaks a foe, +1 vigour next round, deal 6 to every Marked foe and Mark the foe in rank 1, at most twice a round. Exhaust.

du_the_headsmans_round.flavour: The cart is full. The headsman works through the list without looking up.
du_the_headsmans_round.note: The Executioner moves down a kneeling, Marked line, one stroke for each.

du_the_long_sentence.name: The Long Sentence
du_the_long_sentence.text: Mark the target for 3 rounds. Rite: for the rest of the fight, each card you play on a Marked foe gives it 2 Doom. Exhaust.

up.text: Mark the target for 3 rounds. Rite: for the rest of the fight, each card you play on a Marked foe gives it 2 Doom and deals 2 to it. Exhaust.

du_the_long_sentence.flavour: Some sentences take a single stroke. This one takes the whole fight.
du_the_long_sentence.note: The Executioner names a ruler from across the throne room and begins the count.

du_red_tide.name: Sea Anchor
du_red_tide.text: Apply 2 Bleed to every foe. Rite: for the rest of the fight, when a foe dies, every foe gains Bleed equal to the dead foe's Bleed, and you gain 1 Thrift. Exhaust.

up.text: Apply 2 Bleed to every foe. Rite: for the rest of the fight, when a foe dies, every foe gains Bleed equal to the dead foe's Bleed, plus 2, and you gain 1 Thrift. Exhaust.

du_red_tide.flavour: The bowl was never big enough. Let the floor hold it.
du_red_tide.note: The nave floor runs red from wall to wall, and the Bloodletter wades through it.

du_the_bowl_runs_over.name: Brimful
du_the_bowl_runs_over.text: The most wounded hero heals 1 per Bleed on all foes. Rite: at the end of each round, the most wounded hero heals 1 per Bleed on all foes. Exhaust.

up.text: The most wounded hero heals 1 per Bleed on all foes. Rite: at the end of each round, the most wounded hero heals 1 per Bleed on all foes and every hero sheds 2 stress. Exhaust.

du_the_bowl_runs_over.flavour: Whatever they spill, the company drinks. The fight can last forever now.
du_the_bowl_runs_over.note: The bloodied bowl hangs brimming from its cord, and the company's wounds close as foes pale.

el_turn_the_ring.name: Signet
el_turn_the_ring.text: Attune to the next course. Gain 1 Focus. Bank 1.

up.text: Attune to the next course. Gain 2 Focus. Bank 1.

el_turn_the_ring.flavour: Six sigils on a copper ring. Turn it, and the hand turns with it.
el_turn_the_ring.note: The Elementalist spins the copper sigil ring at the belt; the ink on one finger brightens.

el_stopper_the_jar.name: Covered Jar
el_stopper_the_jar.text: If the target has your attuned course, apply 1 more of it. Then gain 2 Focus, plus 1 for each vigour left unspent, up to 4.

up.text: If the target has your attuned course, apply 1 more of it. Then gain 3 Focus, plus 1 for each vigour left unspent, up to 5.

el_stopper_the_jar.flavour: What is poured in stays in. That is the whole art of the brass.
el_stopper_the_jar.note: The Accumulator presses a wax stopper into the brass vessel on its back; the foe's ink stays wet.

el_conjoin.name: Reed Pen

up.text: Conjoin 2. Handoff: Conjoin 1 again.

el_conjoin.flavour: One ink laid down. A second struck across it. Then the meeting.
el_conjoin.note: The Catalyst draws one stroke across a foe's settled ink and the two colours flare together.

el_sixth_ink.name: Sixth Ink
el_sixth_ink.text: Apply 1 of the next course, or 2 if another hero acted before this. Then, if the target holds 5 courses, apply 1 of the one it lacks.

up.text: Apply 2 of the next course, or 3 if another hero acted before this. Then, if the target holds 5 courses, apply 1 of the one it lacks.

el_sixth_ink.flavour: Five pots stand open. The sixth is the one the Mother kept.
el_sixth_ink.note: The Prismatic dips the last unstained finger and touches it to a foe already wearing five colours.

el_ink_bolt.name: Ink Bolt
el_ink_bolt.text: Deal 3. Apply 2 of your attuned course.

up.text: Deal 4. Apply 3 of your attuned course.

el_ink_bolt.flavour: The first lesson: lay the ink down and let it settle.
el_ink_bolt.note: The Elementalist flicks a bead of ink from a stained finger onto a Drowned Thrall's chest.

el_sigil_flick.name: Sigil Flick
el_sigil_flick.text: Deal 3. Apply 1 Volatile of your attuned course.

up.text: Deal 4. Apply 2 Volatile of your attuned course.

el_sigil_flick.flavour: The second lesson: strike across, and do not flinch.
el_sigil_flick.note: A casting flick; the sigil ring spins and a hot spark of ink cracks against a foe.

el_wet_the_nib.name: Inking
el_wet_the_nib.text: A hero gains 3 Focus. Gain 3 Block.

up.text: A hero gains 4 Focus. Gain 4 Block.

el_wet_the_nib.flavour: A dry pen scratches. A wet one writes.
el_wet_the_nib.note: The Elementalist touches an inked finger to the Duelist's blade; the steel drinks the colour.

el_ward_sigil.name: Ward Sigil
el_ward_sigil.text: A hero gains 2 Ward and 3 Block.

up.text: A hero gains 3 Ward and 4 Block.

el_ward_sigil.flavour: Drawn on the skin, a sigil turns a course aside like a hand turns rain.
el_ward_sigil.note: The Elementalist paints a ward sigil on the Bulwark's gauntlet as brine spits from the dark.

el_strike_across.name: Strike Across

up.text: Conjoin 2. Deal 2. Handoff: deal 2 more.

el_strike_across.flavour: Half the chapter calls this heresy. The other half takes notes.
el_strike_across.note: One stroke of ink across another on a foe's hide; the meeting flashes white.

el_lay_the_ground.name: Watering Can
el_lay_the_ground.text: Apply 4 of your attuned course. Gain 2 Block.

up.text: Apply 5 of your attuned course. Gain 3 Block.

el_lay_the_ground.flavour: A working is built from the ground coat up.
el_lay_the_ground.note: The Elementalist lays a thick wash of one ink over a foe, brush strokes still visible.

el_hold_the_breath.name: Gourd

up.text: Retain. Gain 4 Focus and 2 Block. Bank 1.

el_hold_the_breath.note: The Elementalist stands still in the nave, stained hand raised, lips pressed shut.

el_steep.name: Black Cauldron
el_steep.text: Apply 2 of your attuned course, plus 1 for each already on the target, up to 6.

up.text: Apply 3 of your attuned course, plus 1 for each already on the target, up to 8.

el_steep.flavour: Ink sinks into ink. The second coat goes deeper than the first.
el_steep.note: A foe's skin darkens where the same colour is laid over itself, again and again.

el_seal_the_jar.name: Sealing Wax
el_seal_the_jar.text: Apply 1 of your attuned course (this uses your Focus), so it does not fall this round. Then gain 2 Focus and 3 Block.

up.text: Apply 1 of your attuned course (this uses your Focus), so it does not fall this round. Then gain 3 Focus and 4 Block.

el_seal_the_jar.flavour: Wax over the mouth, a thumb pressed in it. The scholar's seal.
el_seal_the_jar.note: The Elementalist thumbs a wax seal onto a foe's brow; the ink beneath it stays glossy.

el_pour_out.name: Pour Out
el_pour_out.text: Apply 2 Volatile of the next course. Deal 1 for each vigour spent before this card this round, up to 4.

up.text: Apply 3 Volatile of the next course. Deal 1 for each vigour spent before this card this round, up to 4.

el_pour_out.flavour: Everything held, let go at once.
el_pour_out.note: The Elementalist tips a second ink over the first and the foe disappears in a flare.

el_spark.name: Spark
el_spark.text: Costs 1 less if another hero is already in the Ordo. Apply 1 Volatile of your attuned course.

up.text: Retain. Costs 1 less if another hero is already in the Ordo. Apply 1 Volatile of your attuned course.

el_spark.flavour: A spark is cheap. What it lands on is not.
el_spark.note: A single bright fleck leaves the Elementalist's fingernail and finds the ink already on a foe.

el_twin_sigil.name: Shield
el_twin_sigil.text: Apply 2 of your attuned course, then 2 Volatile of the next course.

up.text: Apply 3 of your attuned course, then 3 Volatile of the next course.

el_twin_sigil.flavour: Two sigils, one stroke. The chapter still argues which came first.
el_twin_sigil.note: Both of the Elementalist's hands sign at once; two colours cross on a foe's breast and burst.

el_scatter_ink.name: Scroll
el_scatter_ink.text: Apply 2 of your attuned course to every foe.

up.text: Apply 3 of your attuned course to every foe.

el_scatter_ink.flavour: Shake the pen and the whole page is spotted.
el_scatter_ink.note: The Elementalist flings a wet brush down the line of foes, spattering each one.

el_flung_ink.name: Spatter
el_flung_ink.text: Apply 1 Volatile of your attuned course to every foe.

up.text: Deal 2 to every foe. Apply 1 Volatile of your attuned course to every foe.

el_flung_ink.flavour: Every blot on the page catches at once.
el_flung_ink.note: A spray of bright ink arcs over the line and each foe it touches flashes in turn.

el_second_ink.name: Inkhorn
el_second_ink.text: Apply 2 of your attuned course. Attune to the next course and apply 2 of it.

up.text: Apply 3 of your attuned course. Attune to the next course and apply 3 of it.

el_second_ink.flavour: One finger, then the next. The hand remembers the order.
el_second_ink.note: Two stained fingers touch a foe one after the other, leaving two colours side by side.

el_split_nib.name: Split Nib
el_split_nib.text: Deal 3. Apply 1 of your attuned course and 1 of the next course.

up.text: Deal 4. Apply 2 of your attuned course and 2 of the next course.

el_split_nib.flavour: A split nib draws two lines. Keep them apart, or do not.
el_split_nib.note: A cut nib scores a foe with two thin lines of different ink that do not quite touch.

el_spectrum_bolt.name: Refraction
el_spectrum_bolt.text: Deal 3. Apply 2 of your attuned course, then Attune to the next course.

up.text: Deal 4. Apply 3 of your attuned course, then Attune to the next course.

el_spectrum_bolt.flavour: Each bolt leaves the ring a sigil further round.
el_spectrum_bolt.note: A bolt of one colour leaves the hand; the copper ring clicks round to the next sigil.

el_turn_the_page.name: Open Book
el_turn_the_page.text: Attune to the next course. Gain 2 Focus. If this is first in the Ordo, draw 1 more next round.

up.text: Attune to the next course. Gain 3 Focus. If this is first in the Ordo, draw 1 more next round.

el_turn_the_page.flavour: Every page of the satchel is a different colour. Read them in order.
el_turn_the_page.note: The Elementalist turns a page in the air with stained fingers; a new colour wells on the next one.

el_lend_the_nib.name: Spare Quill
el_lend_the_nib.text: Another hero gains 3 Focus and 1 Thrift.

up.text: Another hero gains 4 Focus and 1 Thrift.

el_lend_the_nib.flavour: Any hand can carry a course. It writes better with a scholar's ink on it.
el_lend_the_nib.note: The Elementalist presses a stained thumb to the Alchemist's flask; the glass takes the colour.

el_wet_the_line.name: Kettle

up.text: Apply 3 Water to every foe.

el_wet_the_line.flavour: Soak them all. The Duelist's blade will find the rest.
el_wet_the_line.note: Deep-blue ink sheets down the line of foes and pools at their feet on the drowned stair.

el_frost_the_swing.name: Numb
el_frost_the_swing.text: Apply 2 Frost to every foe that means to attack. Gain 2 Block.

up.text: Apply 3 Frost to every foe that means to attack. Gain 2 Block.

el_frost_the_swing.flavour: Cold the arm before it falls. The Bulwark will thank you, after.
el_frost_the_swing.note: Pale-blue ink rimes the raised arms of three foes as they swing at the Bulwark's door.

el_gall_ink.name: Gall Ink
el_gall_ink.text: Apply 2 Toxin, plus 1 for each Armor the target has, up to 5.

up.text: Apply 3 Toxin, plus 1 for each Armor the target has, up to 7.

el_gall_ink.flavour: Oak-gall ink eats parchment. It eats plate faster.
el_gall_ink.note: Sick-green ink runs into the seams of a foe's armour and the rivets bubble.

el_sulphur_match.name: Sulphur Match
el_sulphur_match.text: Deal 3. If the target has Toxin, deal 2 more. Apply 1 Volatile Fire.

up.text: Deal 4. If the target has Toxin, deal 3 more. Apply 1 Volatile Fire.

el_sulphur_match.flavour: The Plaguewright lays the poison. The scholar brings the light.
el_sulphur_match.note: A vermilion spark drops onto a foe sweating green and the poison goes up in one bright bloom.

el_blotting_sand.name: Blotting Sand
el_blotting_sand.text: Gain 4 Block and 1 Ward. If you stand in rank 1 or 2, gain 3 more Block.

up.text: Gain 5 Block and 1 Ward. If you stand in rank 1 or 2, gain 4 more Block.

el_blotting_sand.flavour: Sand on wet ink. Nothing runs, nothing smears.
el_blotting_sand.note: The Elementalist throws a fistful of blotting sand and the spray of foul course dries mid-air.

el_sigil_on_the_door.name: Warded Door
el_sigil_on_the_door.text: A hero gains 3 Ward. If they stand in rank 1, they gain 2 more.

up.text: A hero gains 4 Ward. If they stand in rank 1, they gain 3 more.

el_sigil_on_the_door.flavour: Paint the ward where the blows land. That is always the door.
el_sigil_on_the_door.note: The Elementalist reaches past the Bulwark and paints a sigil on the church door's oak.

el_draw_the_tide.name: Riptide
el_draw_the_tide.text: Apply 3 Water. Pull the target forward 1.

up.text: Apply 4 Water. Pull the target forward 1.

el_draw_the_tide.flavour: Water runs downhill. So does anything soaked in it.
el_draw_the_tide.note: A rope of deep-blue ink drags a back-rank foe stumbling toward the Bulwark's mace.

el_ink_dart.name: Ink Dart
el_ink_dart.text: Deal 4. Apply 1 of your attuned course. Follow-up: apply 2 more.

up.text: Deal 5. Apply 2 of your attuned course. Follow-up: apply 2 more.

el_ink_dart.flavour: Strike where the last blow landed. The skin is already open.
el_ink_dart.note: A dart of ink follows the Duelist's thrust into the same wound.

el_cross_stroke.name: Dividers
el_cross_stroke.text: Conjoin 1. If the target was moved this round, Conjoin 1 again. Deal 2.

up.text: Conjoin 1. If the target was moved this round, Conjoin 2. Deal 3.

el_cross_stroke.flavour: Ink that has been shaken mixes readier.
el_cross_stroke.note: A foe knocked back by the Bulwark's door staggers, and its two inks flare where they slosh together.

el_open_palm.name: Handprint
el_open_palm.text: Apply 3 Volatile of your attuned course.

up.text: Apply 4 Volatile of your attuned course.

el_open_palm.flavour: Lecturing distance. Close enough to touch the page.
el_open_palm.note: Pulled to the front, the Elementalist slaps an open, stained palm flat against a foe.

el_weigh_the_stacks.name: Plumb
el_weigh_the_stacks.text: Deal 2 for each of your attuned course on the target, up to 20. If this is last in the Ordo, deal 2 more.

up.text: Deal 2 for each of your attuned course on the target, up to 22. If this is last in the Ordo, deal 4 more.

el_weigh_the_stacks.flavour: Measure twice. The scale does the rest.
el_weigh_the_stacks.note: The brass vessel tilts; the foe sags under the weight of its own ink.

el_tip_the_vessel.name: Sluice
el_tip_the_vessel.text: Gain 1 Focus for each vigour left unspent, up to 3. Then Conjoin 2.

up.text: Gain 1 Focus, plus 1 for each vigour left unspent, up to 4. Then Conjoin 2.

el_tip_the_vessel.flavour: All the held breath goes into one stroke.
el_tip_the_vessel.note: The Accumulator stoops and the brass vessel pours its stored light down the arm into a foe.

el_full_measure.name: Full Measure
el_full_measure.text: Deal 3 per X. Apply 2 of your attuned course per X. If X is 4 or more, apply as many again. X counts up to 5.

up.text: Deal 4 per X. Apply 2 of your attuned course per X. If X is 4 or more, apply as many again. X counts up to 5.

el_full_measure.flavour: Fill it to the line. Then fill the line.
el_full_measure.note: From the back rank the Elementalist empties a whole pot of one ink over a single foe.

el_spend_the_breath.name: Vent
el_spend_the_breath.text: Spend all your Focus. Deal 2 for each Focus spent.

up.text: Spend all your Focus. Deal 2, plus 2 for each Focus spent.

el_spend_the_breath.flavour: If the working will not come, the breath behind it still can.
el_spend_the_breath.note: The Elementalist exhales; a gust of raw colour hits a foe like a thrown brick.

el_warding_sigil.name: Talisman
el_warding_sigil.text: A hero gains 2 Block and 1 Ward, plus 2 Ward for each Conjunction so far this round, up to 9 Ward.

up.text: A hero gains 3 Block and 2 Ward, plus 2 Ward for each Conjunction so far this round, up to 10 Ward.

el_warding_sigil.flavour: Every flare lights the sigil brighter.
el_warding_sigil.note: Ward sigils inked on the Catalyst's forearms glow, and the same sigil blooms on the Oracle's brow.

el_reaction_shield.name: Fireguard
el_reaction_shield.text: Gain 4 Block, plus 4 for each Conjunction so far this round, up to 16.

up.text: Gain 5 Block, plus 5 for each Conjunction so far this round, up to 20.

el_reaction_shield.flavour: The heat of the meeting, caught and turned outward.
el_reaction_shield.note: The light of a Conjunction folds around the Catalyst like a cloak.

el_feedback.name: Backlash
el_feedback.text: Deal 4 for each Conjunction so far this round, up to 16. Handoff: deal 3 more.

up.text: Deal 5 for each Conjunction so far this round, up to 20. Handoff: deal 4 more.

el_feedback.flavour: It comes back down the line. Aim it.
el_feedback.note: Lines of light from three flaring foes converge in the Catalyst's palm and leap at a fourth.

el_second_spark.name: Lantern
el_second_spark.text: Costs 1 less if 2 or more heroes are already in the Ordo. Apply 1 Volatile of the next course. Deal 1.

up.text: Retain. Costs 1 less if 2 or more heroes are already in the Ordo. Apply 1 Volatile of the next course. Deal 1.

el_second_spark.flavour: The first spark lit nothing. The second never misses.
el_second_spark.note: A second fleck of a different colour follows the first across the nave.

el_cascade.name: Cascade
el_cascade.text: Conjoin 1. If 3 or more vigour was spent before this card this round, Conjoin 1 again. Deal 2.

up.text: Conjoin 1. If 3 or more vigour was spent before this card this round, Conjoin 1 again. Deal 4.

el_cascade.note: Two flares chase each other across one foe's inked hide.

el_blot_spread.name: Blot Spread
el_blot_spread.text: Copy every course on the target to the foes beside it. Deal 3.

up.text: Copy every course on the target to the foes beside it. Deal 5.

el_blot_spread.flavour: Blot one line and the page beneath drinks it too.
el_blot_spread.note: The ink on one foe bleeds sideways into its neighbours like a blot through vellum.

el_count_the_colours.name: Abacus
el_count_the_colours.text: Deal 1, plus 3 for each course in the target's Spectrum.

up.text: Deal 1, plus 4 for each course in the target's Spectrum.

el_count_the_colours.flavour: One, two, three. The Mother had six. Count on.
el_count_the_colours.note: The Prismatic's clouded eye fixes on a foe painted in four colours; each colour cracks open.

el_prism_ward.name: Prism Ward
el_prism_ward.text: A hero gains 3 Block and 1 Ward for each different course on the foes.

up.text: A hero gains 5 Block and 1 Ward for each different course on the foes.

el_prism_ward.flavour: Every colour on the field is a colour the ward has learned.
el_prism_ward.note: A ward of six thin bands rings the Bulwark like light through a cracked window.

el_wash_of_colour.name: Wash Bowl
el_wash_of_colour.text: Apply 2 of your attuned course to every foe. Attune to the next course and apply 2 of it to every foe.

up.text: Apply 2 of your attuned course to every foe. Attune to the next course and apply 2 of it to every foe.

el_wash_of_colour.flavour: Two washes over the whole page, one wet on the other.
el_wash_of_colour.note: Two broad washes of colour roll down the line of foes, one after the other.

el_fill_the_gaps.name: Infill
el_fill_the_gaps.text: Deal 2, plus 2 for each other hero who acted before this, up to 6. Then, if the target holds 3 or more courses, apply 1 of each course it lacks.

up.text: Deal 4, plus 2 for each other hero who acted before this, up to 8. Then, if the target holds 3 or more courses, apply 1 of each course it lacks.

el_fill_the_gaps.flavour: Where the ring is broken, ink it whole.
el_fill_the_gaps.note: The Prismatic dabs the missing colours onto a foe's hide until a full ring of six shows.

el_read_the_colours.name: Reading Desk
el_read_the_colours.text: Gain 1 Focus for each different course on the foes. Gain 4 Block.

up.text: Gain 1 Focus for each different course on the foes. Gain 6 Block.

el_read_the_colours.flavour: The field is a page. Every colour on it is a word.
el_read_the_colours.note: The Prismatic pauses mid-fight, eyes moving over the painted foes as if reading a line.

el_strip_the_plate.name: Strip the Plate
el_strip_the_plate.text: Apply 1 Fire, then 1 Volatile Frost, plus 1 for each Armor the target has, up to 3.

up.text: Apply 2 Fire, then 1 Volatile Frost, plus 1 for each Armor the target has, up to 4.

el_strip_the_plate.flavour: Hot, then cold. Iron forgets what shape it was.
el_strip_the_plate.note: Vermilion then pale-blue ink: a foe's breastplate cracks and falls before the Duelist's lunge.

el_rime_and_brine.name: Sprinkler
el_rime_and_brine.text: Apply 1 Water, then 2 Volatile Frost. Prime 2.

up.text: Apply 2 Water, then 3 Volatile Frost. Prime 2.

el_rime_and_brine.flavour: Soak it, then still it. Let someone with a blade finish it.
el_rime_and_brine.note: A foe glazed in ice stands frozen mid-step as the Bulwark's mace comes over the door.

el_ground_the_arc.name: Grounding
el_ground_the_arc.text: Apply 1 Volatile Water, plus 1 for each Lightning on the target, up to 4.

up.text: Apply 2 Volatile Water, plus 1 for each Lightning on the target, up to 5.

el_ground_the_arc.flavour: The Duelist leaves the sparks. Water gives them somewhere to go.
el_ground_the_arc.note: Deep-blue ink splashes a foe still crackling from the Duelist's cuts, and the spark runs everywhere.

el_cold_for_the_void.name: Ice Phial
el_cold_for_the_void.text: Apply 1 Volatile Frost, plus 1 for each Void on the target, up to 4.

up.text: Apply 2 Volatile Frost, plus 1 for each Void on the target, up to 5.

el_cold_for_the_void.flavour: The Augur opens the hole. Frost is what falls into it.
el_cold_for_the_void.note: Pale-blue ink meets the violet-black the Oracle laid, and a foe goes still as a carving.

el_deep_cold.name: Freeze
el_deep_cold.text: Turn all Water on the target into Frost. Gain 3 Block. Dosed: gain 4 more.

up.text: Turn all Water on the target into Frost. Gain 5 Block. Dosed: gain 4 more.

el_deep_cold.flavour: Brine does not freeze easily. Ask it nicely, in the right ink.
el_deep_cold.note: The Transmuter's brine on a foe turns to rime under the Elementalist's touch.

el_brass_gauge.name: Brass Gauge
el_brass_gauge.text: Gain 2 Focus. Bank 2. Rite: at the start of each round, gain 1 Focus, then Block equal to your Focus, up to 8. Exhaust.

up.text: Gain 4 Focus. Bank 2. Rite: at the start of each round, gain 1 Focus, then Block equal to your Focus, up to 8. Exhaust.

el_brass_gauge.flavour: The needle on the brass climbs. So does the wall around the one who carries it.
el_brass_gauge.note: A brass gauge on the Accumulator's vessel ticks upward; a faint shell of light thickens round them.

el_weight_and_measure.name: Assay
el_weight_and_measure.text: Deal 2, plus 4 for each stack of the target's largest course, up to 42.

up.text: Deal 4, plus 5 for each stack of the target's largest course, up to 54.

el_weight_and_measure.flavour: It does not matter whose ink it was. It all weighs the same.
el_weight_and_measure.note: A foe drenched in the Alchemist's fire buckles as the Elementalist closes a stained fist.

el_stored_breath.name: Stored Breath
el_stored_breath.text: Retain. Gain 2 Focus, plus 2 for each vigour left unspent, up to 6. Then double your Focus. Exhaust.

up.text: Retain. Gain 4 Focus, plus 2 for each vigour left unspent, up to 8. Then double your Focus. Exhaust.

el_stored_breath.flavour: The brass holds more than the lungs ever could.
el_stored_breath.note: The Accumulator breathes into the brass vessel and its seams glow white.

el_chain_of_ink.name: Flint
el_chain_of_ink.text: Apply 2 of your attuned course to every foe, then 1 Volatile of the next course to every foe, or 2 on a Handoff.

up.text: Apply 3 of your attuned course to every foe, then 1 Volatile of the next course to every foe, or 2 on a Handoff.

el_chain_of_ink.flavour: Write the same two words down the whole line, and read it aloud.
el_chain_of_ink.note: Down the whole line of foes, two colours cross and flare one after another like lit wicks.

el_spark_shower.name: Coal Pan
el_spark_shower.text: Retain. Echo. Costs 1 less if another hero is already in the Ordo. Apply 1 Volatile of your attuned course.

up.text: Retain. Echo. Costs 1 less if another hero is already in the Ordo. Apply 2 Volatile of your attuned course.

el_spark_shower.flavour: Nervous fingers, quick sigils, sparks everywhere.
el_spark_shower.note: The Catalyst's fingers twitch and a shower of tiny sparks patters across a foe.

el_afterglow.name: Afterglow
el_afterglow.text: Next round, draw 1 more for each Conjunction so far this round, up to 3. If there were 2 or more, gain 1 vigour next round.

up.text: Next round, draw 1 more for each Conjunction so far this round, up to 4. If there were 2 or more, gain 1 vigour next round.

el_afterglow.flavour: The light fades slowly. Work by it while it lasts.
el_afterglow.note: The company's faces are lit from below by the glow of three foes still smouldering.

el_full_ring.name: Every Colour
el_full_ring.text: Deal 5. Apply 1 of each course the target lacks, or 2 of each if this is first in the Ordo. Exhaust.

up.text: Deal 8. Apply 1 of each course the target lacks, or 2 of each if this is first in the Ordo. Exhaust.

el_full_ring.flavour: All six at once. The abbey forbade it. The abbey is not here.
el_full_ring.note: The Prismatic presses all six stained fingers to a foe; a ring of six colours sears into it.

el_strike_the_ring.name: Chime
el_strike_the_ring.text: Deal 2 for each course in the target's Spectrum. If this is last in the Ordo, deal 1 more for each. Then apply 1 Volatile of your attuned course.

up.text: Deal 3 for each course in the target's Spectrum. If this is last in the Ordo, deal 1 more for each. Then apply 1 Volatile of your attuned course.

el_strike_the_ring.flavour: Paint the whole ring, then strike it like a bell.
el_strike_the_ring.note: A foe painted in five colours rings like struck bronze as the Prismatic's stroke lands.

el_bright_margin.name: Bright Margin
el_bright_margin.text: Deal 3. If the target holds 4 or more courses, gain 1 vigour next round.

up.text: Deal 5. If the target holds 4 or more courses, gain 1 vigour next round.

el_bright_margin.flavour: Brother Lucan illuminates the margins. This scholar illuminates foes.
el_bright_margin.note: A foe outlined in four bright inks glows like an illuminated capital on the page.

el_conflux.name: Conflux
el_conflux.text: Remove every course from the target. Deal 3 for each stack removed, up to 30. If any vigour was carried into this round, deal 1 more for each, up to 10 more.

up.text: Remove every course from the target. Deal 2, plus 3 for each stack removed, up to 30. If any vigour was carried into this round, deal 1 more for each, up to 10 more.

el_conflux.flavour: Every ink on the page, drawn back into the pen at once.
el_conflux.note: Every colour on a foe streams back into the Elementalist's raised hand, and the foe crumples.

el_draw_the_ink_out.name: Siphon
el_draw_the_ink_out.text: Move every ailment from the hero who has the most onto the target. Conjoin 1. Deal 3.

up.text: Move every ailment from the hero who has the most onto the target. Conjoin 2. Deal 3.

el_draw_the_ink_out.flavour: A course on a friend is a wound. On a foe, it is a sentence half written.
el_draw_the_ink_out.note: The Elementalist pulls a thread of brine out of the Duelist's lungs and lashes a foe with it.

el_shared_pot.name: Shared Pot
el_shared_pot.text: Every hero gains 1 Focus. Dosed: every hero gains 2 more.

up.text: Every hero gains 2 Focus. Dosed: every hero gains 2 more.

el_shared_pot.flavour: One pot of ink, every pen in the company dipped in it.
el_shared_pot.note: The company crowd round the Elementalist's open ink pot as the Alchemist uncorks a flask.

el_brass_bands.name: Astrolabe
el_brass_bands.text: Raise your Conjunction cap by 4 for this fight. Gain 3 Focus, plus 2 for each vigour left unspent, up to 7. Exhaust.

up.text: Raise your Conjunction cap by 4 for this fight. Gain 5 Focus, plus 2 for each vigour left unspent, up to 9. Exhaust.

el_brass_bands.flavour: Band the vessel in brass and it will hold what would split clay.
el_brass_bands.note: The Accumulator hammers a new brass band round the vessel on its back.

el_pressure.name: Pressure
el_pressure.text: Double the target's largest course. Gain 3 Block, plus 2 for each vigour left unspent, up to 7. Exhaust.

up.text: Double the target's largest course. Gain 5 Block, plus 2 for each vigour left unspent, up to 9. Exhaust.

el_pressure.flavour: Squeeze the jar and the ink climbs the neck.
el_pressure.note: The Accumulator clenches a stained fist and a foe's ink swells darker, thicker.

el_heavy_pour.name: Deluge
el_heavy_pour.text: Apply 4 Volatile of the next course. Deal 4, plus 2 for each vigour carried into this round, up to 8.

up.text: Apply 4 Volatile of the next course. Deal 4, plus 2 for each vigour carried into this round, up to 8.

el_heavy_pour.flavour: The great working is one gesture. Everything before it was the ink.
el_heavy_pour.note: Bent double, the Accumulator upends the brass vessel and a torrent of colour drowns one foe.

el_under_the_weight.name: Ballast
el_under_the_weight.text: Gain 2 Focus, then 4 Block plus 1 for each Focus you hold, up to 12. If a foe means to strike you, gain 3 more Block.

up.text: Gain 3 Focus, then 5 Block plus 1 for each Focus you hold, up to 14. If a foe means to strike you, gain 3 more Block.

el_under_the_weight.flavour: Bent under the brass. Nothing gets past that much weight.
el_under_the_weight.note: The Accumulator kneels behind the brass vessel and blows glance off its curve.

el_brim_over.name: Font
el_brim_over.text: Apply 2 of your attuned course. Copy up to 2 of each course on the target to the foes beside it.

up.text: Apply 3 of your attuned course. Copy up to 3 of each course on the target to the foes beside it.

el_brim_over.flavour: A full jar spills. Let it spill where you meant.
el_brim_over.note: Ink overflows one drenched foe and runs down onto the two beside it.

el_weight_of_the_vessel.name: Heft
el_weight_of_the_vessel.text: Deal 3, plus 2 for each Focus you hold, up to 13. Deal 1 more for each vigour left unspent, up to 3. Your Focus is not spent.

up.text: Deal 5, plus 2 for each Focus you hold, up to 15. Deal 1 more for each vigour left unspent, up to 3. Your Focus is not spent.

el_weight_of_the_vessel.flavour: It need not be poured. Swung is enough.
el_weight_of_the_vessel.note: The Accumulator swings round and the brass vessel on its back strikes a foe full in the chest.

el_hair_trigger.name: Hair Trigger
el_hair_trigger.text: Costs 1 less if 3 or more cards are already in the Ordo. Conjoin 1. Deal 1.

up.text: Retain. Costs 1 less if 3 or more cards are already in the Ordo. Conjoin 1. Deal 1.

el_hair_trigger.flavour: It wanted to go off. It only needed asking.
el_hair_trigger.note: The Catalyst barely flicks a finger and the ink on a foe goes up.

el_sigils_on_the_skin.name: Wax Tablet
el_sigils_on_the_skin.text: Every hero gains 1 Ward for each Conjunction so far this round, up to 4. Gain 3 Block.

up.text: Every hero gains 1 Ward for each Conjunction so far this round, up to 4. Gain 5 Block.

el_sigils_on_the_skin.flavour: Ink the ward on the skin and every flare feeds it.
el_sigils_on_the_skin.note: The sigils on the Catalyst's face and forearms burn bright and copy themselves onto the company.

el_backdraft.name: Backdraft
el_backdraft.text: Deal 3 to every foe, plus 3 for each Conjunction so far this round, up to 15. If this is last in the Ordo, deal 2 more to every foe.

up.text: Deal 3 to every foe, plus 3 for each Conjunction so far this round, up to 15. If this is last in the Ordo, deal 2 more to every foe.

el_backdraft.flavour: Every fire breathes in before it roars.
el_backdraft.note: The air in the vault sucks inward, then the whole line of foes is thrown back in a wall of light.

el_nervous_hands.name: Guttering Candles
el_nervous_hands.text: If there has been a Conjunction this round, draw 1 more next round.

up.text: If there has been a Conjunction this round, draw 2 more next round.

el_nervous_hands.flavour: The hands never stop. Neither do the pages.
el_nervous_hands.note: The Catalyst riffles through the satchel of scrolls with shaking, ink-wet fingers.

el_double_flick.name: Firesteel
el_double_flick.text: If there has already been a Conjunction this round, gain 1 Thrift. Apply 1 Volatile of your attuned course, then 1 Volatile of the next course.

up.text: If there has already been a Conjunction this round, gain 1 Thrift. Apply 2 Volatile of your attuned course, then 1 Volatile of the next course.

el_double_flick.flavour: Left hand, right hand. Two sparks before the foe can blink.
el_double_flick.note: Both the Catalyst's hands flick at once and two coloured sparks cross in the air.

el_steady_nerves.name: Steady Nerves
el_steady_nerves.text: Shed 4 stress, plus 4 for each Conjunction so far this round. Gain 3 Block.

up.text: Shed 5 stress, plus 5 for each Conjunction so far this round. Gain 4 Block.

el_steady_nerves.flavour: Every flare is a breath let out.
el_steady_nerves.note: Amid the smoke the Catalyst's shaking hands go still for a moment.

el_prism_lance.name: Prism Lance
el_prism_lance.text: Deal 1, plus 2 for each different course on the foes. If another hero acted before this, deal 2 more.

up.text: Deal 3, plus 2 for each different course on the foes. If another hero acted before this, deal 2 more.

el_prism_lance.flavour: White light, split six ways, gathered back to a point.
el_prism_lance.note: Six thin rays leave the Prismatic's hood halo and meet on one foe.

el_ring_turn.name: Corona
el_ring_turn.text: Deal 4. Gain 1 Focus for each course in the target's Spectrum. Attune to the next course.

up.text: Deal 6. Gain 1 Focus for each course in the target's Spectrum. Attune to the next course.

el_ring_turn.flavour: Every colour a foe wears is a lesson. Read it, then turn the page.
el_ring_turn.note: The Prismatic strikes a painted foe and the hood's sigil halo brightens one band per colour.

el_six_inks.name: Stained Fingers
el_six_inks.text: Four times: apply 1 of your attuned course, then Attune to the next course. If this is first in the Ordo, gain 2 Focus.

up.text: Five times: apply 1 of your attuned course, then Attune to the next course. If this is first in the Ordo, gain 2 Focus.

el_six_inks.flavour: Finger by finger, round the hand.
el_six_inks.note: The Prismatic drags all four fingers down a foe, each leaving a different colour.

el_glass_halo.name: Hand Mirror
el_glass_halo.text: Every hero gains 1 Ward for each different course on the foes.

up.text: Every hero gains 1 Ward for each different course on the foes.

el_glass_halo.flavour: She held all six in one body. A halo is a smaller thing to hold.
el_glass_halo.note: The six sigils embroidered on the Prismatic's hood light up and ring every hero.

el_every_colour.name: Polychrome
el_every_colour.text: Every foe takes 3 for each course in its Spectrum. If another hero acted before this, each takes 1 more for each course.

up.text: Every foe takes 4 for each course in its Spectrum. If another hero acted before this, each takes 1 more for each course.

el_every_colour.flavour: Each colour a foe wears is a colour it can burn in.
el_every_colour.note: Across the line, every painted foe flares in all the colours it carries.

el_clouded_sight.name: Glass Globe
el_clouded_sight.text: Gain 1 Focus for each different course on the foes. Next round, draw 1 more.

up.text: Gain 1 Focus for each different course on the foes, plus 1. Next round, draw 1 more.

el_clouded_sight.flavour: The clouded eye sees the colours better than the clear one.
el_clouded_sight.note: The Prismatic closes the clear eye; the white one looks over a field painted in courses.

el_brass_reservoir.name: The Brass Reservoir
el_brass_reservoir.text: Gain 2 Focus for each vigour carried into this round. Apply 3 Volatile of the next course. Its Conjunctions have no cap. Exhaust.

up.text: Gain 3 Focus, plus 2 for each vigour carried into this round. Apply 3 Volatile of the next course. Its Conjunctions have no cap. Exhaust.

el_brass_reservoir.flavour: Years of held breath in one brass vessel, opened once.
el_brass_reservoir.note: The Accumulator unseals the brass vessel and a column of colour swallows the ruler.

el_perpetual_working.name: Perpetual Working
el_perpetual_working.text: Gain 2 Focus. Rite: twice a round, when the company sets off a Conjunction on a foe, apply 3 of your attuned course to it. Exhaust.

up.text: Gain 2 Focus. Rite: twice a round, when the company sets off a Conjunction on a foe, apply 3 of your attuned course to it, then gain 1 Focus. Exhaust.

el_perpetual_working.flavour: The working that consumes itself and is whole again by morning.
el_perpetual_working.note: A foe's spent ink seeps back into its skin as fast as the Conjunctions burn it off.

el_chain_of_sigils.name: Wildfire
el_chain_of_sigils.text: Apply 1 Volatile of your attuned course, or 2 on a Handoff. Rite: three times a round, when the company sets off a Conjunction on a foe, apply 1 Volatile of your attuned course to the foes beside it. Exhaust.

up.text: Apply 1 Volatile of your attuned course, or 2 on a Handoff. Rite: three times a round, when the company sets off a Conjunction on a foe, deal 2 to it and apply 1 Volatile of your attuned course to the foes beside it. Exhaust.

el_chain_of_sigils.flavour: One sigil drawn, the next draws itself, and the next.
el_chain_of_sigils.note: A flare on one foe leaps sigil to sigil down the whole line like a lit fuse.

el_quickened_hand.name: Quickening
el_quickened_hand.text: Gain 1 Focus. Rite: the first two times each round the company sets off a Conjunction, gain 1 Thrift. Exhaust.

up.text: Gain 1 Focus. Rite: the first two times each round the company sets off a Conjunction, gain 1 Thrift and draw 1 more next round. Exhaust.

el_quickened_hand.flavour: Faster than the eye. Faster than the chapter can object.
el_quickened_hand.note: The Catalyst's hands blur; cards and sigils leave them faster than the flares can follow.

el_sixfold_ring.name: The Sixfold Ring
el_sixfold_ring.text: Apply 1 of each course the target lacks, then Conjoin 3, or 5 if this is last in the Ordo. Exhaust.

up.text: Deal 3 for each course in the target's Spectrum. Apply 1 of each course the target lacks, then Conjoin 3, or 5 if this is last in the Ordo. Exhaust.

el_sixfold_ring.flavour: She held all six apart. Let them meet, and see what she was holding back.
el_sixfold_ring.note: All six colours on one foe meet at once and the Prismatic's clouded eye reflects a white star.

el_clouded_eye_saw.name: Clouded Eye
el_clouded_eye_saw.text: Every hero gains 1 Ward. Rite: at the end of each round, if the foes hold 4 or more different courses between them, every foe takes 2 for each. Exhaust.

up.text: Every hero gains 1 Ward. Rite: at the end of each round, if the foes hold 4 or more different courses between them, every foe takes 2 for each and every hero gains 1 Ward. Exhaust.

el_clouded_eye_saw.flavour: The eye went white at the gate. It has seen every colour since.
el_clouded_eye_saw.note: The Prismatic stands with the white eye open, and every painted foe cracks along its colours.

pass_it_on.name: Transference
pass_it_on.text: Move the largest ailment (every stack of it) off the other hero carrying the most onto the target. A course arrives as Stable stacks. Handoff: apply 1 Hex.

up.text: Move the largest ailment (every stack of it) off the other hero carrying the most onto the target. A course arrives as Stable stacks. Handoff: apply 2 Hex.

pass_it_on.flavour: Say the rhyme, tie the knot, and the fever is someone else's.
pass_it_on.note: The Hexweaver draws a sick hero's rot into a cloth poppet and flings it at a foe.

bloodletting.name: Bloodletting
bloodletting.text: Lose 1 HP. Apply 3 Hex. Shed 2 stress.

up.text: Lose 1 HP. Apply 4 Hex. Shed 2 stress.

bloodletting.flavour: The cut is always fresh. The bandage is never clean.
bloodletting.note: The Pactbound draws the bone knife along the bandaged forearm over a poppet.

ring_the_bell.name: Clapper
ring_the_bell.text: Every foe with Hex gains 2 Doom.

up.text: Every foe with Hex gains 3 Doom.

ring_the_bell.flavour: One stroke for each of you. Count them.
ring_the_bell.note: The Doomsayer rings the handbell once, and every hexed foe looks up.

glint.name: Glint
glint.text: A hero gains 2 Ward and 1 Thorns.

up.text: A hero gains 2 Ward and 2 Thorns.
