glint.flavour: Look into the glass. It looks back harder.
glint.note: The Mirrorhex tilts the cracked hand mirror and a hero's outline glints in it.

pin_the_poppet.name: Pin the Poppet

up.text: Deal 5. Apply 2 Hex.

pin_the_poppet.flavour: Straw takes the shape you tell it. Then it takes the pin.
pin_the_poppet.note: The Hexweaver crouches and drives a long pin through a straw poppet's chest.

knotted_cord.name: Knotted Cord
knotted_cord.text: A hero gains 5 Block and 1 Ward.

up.text: A hero gains 6 Block and 2 Ward.

knotted_cord.flavour: Seven knots, and nothing gets through the seventh.
knotted_cord.note: The Hexweaver ties a knotted cord round a hero's wrist and bites it tight.

evil_eye.name: Evil Eye

up.text: Apply 5 Hex.

evil_eye.flavour: A look is cheap. This one will cost it.
evil_eye.note: Sharp watchful eyes under the ragged hood fix on a foe.

graveyard_dirt.name: Graveyard Dirt

up.text: Apply 4 Toxin and 1 Void.

graveyard_dirt.flavour: Taken from a fresh grave at midnight. It remembers.
graveyard_dirt.note: The Hexweaver flings a fistful of graveyard dirt from the belt pouch.

blood_price.name: Pricked Thumb

up.text: Lose 1 HP. Apply 1 Hex. Prime 4.

blood_price.flavour: A drop for the poppet, and the next blow lands true.
blood_price.note: The Hexweaver pricks a thumb and smears blood on a poppet's face.

twist_the_pin.name: Wax Heart
twist_the_pin.text: Spend the target's Hex. Deal 4, plus 2 per Hex spent.

up.text: Spend the target's Hex. Deal 4, plus 3 per Hex spent.

twist_the_pin.flavour: Every knot you tied, I pull at once.
twist_the_pin.note: The Hexweaver twists a pin already deep in a poppet; the foe doubles over.

whispered_name.name: Whispered Name
whispered_name.text: Apply 2 Hex, plus 2 per vigour left unspent this round, at most 6. Shed 3 stress.

up.text: Apply 3 Hex, plus 2 per vigour left unspent this round, at most 7. Shed 4 stress.

whispered_name.flavour: Everything has a name. Say it into the straw.
whispered_name.note: The Hexweaver whispers into a poppet's ear, eyes on the foe.

rotting_word.name: Rotting Word

up.text: Deal 3. Apply 5 Toxin.

rotting_word.flavour: Touch it once. Let the fen do the rest.
rotting_word.note: A knotted, dirt-black hand presses to a foe's flank and the skin greens.

sour_milk.name: Sour Milk
sour_milk.text: Apply 3 Toxin to the target and 2 to each foe beside it.

up.text: Apply 4 Toxin to the target and 3 to each foe beside it.

sour_milk.flavour: The cow went dry, the well went bad, and then it was their turn.
sour_milk.note: The Hexweaver spills a clay jug of curdled milk across the foes' line.

hags_finger.name: Hag's Finger
hags_finger.text: Pull the target 1 rank forward. Apply 2 Hex, and 2 more if it now stands in rank 1.

up.text: Pull the target 1 rank forward. Apply 3 Hex, and 3 more if it now stands in rank 1.

hags_finger.note: A crooked finger beckons; a foe stumbles forward out of its rank.

salt_the_threshold.name: Salted Threshold
salt_the_threshold.text: Every hero gains 1 Ward and sheds 1 stress.

up.text: Every hero gains 1 Ward and sheds 2 stress.

salt_the_threshold.flavour: Nothing crosses a salt line without asking first.
salt_the_threshold.note: The Hexweaver pours a line of salt across the floor in front of the company.

tithe_of_blood.name: Cut Palm

up.text: Lose 1 HP. Gain 1 Might. Exhaust.

tithe_of_blood.flavour: The poppets drink first. Then they work.
tithe_of_blood.note: The Pactbound lets blood run down the bone knife onto the poppets at the belt.

spite.name: Spite
spite.text: Deal 3, plus 1 per ailment you carry.

up.text: Deal 5, plus 1 per ailment you carry.

spite.flavour: Every sore on me is a pin in you.
spite.note: The Hexweaver, blistered and green at the lips, spits at a foe.

drain.name: Drain
drain.text: Deal 4. Heal half the damage dealt. Dosed: heal 3 more.

up.text: Deal 6. Heal half the damage dealt. Dosed: heal 3 more.

drain.flavour: What runs out of it runs into me.
drain.note: A thread of dark red runs from a foe's wound into the Hexweaver's cupped hands.

blood_offering.name: Blood Offering
blood_offering.text: Lose 3 HP, or only 1 if Dosed. Next round, +1 vigour. Exhaust.

up.text: Lose 2 HP, or only 1 if Dosed. Next round, +1 vigour. Exhaust.

blood_offering.flavour: Paid in advance. The debt is never small.
blood_offering.note: The Pactbound holds a bleeding palm over a black tallow candle until it flares.

take_the_rot.name: Drawing Salve
take_the_rot.text: Move every ailment off the other hero carrying the most onto yourself. Apply 3 Hex.

up.text: Move every ailment off the other hero carrying the most onto yourself. Apply 4 Hex.

take_the_rot.flavour: Give it here. I have carried worse.
take_the_rot.note: The Hexweaver lays a palm on a sick hero's chest and the green creeps up their own arm.

martyrs_pin.name: Red Hand
martyrs_pin.text: Lose 2 HP. Apply 4 Hex, plus 1 per HP lost.

up.text: Lose 2 HP. Apply 6 Hex, plus 1 per HP lost.

martyrs_pin.flavour: Pins go in deeper when they are wet.
martyrs_pin.note: The Pactbound pushes a pin through their own palm and into the poppet beneath.

handbell.name: Handbell

up.text: Apply 3 Hex to every foe.

handbell.flavour: It rings for all of you.
handbell.note: The Doomsayer swings the handbell high; the foes' line flinches as one.

bad_tidings.name: Bad Tidings
bad_tidings.text: Apply 3 Doom, and 3 more if the target is Marked.

up.text: Apply 4 Doom, and 4 more if the target is Marked.

bad_tidings.flavour: I don't make it happen. I only say it first.
bad_tidings.note: The Doomsayer points the bell staff at a marked foe and speaks its end.

corpse_candle.name: Corpse Candle
corpse_candle.text: Apply 2 Doom and 2 Toxin. If the company has set off a Conjunction this round, apply 2 more Doom.

up.text: Apply 3 Doom and 2 Toxin. If the company has set off a Conjunction this round, apply 3 more Doom.

corpse_candle.flavour: The little light walks the road the coffin will take.
corpse_candle.note: A black tallow candle drifts from the shoulder plate and hangs over a foe.

knell.name: Bell-Cote
knell.text: Every foe gains 1 Doom per 2 Hex on it.

up.text: Apply 1 Hex to every foe. Then every foe gains 1 Doom per 2 Hex on it.

knell.flavour: Slow strokes. One for every year it has left.
knell.note: The iron bell on the Doomsayer's staff tolls; hexed foes stagger at each stroke.

dirge.name: Dirge
dirge.text: Deal 2 to every foe, and 1 more to each foe with Hex.

up.text: Deal 3 to every foe, and 1 more to each foe with Hex.

dirge.flavour: We sing it now so no one has to later.
dirge.note: The Hexweaver hums low over a ring of candles; the foes' line sags.

hasten_the_end.name: Coffin Nail
hasten_the_end.text: Deal 3, plus 1 per 2 Doom on the target.

up.text: Deal 5, plus 1 per 2 Doom on the target.

hasten_the_end.flavour: It was always going to happen. Why wait?
hasten_the_end.note: The Doomsayer brings the bell staff down on a doomed foe's head.

mirror_shard.name: Mirror Shard
mirror_shard.text: A hero gains 2 Thorns and 1 Ward. If it has Taunt, it gains 2 more Thorns.

up.text: A hero gains 3 Thorns and 1 Ward. If it has Taunt, it gains 3 more Thorns.

mirror_shard.flavour: Hit it and the glass bites back.
mirror_shard.note: The Mirrorhex stitches a shard of mirror onto the Bulwark's door-shield.

silver_lie.name: Silver Lie
silver_lie.text: Take the target's Block. Apply 2 Hex.

up.text: Take the target's Block. Apply 3 Hex.

silver_lie.flavour: Silver backs every mirror. It tells you you're safe.
silver_lie.note: The Mirrorhex holds up the cracked glass and a foe's guard slides into it.

cracked_glass.name: Fracture
cracked_glass.text: Deal 4, plus 1 per Might on the target.

up.text: Deal 4, plus 2 per Might on the target.

cracked_glass.flavour: The stronger it stands, the more glass it sees.
cracked_glass.note: A foe flexes before the cracked mirror and the crack runs through its arm.

mirror_mirror.name: Looking Glass
mirror_mirror.text: If the target attacks this round, its attack strikes a foe beside it instead. Apply 1 Hex.

up.text: If the target attacks this round, its attack strikes a foe beside it instead. Apply 3 Hex.

mirror_mirror.flavour: Strike, then. Your friend has the face you hate.
mirror_mirror.note: The Mirrorhex flashes the glass and a foe's blow lands on its neighbour.

echoing_hex.name: Echoing Hex

up.text: Echo. Apply 3 Hex. Gain 1 Ward.

echoing_hex.flavour: Say it once to the foe, once to the glass.
echoing_hex.note: A curse spoken into the mirror comes back out of it, twice as loud.

hand_it_back.name: Hand of Glory
hand_it_back.text: Move every ailment off the other hero carrying the most onto the target. Apply 2 Hex.

up.text: Move every ailment off the other hero carrying the most onto the target. Apply 3 Hex.

hand_it_back.note: The Mirrorhex wipes a hero's sores onto the glass and turns it toward a foe.

bind_the_fear.name: Horseshoe
bind_the_fear.text: Unbind: take one affliction card out of the company's decks for this fight. The target suffers its when-drawn effect and gains 3 Hex. Every hero sheds 3 stress.

up.text: Unbind: take one affliction card out of the company's decks for this fight. The target suffers its when-drawn effect and gains 4 Hex. Every hero sheds 4 stress.

bind_the_fear.flavour: Tell the poppet what you dream of. It will dream it for you now.
bind_the_fear.note: The Hexweaver binds a hero's nightmare into a cloth poppet with black cord.

twofold_curse.name: Twofold Curse
twofold_curse.text: Apply 2 Hex. Then the target gains Hex equal to its Hex, at most 5.

up.text: Apply 3 Hex. Then the target gains Hex equal to its Hex, at most 6.

twofold_curse.flavour: Tie the knot. Tie it again. Now it is two knots.
twofold_curse.note: The Hexweaver loops a second cord over the first round a poppet's neck.

contagion.name: Contagion
contagion.text: Apply 1 Hex. Each foe beside the target gains Hex equal to the target's Hex.

up.text: Apply 2 Hex. Each foe beside the target gains Hex equal to the target's Hex.

contagion.flavour: Curses are like coughs. They want company.
contagion.note: Black threads run from one hexed foe to the foes on either side.

hedge_charm.name: Hag Stone
hedge_charm.text: Spend the target's Hex. The hero lowest on health gains 1 Block, plus 2 per Hex spent.

up.text: Spend the target's Hex. The hero lowest on health gains 4 Block, plus 2 per Hex spent.

hedge_charm.flavour: Unpick the curse, and knit the thread into a coat.
hedge_charm.note: The Hexweaver pulls a black thread out of a foe and winds it round a wounded hero.

blight_bloom.name: Blight Bloom
blight_bloom.text: Apply 2 Toxin, then 1 Volatile Void, plus 1 per Conjunction set off this round.

up.text: Apply 3 Toxin, then 2 Volatile Void, plus 1 per Conjunction set off this round.

blight_bloom.flavour: Rot and nothing, together. Nothing grows back.
blight_bloom.note: A black flower opens on a foe's chest where the Hexweaver touched it.

rot_from_within.name: Canker
rot_from_within.text: Deal 6, plus 2 per Toxin on the target, and 4 more if Dosed.

up.text: Deal 8, plus 2 per Toxin on the target, and 4 more if Dosed.

rot_from_within.flavour: It was already rotten. I only told it so.
rot_from_within.note: A Toxin-green foe splits along the seams as the Hexweaver closes a fist.

weeping_sores.name: Weeping Sores
weeping_sores.text: Apply 2 Toxin, plus 1 per Bleed on the target.

up.text: Apply 3 Toxin, plus 1 per Bleed on the target.

weeping_sores.flavour: An open cut is an open door.
weeping_sores.note: The Hexweaver rubs graveyard dirt into a foe's bleeding wound.

witchs_ladder.name: Witch's Ladder
witchs_ladder.text: Apply 1 Hex, plus 2 per different course on the target.

up.text: Apply 2 Hex, plus 2 per different course on the target.

witchs_ladder.flavour: A feather knotted in for every ill. Count them as you tie.
witchs_ladder.note: The Hexweaver knots a cord of coloured feathers, one for each course on a foe.

blood_moon.name: Blood Moon
blood_moon.text: Costs 1 less once you carry 10 Scars. Deal 5, plus 1 per 2 HP you are missing.

up.text: Costs 1 less once you carry 10 Scars. Deal 7, plus 1 per 2 HP you are missing.

blood_moon.flavour: The thinner I bleed, the sharper the knife.
blood_moon.note: The Pactbound, pale and swaying, lunges with the bone knife under a red light.

spill_the_rot.name: Unburden
spill_the_rot.text: Move every ailment you carry onto the target. Deal 2, plus 2 per ailment moved.

up.text: Move every ailment you carry onto the target. Deal 4, plus 2 per ailment moved.

spill_the_rot.flavour: I held it all for you. Here.
spill_the_rot.note: The Hexweaver vomits a black cloud of rot over a foe and straightens up.

blood_on_the_poppets.name: Poppet
blood_on_the_poppets.text: Lose 3 HP. Apply 2 Hex to every foe, and 2 more to each foe that bleeds.

up.text: Lose 3 HP. Apply 3 Hex to every foe, and 2 more to each foe that bleeds.

blood_on_the_poppets.flavour: One for each of them. They all get a taste.
blood_on_the_poppets.note: The Pactbound draws the knife and flicks blood across every poppet on the belt.

old_wounds.name: Old Wounds
old_wounds.text: Prime 2, plus 1 per 2 Scars you carry.

up.text: Prime 4, plus 1 per 2 Scars you carry.

old_wounds.flavour: Every scar points somewhere. Follow them.
old_wounds.note: The Pactbound unwinds the forearm bandage; the old cuts glow like a map.

take_their_wounds.name: Proxy
take_their_wounds.text: Guard another hero this round. Next round, a Cut Palm is added to their hand. Exhaust.

up.text: Guard another hero this round. Gain 3 Block. Next round, a Cut Palm is added to their hand. Exhaust.

take_their_wounds.flavour: Hit me instead. I know what to do with it.
take_their_wounds.note: The Hexweaver steps in front of a fallen hero, arms wide, poppets swinging.

toll_the_hour.name: Curfew
toll_the_hour.text: Deal 3. Execute 3 times this card's place in the Ordo, at most 15.

up.text: Deal 4. Execute 4 times this card's place in the Ordo, at most 20.

toll_the_hour.flavour: The bell does not ask whose hour it is.
toll_the_hour.note: The Doomsayer strikes the staff's iron bell beside a staggering foe.

passing_bell.name: Passing Bell
passing_bell.text: Apply 2 Doom and 1 Hex to every foe, and 2 more Doom to each foe that was Delayed this round.

up.text: Apply 3 Doom and 1 Hex to every foe, and 2 more Doom to each foe that was Delayed this round.

passing_bell.flavour: Rung for the dying, so the living know to pray.
passing_bell.note: The Doomsayer rings the handbell slowly, walking along the foes' line.

lych_gate.name: Lych Gate
lych_gate.text: Spend the target's Hex. Deal 3. It gains 2 Doom per Hex spent.

up.text: Spend the target's Hex. Deal 5. It gains 2 Doom per Hex spent, plus 2.

lych_gate.flavour: Here the coffin waits, and here the curse turns to a promise.
lych_gate.note: A hexed foe stands under a roofed churchyard gate as its curse turns to Doom.

borrowed_strength.name: Borrowed Strength
borrowed_strength.text: If the target has Might, the hero lowest on health gains 1 Might. The target loses all its Might. Apply 2 Hex.

up.text: If the target has Might, the hero lowest on health gains 2 Might. The target loses all its Might. Apply 2 Hex.

borrowed_strength.flavour: You won't miss it. You won't be using it.
borrowed_strength.note: The Mirrorhex catches a foe's strength in the glass and pours it into a hero.

turn_the_glass.name: Glamour
turn_the_glass.text: If the target attacks this round, its attack strikes a foe beside it instead. If the target has Hex, it is Vulnerable this round.

up.text: If the target attacks this round, its attack strikes a foe beside it instead. If the target has Hex, it is Vulnerable for 2 rounds.

turn_the_glass.flavour: Show it its own face. Watch it flinch.
turn_the_glass.note: The Mirrorhex turns the glass on a hexed foe, which recoils from its reflection.

glass_splinters.name: Glass Splinters
glass_splinters.text: Deal 2 per Thorns you have, and 2 more on a Handoff.

up.text: Deal 2, plus 2 per Thorns you have, and 2 more on a Handoff.

glass_splinters.flavour: Every shard stitched in the hood has a twin.
glass_splinters.note: The Mirrorhex shakes the hood and the mirror shards fly loose at a foe.

backed_with_silver.name: Silvered Shield
backed_with_silver.text: A hero gains 3 Block and 2 Thorns, then 1 more Thorns per 4 Block they have, at most 3.

up.text: A hero gains 4 Block and 3 Thorns, then 1 more Thorns per 4 Block they have, at most 3.

backed_with_silver.flavour: A mirror is only glass until you back it.
backed_with_silver.note: The Mirrorhex presses a silvered shard to a hero's breastplate.

pact_of_bones.name: Crow Skull
pact_of_bones.text: Lose 9 HP. Next round, +2 vigour. Exhaust.

up.text: Lose 7 HP. Next round, +2 vigour. Exhaust.

pact_of_bones.flavour: Sign with the long bone. They always ask for the long bone.
pact_of_bones.note: The Pactbound scratches a mark on a bone with their own blood and snaps it.

drink_deep.name: Drink Deep
drink_deep.text: Remove all Toxin from the target. Deal 6, plus 2 per Toxin removed, and 4 more if Dosed. Heal the damage dealt.

up.text: Remove all Toxin from the target. Deal 8, plus 2 per Toxin removed, and 4 more if Dosed. Heal the damage dealt.

drink_deep.flavour: Fen water, blood, it all goes down the same.
drink_deep.note: The Pactbound sinks the bone knife in a green-veined foe and drinks from the wound.

sin_eater.name: Sin-Eater
sin_eater.text: Take up to 8 stress from every other hero. Move every ailment off the other hero carrying the most onto you.

up.text: Take up to 10 stress from every other hero. Move every ailment off the other hero carrying the most onto you.

sin_eater.flavour: Bread and salt on the breast of the dead. I eat it all.
sin_eater.note: The Hexweaver eats bread from a hero's chest while the company's shadows drain into them.

blood_debt.name: Grudge
blood_debt.text: The target gains 1 Doom per 2 Scars you carry.

up.text: The target gains 2 Doom, plus 1 per 2 Scars you carry.

blood_debt.flavour: Every drop I lost is written down. You will pay it back.
blood_debt.note: The Pactbound presses a bloody hand on a foe's chest and the print turns black.

deaths_ledger.name: Death's Ledger
deaths_ledger.text: The target gains 1 Doom per 2 HP it is missing, at most 15, and 4 more if it bleeds.

up.text: Apply 3 Doom. The target gains 1 Doom per 2 HP it is missing, at most 15, and 4 more if it bleeds.

deaths_ledger.flavour: Every wound is a line in the book. I add them up.
deaths_ledger.note: The Doomsayer reads a foe's wounds aloud from a cord of knots.

witching_hour.name: Witching Hour
witching_hour.text: Every foe gains Hex equal to its Hex, at most 2. Last in the Ordo: every foe gains 2 more Hex. Exhaust.

up.text: Every foe gains Hex equal to its Hex, at most 3. Last in the Ordo: every foe gains 2 more Hex. Exhaust.

witching_hour.flavour: At this hour every knot pulls twice as tight.
witching_hour.note: Every black candle on the shoulder plate flares at once.

bell_book_candle.name: Anathema
bell_book_candle.text: Apply 2 Hex. The target gains 2 Doom per Hex on it, at most 16, and 4 more if it has Fire.

up.text: Apply 3 Hex. The target gains 2 Doom per Hex on it, at most 20, and 4 more if it has Fire.

bell_book_candle.flavour: Ring it out, shut it out, snuff it out.
bell_book_candle.note: The Doomsayer rings the bell, slams a cord-bound book and pinches a candle out.

scapegoat.name: Scapegoat
scapegoat.text: Move every ailment off the other hero carrying the most onto the target. Apply 5 Hex. If it attacks this round, its attack strikes a foe beside it instead.

up.text: Move every ailment off the other hero carrying the most onto the target. Apply 7 Hex. If it attacks this round, its attack strikes a foe beside it instead.

scapegoat.flavour: Lay it all on the goat and drive it out among its own.
scapegoat.note: A foe, smeared with the company's sickness, turns snarling on its kin.

silver_tongue.name: Silver Tongue
silver_tongue.text: Take every foe's Block. Every foe loses all its Might. Apply 1 Hex to every foe, and 1 more to each that is Marked.

up.text: Take every foe's Block. Every foe loses all its Might. Apply 2 Hex to every foe, and 1 more to each that is Marked.

silver_tongue.flavour: Everything you have looks better in my glass.
silver_tongue.note: The Mirrorhex sweeps the cracked mirror along the foes' line, and it fills.

buried_bottle.name: Buried Bottle
buried_bottle.text: Rite: whenever a foe hits another hero, it gains 1 Hex, and 1 Doom if it has 4 or more Hex. Exhaust.

up.text: Rite: whenever a foe hits another hero, it gains 1 Hex and takes 2 damage, and gains 1 Doom if it has 4 or more Hex. Exhaust.

buried_bottle.flavour: Pins, nails and hair in a stoppered bottle, buried under the door.
buried_bottle.note: The Mirrorhex buries a stoppered bottle of pins under the company's threshold.

malediction.name: Cracked Skull
malediction.text: Apply 2 Hex to every foe, plus 1 per other hero who has acted before this in the Ordo. Apply 2 Toxin to every foe.

up.text: Apply 3 Hex to every foe, plus 1 per other hero who has acted before this in the Ordo. Apply 2 Toxin to every foe.

malediction.flavour: Cursed in your bread, your bed, your breath, your blood.
malediction.note: The Hexweaver stands, for once, arms wide, cursing the whole line in green-black smoke.

burn_the_poppet.name: Burning Effigy
burn_the_poppet.text: Spend the target's Hex and Fire. Deal 2, plus 2 per stack spent. If this kills it, every foe gains 1 Hex per stack spent.

up.text: Spend the target's Hex and Fire. Deal 4, plus 2 per stack spent. If this kills it, every foe gains 1 Hex per stack spent.

burn_the_poppet.flavour: Into the candle with it. Watch who screams.
burn_the_poppet.note: The Hexweaver holds a straw poppet to a black candle and it catches.

scar_tally.name: Scar Tally
scar_tally.text: Deal 3. Apply 1 Bleed per 4 Scars you carry, at most 4.

up.text: Deal 5. Apply 1 Bleed per 4 Scars you carry, at most 4.

scar_tally.flavour: I keep count on the arm. The knife keeps count on you.
scar_tally.note: The Pactbound bares a forearm of tally cuts and slashes a foe.

let_it_run.name: Lancing
let_it_run.text: Lose 2 HP. Next round, draw 1 more.

up.text: Lose 1 HP. Next round, draw 1 more.

let_it_run.flavour: Don't bind it yet. It's telling me things.
let_it_run.note: Blood drips from the Pactbound's cut arm onto a row of poppets, which twitch.

take_the_curse_in.name: Shears
take_the_curse_in.text: Unbind: take one affliction card out of the company's decks for this fight. The target suffers its when-drawn effect and gains 4 Hex. Prime 3.

up.text: Unbind: take one affliction card out of the company's decks for this fight. The target suffers its when-drawn effect and gains 5 Hex. Prime 4.

take_the_curse_in.flavour: I swallowed your fear. Now I spit it out.
take_the_curse_in.note: The Pactbound bites a cloth poppet open and a hero's nightmare pours out at a foe.

bear_the_burden.name: Heavy Sack
bear_the_burden.text: Move every ailment off the other hero carrying the most onto you. Gain 1 Might.

up.text: Move every ailment off the other hero carrying the most onto you. Gain 2 Might.

bear_the_burden.flavour: The heavier the load, the harder I hit.
bear_the_burden.note: The Pactbound shoulders a hero's sickness like a sack and squares up.

blood_for_blood.name: Feud
blood_for_blood.text: Deal 6, plus 2 per ailment you carry and 1 per Bleed on the target.

up.text: Deal 8, plus 2 per ailment you carry and 1 per Bleed on the target.

blood_for_blood.flavour: Every sore you gave me, I give back with an edge.
blood_for_blood.note: A blistered, poisoned Pactbound drives the bone knife in to the hilt.

knock_at_the_door.name: Knock
knock_at_the_door.text: Deal 8, or 20 if you are at a quarter of your HP or less.

up.text: Deal 10, or 25 if you are at a quarter of your HP or less.

knock_at_the_door.flavour: I've stood on that step. I know who answers.
knock_at_the_door.note: The Pactbound, grey-lipped at Death's Door, strikes with everything left.

prophet_of_doom.name: Raven
prophet_of_doom.text: Apply 4 Doom. If 4 or more vigour was spent before this in the Ordo, apply 3 more.

up.text: Apply 5 Doom. If 4 or more vigour was spent before this in the Ordo, apply 4 more.

prophet_of_doom.flavour: Your name is on the bell. I can read it from here.
prophet_of_doom.note: The Doomsayer holds the bell staff high and points at a foe.

harbinger.name: Harbinger
harbinger.text: Apply 4 Doom and 3 Hex. First in the Ordo: the target is Vulnerable for 2 rounds.

up.text: Apply 5 Doom and 4 Hex. First in the Ordo: the target is Vulnerable for 2 rounds.

harbinger.flavour: Before the end comes, it sends a bell ahead of it.
harbinger.note: The Doomsayer walks up to a foe ringing the handbell in its face.

the_final_hour.name: Snuff Out
the_final_hour.text: Deal 5. Execute 6, or 12 if this is last in the Ordo. If this kills, every foe gains 2 Doom.

up.text: Deal 6. Execute 8, or 15 if this is last in the Ordo. If this kills, every foe gains 3 Doom.

the_final_hour.flavour: The last stroke of the hour. Then quiet.
the_final_hour.note: The Doomsayer swings the bell staff and the struck foe falls silent mid-cry.

death_watch.name: Death Watch
death_watch.text: Rite: whenever a foe dies, every foe gains 3 Doom, and 2 more if the dead foe was Marked. Exhaust.

up.text: Rite: whenever a foe dies, every foe gains 3 Doom and 1 Hex, and 2 more Doom if the dead foe was Marked. Exhaust.

death_watch.flavour: The beetle in the beam ticks for the next of you.
death_watch.note: The Doomsayer kneels by a fallen foe and listens to the walls.

nine_tailors.name: Running Sand
nine_tailors.text: Every foe gains 1 Doom per Hex on it. Bank 1.

up.text: Every foe gains 2 Doom, plus 1 per Hex on it. Bank 1.

nine_tailors.flavour: Nine strokes for the dead, then one for every year. Count yours.
nine_tailors.note: The Doomsayer rings the staff bell nine times; the hexed foes kneel.

toll_of_bells.name: Peal
toll_of_bells.text: Double the Doom on every foe. Exhaust.

up.text: Apply 2 Doom to every foe, then double the Doom on every foe. Exhaust.

toll_of_bells.flavour: Every bell in the drowned towers answers mine.
toll_of_bells.note: The Doomsayer rings both bells at once and distant bells answer.

mirror_skin.name: Cowl
mirror_skin.text: Every hero gains 2 Thorns and 1 Ward. A hero with Taunt gains 1 more Thorns.

up.text: Every hero gains 3 Thorns and 1 Ward. A hero with Taunt gains 1 more Thorns.

mirror_skin.flavour: Wear the glass on the outside, and they cut themselves.
mirror_skin.note: Shards from the Mirrorhex's hood swirl out and settle on the company's armour.

return_to_sender.name: Recoil
return_to_sender.text: Deal 1 per 2 damage the foes mean to deal you, plus 1 per Thorns you have.

up.text: Deal 3, plus 1 per 2 damage the foes mean to deal you, plus 1 per Thorns you have.

return_to_sender.flavour: Whatever you send, the glass sends half of it home.
return_to_sender.note: The Mirrorhex angles the cracked glass at the foes as they wind up.

crossed_glass.name: Bewilder
crossed_glass.text: Costs 1 less once 2 heroes are in the Ordo. If the target or a foe beside it attacks this round, that attack strikes its own neighbour instead. Apply 2 Hex.

up.text: Costs 1 less once 2 heroes are in the Ordo. If the target or a foe beside it attacks this round, that attack strikes its own neighbour instead. Apply 4 Hex.

crossed_glass.flavour: Two mirrors facing. Nobody knows which one is real.
crossed_glass.note: The Mirrorhex holds up two shards and the foes in the middle turn on each other.

mirrored_curse.name: Reflection
mirrored_curse.text: Apply 3 Hex. Handoff: also apply 3 Hex to each foe beside the target.

up.text: Apply 4 Hex. Handoff: also apply 4 Hex to each foe beside the target.

mirrored_curse.flavour: Curse one, and its reflections take it too.
mirrored_curse.note: A foe's curse sigil appears again on the foes on either side, reversed.

thiefs_glass.name: Cutpurse
thiefs_glass.text: Take the target's Block. The target loses all its Might, and you gain 1 Might if it had any. Gain 1 Thrift.

up.text: Take the target's Block. The target loses all its Might, and you gain that much Might, at most 2. Gain 1 Thrift.

thiefs_glass.flavour: It was yours in the mirror. Now it is mine in the world.
thiefs_glass.note: A foe's swagger slides out of it into the glass and into the Mirrorhex.

doubled_image.name: Twin Panels
doubled_image.text: A hero gains 1 Dodge and 2 Ward. If they Taunt, they gain 1 more Dodge.

up.text: A hero gains 1 Dodge and 3 Ward. If they Taunt, they gain 1 more Dodge.

doubled_image.flavour: Strike the one in the glass. I am standing beside it.
doubled_image.note: A hero's reflection steps out of the mirror and takes the blow.

signed_in_blood.name: Signed in Blood
signed_in_blood.text: Rite: whenever you play a card on a foe, lose 1 HP, deal 5 to that foe, ignoring Block, and it gains 1 Bleed. Exhaust.

up.text: Gain 2 Might. Rite: whenever you play a card on a foe, lose 1 HP, deal 5 to that foe, ignoring Block, and it gains 1 Bleed. Exhaust.

signed_in_blood.flavour: My name, in my blood, on your contract. Every line costs us both.
signed_in_blood.note: The Pactbound signs a long scroll with the bone knife, and a foe bleeds at every stroke.

the_open_door.name: The Open Door
the_open_door.text: Gain 1 Grit. Rite: at the start of each round, if you are at Death's Door, gain 2 Thrift and 1 Grit. Exhaust.

up.text: Gain 1 Grit. Next round, +1 vigour. Rite: at the start of each round, if you are at Death's Door, gain 2 Thrift and 1 Grit. Exhaust.

the_open_door.flavour: I have one foot over the step. The other is kicking.
the_open_door.note: The Pactbound stands in a doorway of black light, poppets ablaze.

the_great_bell.name: The Great Bell
the_great_bell.text: Rite: at round end, every foe gains Doom equal to its Hex, and each foe that was Delayed this round gains 2 more. Exhaust.

up.text: Apply 2 Hex to every foe. Rite: at round end, every foe gains Doom equal to its Hex, and each foe that was Delayed this round gains 2 more. Exhaust.

the_great_bell.flavour: The great bell has not rung since the flood. It rings for you.
the_great_bell.note: A drowned tower's great bell swings behind the Doomsayer as the foes fall still.

death_knell.name: Death Toll
death_knell.text: Rite: when a foe dies, every other foe gains its Hex, Doom and Bleed. Exhaust.

up.text: Apply 3 Doom to every foe. Rite: when a foe dies, every other foe gains its Hex, Doom and Bleed. Exhaust.

death_knell.flavour: When one goes, the bell tolls for the rest of the house.
death_knell.note: A foe falls, and black threads leap from its body to every foe still standing.

hall_of_mirrors.name: Hall of Mirrors
hall_of_mirrors.text: Rite: this round and next round, every foe's attack strikes its neighbour instead. Exhaust.

up.text: Every hero gains 2 Ward. Rite: this round and next round, every foe's attack strikes its neighbour instead. Exhaust.

hall_of_mirrors.flavour: A hundred glasses, and in every one, the face you hate.
hall_of_mirrors.note: The room fills with cracked mirrors and the foes turn on their own reflections.

the_witchs_glass.name: Witch Ball
the_witchs_glass.text: Rite: whenever a foe hits another hero, every ailment on the other hero carrying the most moves onto that foe, and it gains 1 Hex per ailment moved. Exhaust.

up.text: Every hero gains 2 Ward. Rite: whenever a foe hits another hero, every ailment on the other hero carrying the most moves onto that foe, and it gains 1 Hex per ailment moved. Exhaust.

the_witchs_glass.flavour: Whatever you lay on mine comes home to you, and brings a friend.
the_witchs_glass.note: A great cracked mirror stands behind the company; every curse thrown at it flies back.

or_hasten.name: Hasten

up.text: Prime 4. Handoff: Prime 2 more.

or_hasten.flavour: The sand falls a little faster for whoever moves next.
or_hasten.note: The Oracle tips the wrist hourglass toward an ally; the sand runs bright.

or_second_hand.name: Second Hand
or_second_hand.text: Echo. Deal 1, or 3 if this is last in the Ordo.

up.text: Echo. Deal 2, or 4 if this is last in the Ordo.

or_second_hand.flavour: Turn it over. The same blow falls again.
or_second_hand.note: The brass clock face on the chest shows two hands where one should be.

or_read_the_bones.name: Read the Bones
or_read_the_bones.text: Choose a foe. Gain 1 Omen, 1 more if it means to attack, and 1 more if this is first in the Ordo.

up.text: Choose a foe. Gain 2 Omen, 1 more if it means to attack, and 1 more if this is first in the Ordo.

or_read_the_bones.flavour: Knucklebones on the flagstones. Three fall face down.
or_read_the_bones.note: The Augur crouches and casts knucklebones before a raised foe.

or_bind.name: Bind
or_bind.text: Prime 2, plus 2 per Prime spent this round.

up.text: Prime 3, plus 2 per Prime spent this round.

or_bind.flavour: One knot holds. Two knots bind. Three knots are a promise.
or_bind.note: The Fatebinder ties a red thread between two of the company's wrists.

or_void_glimpse.name: Void Glimpse

up.text: Deal 7. Apply 1 Void.

or_void_glimpse.flavour: It points. The robe opens. The stars look back.
or_void_glimpse.note: The Oracle points; the robe falls open on its sewn star charts.

or_foretelling.name: Foretelling

up.text: A hero gains 3 Ward. Prime 4.

or_foretelling.flavour: I have heard your blow land already. Make it so.
or_foretelling.note: The Oracle's long fingers rest on an ally's shoulder; faint stars cling there.

or_stall.name: Stall

up.text: Delay the target. Deal 6.

or_stall.note: The Oracle raises one palm; a foe's swing hangs in the air.

or_drawn_veil.name: Drawn Veil
or_drawn_veil.text: A hero gains 5 Block and 1 Ward.

up.text: A hero gains 7 Block and 1 Ward.

or_drawn_veil.flavour: The linen over my eyes keeps out more than light.
or_drawn_veil.note: A fold of violet-black robe drawn across an ally like a curtain.

or_time_shear.name: Time Shear
or_time_shear.text: Deal 9, or 12 if this is last in the Ordo. Apply 1 Void.

up.text: Deal 12, or 15 if this is last in the Ordo. Apply 1 Void.

or_time_shear.flavour: A moment cut out of the day. The foe was standing in it.
or_time_shear.note: A slice of night opens across a foe, stars showing through the wound.

or_hourglass.name: Hourglass

up.text: Bank 2. Shed 5 stress.

or_hourglass.flavour: Turn it, and the hour you did not use comes back to you.
or_hourglass.note: The Oracle turns the hourglass on its chain; the last grain hangs.

or_glimpse_ahead.name: Premonition
or_glimpse_ahead.text: Next round, draw 1 more. Gain 3 stress.

up.text: Next round, draw 1 more. Gain 1 stress.

or_glimpse_ahead.flavour: Seeing tomorrow is easy. Living through today after is not.
or_glimpse_ahead.note: Behind the blindfold, a painted eye seems to open.

or_stutter.name: Stutter
or_stutter.text: Echo. Deal 2, plus 1 per vigour left unspent this round, at most 5. Apply 1 Void.

up.text: Echo. Deal 3, plus 1 per vigour left unspent this round, at most 6. Apply 1 Void.

or_stutter.flavour: The moment skips, and the foe is struck twice by one blow.
or_stutter.note: Two ghost images of the same pointing hand, one a beat behind.

or_late_blow.name: Smith's Hammer
or_late_blow.text: Deal 4, or 8 if the target was Delayed this round.

up.text: Deal 5, or 11 if the target was Delayed this round.

or_late_blow.flavour: It waited for you. It should not have.
or_late_blow.note: A foe frozen mid-step while a second blow arrives from behind it.

or_quicken.name: Quicken
or_quicken.text: Another hero gains 2 Momentum and 3 Block.

up.text: Another hero gains 3 Momentum and 4 Block.

or_quicken.flavour: Your hour, given early. Spend it well.
or_quicken.note: Sand pours from the hourglass into an ally's open palm.

or_stopped_sand.name: Stilled Pendulum
or_stopped_sand.text: Deal 2. If the target is Marked, Delay it.

up.text: Deal 4. If the target is Marked, Delay it.

or_stopped_sand.flavour: The marked one waits longest, and waits open.
or_stopped_sand.note: A Marked foe caught in still, glittering sand to the knees.

or_knucklebones.name: Knucklebones
or_knucklebones.text: Deal 3. Apply 1 Void. If the target means to attack, gain 2 Omen.

up.text: Deal 4. Apply 1 Void. If the target means to attack, gain 3 Omen.

or_knucklebones.flavour: The bones fall the way the blow will.
or_knucklebones.note: Knucklebones skitter across the floor toward a foe's raised weapon.

or_forewarn.name: Forewarn
or_forewarn.text: A hero gains 5 Block, plus 1 per 2 damage the foes mean to deal them this round.

up.text: A hero gains 7 Block, plus 1 per 2 damage the foes mean to deal them this round.

or_forewarn.note: The Oracle's hand on an ally's arm, turning them a half step.

or_bird_bone_ward.name: Bird-Bone Ward
or_bird_bone_ward.text: Every hero gains 1 Ward. If any foe means to attack, gain 1 Omen.

up.text: Every hero gains 1 Ward. You gain 1 more. If any foe means to attack, gain 1 Omen.

or_bird_bone_ward.flavour: A wren's skull on a thread. It hears the course before it comes.
or_bird_bone_ward.note: Tiny bird skulls on red thread hang from every hero's belt.

or_entrails.name: Entrails
or_entrails.text: Deal 5. If it kills, gain 2 Omen.

up.text: Deal 7. If it kills, gain 2 Omen.

or_entrails.flavour: The dead say more than the living. Mostly about you.
or_entrails.note: The Augur kneels over a fallen foe, reading what spilled.

or_omen_bolt.name: Portent
or_omen_bolt.text: Deal 3, plus 1 per Omen you hold.

up.text: Deal 5, plus 1 per Omen you hold.

or_omen_bolt.note: A bolt of violet dark leaves the Augur's feathered hand.

or_ill_omen.name: Magpie
or_ill_omen.text: Deal 3. If the target means to attack, it becomes Vulnerable and you gain 1 Omen.

up.text: Deal 5. If the target means to attack, it becomes Vulnerable and you gain 1 Omen.

or_ill_omen.flavour: Raise that arm and the stars will mark the gap under it.
or_ill_omen.note: A crow feather lands on a foe's raised arm.

or_knot.name: Hangman's Knot

up.text: Handoff: Prime 4.

or_knot.flavour: A knot in red thread. Someone's fate just tightened.
or_knot.note: Ink-red fingers pull a small knot tight.

or_bind_fate.name: Padlock
or_bind_fate.text: Retain. Prime 4, plus 1 per card you keep in hand this round, at most 8.

up.text: Retain. Prime 5, plus 1 per card you keep in hand this round, at most 10.

or_bind_fate.flavour: Written now. Paid when it is needed.
or_bind_fate.note: The Fatebinder writes one red word on the wax tablet and holds it closed.

or_guiding_word.name: Guiding Word

up.text: Prime 5. Another hero gains 3 Focus.

or_guiding_word.flavour: Say it with me, and it lands.
or_guiding_word.note: Red rubric letters drift from the Oracle's lips to an ally's ear.

or_red_letter.name: Red Letter
or_red_letter.text: Deal 3, plus 3 per Prime spent this round.

up.text: Deal 4, plus 4 per Prime spent this round.

or_red_letter.flavour: Rubric marks the line that matters.
or_red_letter.note: A single red capital letter burns across a foe's chest.

or_woven_shield.name: Woven Shield
or_woven_shield.text: Every hero gains 1 Block, plus 1 per Prime spent this round.

up.text: Every hero gains 2 Block, plus 1 per Prime spent this round.

or_woven_shield.flavour: Every thread pulled tight is a thread that holds.
or_woven_shield.note: A web of red thread strung between the company, catching a blow.

or_pull_the_thread.name: Unravel
or_pull_the_thread.text: Pull the target forward 1. Deal 3. Apply 1 Void.

up.text: Pull the target forward 1. Deal 5. Apply 1 Void.

or_pull_the_thread.flavour: Every fate has a loose end. Pull.
or_pull_the_thread.note: A red thread from the Fatebinder's quill hooks a back-rank foe forward.

or_void_lance.name: Void Lance

up.text: Deal 6. Apply 1 Volatile Void.

or_void_lance.flavour: The void answers every course you have left in it.
or_void_lance.note: A shaft of starless dark meets the colours already burning on a foe.

or_starlit_ward.name: Starlight
or_starlit_ward.text: A hero gains 3 Ward and sheds 3 stress.

up.text: A hero gains 4 Ward and sheds 4 stress.

or_starlit_ward.flavour: Stars do not move for the storm. Stand behind them.
or_starlit_ward.note: A ring of tiny stars circles an ally's head like a halo.

or_event_horizon.name: Abyss
or_event_horizon.text: Deal 2 to every foe, plus 2 per Conjunction set off this round. Apply 1 Void to every foe.

up.text: Deal 3 to every foe, plus 2 per Conjunction set off this round. Apply 1 Void to every foe.

or_event_horizon.flavour: Where the courses meet, the door opens wider.
or_event_horizon.note: A dark ring spreads across the floor beneath the foes, stars at its rim.

or_hollow_gaze.name: Hollow Gaze
or_hollow_gaze.text: Mark the target. Every hero sheds 3 stress.

up.text: Mark the target. Every hero sheds 5 stress.

or_hollow_gaze.flavour: It turns its blindfold on you. The company breathes out.
or_hollow_gaze.note: The Oracle's blind face turns toward one foe; the others seem to shrink.

or_unmaking.name: Breastplate

up.text: Take the target's Block. Deal 6.

or_unmaking.flavour: What you built, the dark unbuilds, and gives to me.
or_unmaking.note: A foe's shield crumbles into motes that drift to the Oracle's robe.

or_blind_spot.name: Blind Spot
or_blind_spot.text: A hero dodges the next hit and gains 1 Ward. If they Taunt, they also gain 4 Block.

up.text: A hero dodges the next hit and gains 2 Ward. If they Taunt, they also gain 5 Block.

or_blind_spot.flavour: The blow comes from where you are not looking. So look away.
or_blind_spot.note: An ally steps aside a hair's breadth as a blade passes.

or_reverse_the_glass.name: Armillary Sphere
or_reverse_the_glass.text: Delay every foe that means to attack. Deal 2 to every foe. Exhaust.

up.text: Delay every foe that means to attack. Deal 4 to every foe. Exhaust.

or_reverse_the_glass.flavour: Every raised hand waits its turn. Mine comes first.
or_reverse_the_glass.note: The Chronomancer flips a great hourglass; every foe's weapon slows.

or_pendulum.name: Pendulum
or_pendulum.text: Echo. Deal 6, or 9 if no vigour is left unspent this round. Apply 1 Void.

up.text: Echo. Deal 8, or 11 if no vigour is left unspent this round. Apply 1 Void.

or_pendulum.flavour: It swings out. It swings back. Both ways it hurts.
or_pendulum.note: The broken pendulum staff swings through a foe, and swings again.

or_borrowed_time.name: Night Lamp
or_borrowed_time.text: Next round, +1 vigour. Gain 7 stress. Exhaust.

up.text: Next round, +1 vigour. Gain 4 stress. Exhaust.

or_borrowed_time.flavour: Time borrowed from the dark is paid back with interest.
or_borrowed_time.note: The Oracle holds out the hourglass; a hand of shadow pours sand in.

or_skipped_tooth.name: Skipped Tooth
or_skipped_tooth.text: Costs 1 less once 3 cards are in the Ordo. Every hero gains 1 Momentum. If this cost 1 or less, every hero also draws 1 more next round.

up.text: Costs 1 less once 3 cards are in the Ordo. Every hero gains 2 Momentum. If this cost 1 or less, every hero also draws 1 more next round.

or_skipped_tooth.flavour: The clock skips a tooth, and the whole company is ahead of it.
or_skipped_tooth.note: The clock face on the Chronomancer's chest spins; the company leans forward.

or_wind_the_spring.name: Mainspring
or_wind_the_spring.text: Take all of another hero's Momentum. Prime 2 per Momentum taken.

up.text: Take all of another hero's Momentum. Prime 3 per Momentum taken.

or_wind_the_spring.flavour: Your speed, wound tight, let go all at once.
or_wind_the_spring.note: The Chronomancer winds a brass key in an ally's back like a clock.

or_fulfil_the_omen.name: Swift
or_fulfil_the_omen.text: Spend all your Omen. Deal 4, plus 3 per Omen spent.

up.text: Spend all your Omen. Deal 6, plus 4 per Omen spent.

or_fulfil_the_omen.flavour: I told you how it ends. Here is the end.
or_fulfil_the_omen.note: Every bone in the pouch flies at once, trailing violet dark.

or_unheeded_warning.name: Unheeded Warning
or_unheeded_warning.text: Deal half the damage the foes mean to deal this round.

up.text: Deal 2, plus half the damage the foes mean to deal this round.

or_unheeded_warning.flavour: They were warned. They are always warned.
or_unheeded_warning.note: A foe's own raised blade turns to smoke and strikes its face.

or_wheel_turns.name: Fortune's Wheel
or_wheel_turns.text: The target's attack this round strikes the foe beside it instead. If it means to attack, gain 1 Omen.

up.text: The target's attack this round strikes the foe beside it instead. If it means to attack, gain 2 Omen. Deal 2.

or_wheel_turns.flavour: Fate is a wheel. Today you are under it.
or_wheel_turns.note: A foe's strike swerves into its neighbour; the Augur's feathers stir.

or_seen_coming.name: Seen Coming
or_seen_coming.text: Gain Block equal to the damage the foes mean to deal you. First in the Ordo: gain 1 Omen.

up.text: Gain 3 Block, plus Block equal to the damage the foes mean to deal you. First in the Ordo: gain 1 Omen.

or_seen_coming.flavour: I heard your step on the stair a year ago.
or_seen_coming.note: A diving foe meets the Oracle's raised palm and a wall of still stars.

or_trade_on_tomorrow.name: Augur's Fee
or_trade_on_tomorrow.text: Spend all your Omen. Gain 1 Thrift per 3 Omen spent, at most 2.

up.text: Spend all your Omen. Gain 1 Thrift per 2 Omen spent, at most 3.

or_trade_on_tomorrow.flavour: What I know of tomorrow, I sell to today.
or_trade_on_tomorrow.note: The Augur pours knucklebones into the Chronomancer's hourglass.

or_tapestry.name: Tapestry
or_tapestry.text: Costs 1 less once 2 heroes are in the Ordo. Deal 3 to every foe, plus 3 per Prime spent this round.

up.text: Costs 1 less once 2 heroes are in the Ordo. Deal 4 to every foe, plus 4 per Prime spent this round.

or_tapestry.flavour: Every thread in the weave runs through them.
or_tapestry.note: A red tapestry of the company's deeds unrolls, and the foes are in it.

or_red_ink.name: Vermilion
or_red_ink.text: Choose a foe. Prime 3, plus 1 per Bleed on it.

up.text: Choose a foe. Prime 4, plus 1 per Bleed on it.

or_red_ink.flavour: Rubric ink and blood are the same colour. I use both.
or_red_ink.note: The Fatebinder dips the quill in a foe's wound and writes.

or_gathering_thread.name: Spindle
or_gathering_thread.text: Prime 4, plus 3 per other hero who has acted before this in the Ordo, at most 10.

up.text: Prime 5, plus 4 per other hero who has acted before this in the Ordo, at most 12.

or_gathering_thread.flavour: Each knot tied makes the next one tighter.
or_gathering_thread.note: Red thread winds around the Fatebinder's arm in a growing coil.

or_fates_edge.name: Fate's Edge

up.text: Deal 7. If it kills, Prime 6.

or_fates_edge.flavour: One thread cut. The next blow is already falling.
or_fates_edge.note: A foe falls; its red thread whips toward the next in line.

or_cut_the_cord.name: Cut Short
or_cut_the_cord.text: Deal 4. Execute 3, plus 3 per Prime spent this round.

up.text: Deal 5. Execute 4, plus 4 per Prime spent this round.

or_cut_the_cord.flavour: Some cords are cut. Some were never tied.
or_cut_the_cord.note: Scissors of red ink close on a thin thread above a foe's head.

or_cold_star.name: Cold Star
or_cold_star.text: Deal 3. If the target has Frost, apply 2 Volatile Void.

up.text: Deal 4. If the target has Frost, apply 3 Volatile Void.

or_cold_star.flavour: Cold to cold, dark to dark. Nothing is left between.
or_cold_star.note: A pale star falls on a rimed foe and the frost goes black.

or_collapse.name: Collapse
or_collapse.text: Spend all Void and Frost on the target. Deal 4, plus 2 per stack spent.

up.text: Spend all Void and Frost on the target. Deal 5, plus 3 per stack spent.

or_collapse.flavour: The door was always in it. Now it opens.
or_collapse.note: A foe folds inward around a point of starless dark.

or_quiet_hour.name: Vigil Candles
or_quiet_hour.text: Every hero sheds 5 stress and gains 1 Ward. Dosed: every hero gains 1 more Ward.

up.text: Every hero sheds 7 stress and gains 1 Ward. Dosed: every hero gains 1 more Ward.

or_quiet_hour.flavour: The cell was quiet for years. I bring a little of it with me.
or_quiet_hour.note: The company sits in a circle of still candlelight; the Oracle listens.

or_unwritten.name: Erasure
or_unwritten.text: The target loses its Might and Thorns. Gain 1 Omen per 2 stacks lost. Apply 2 Void. Deal 2.

up.text: The target loses its Might and Thorns. Gain 1 Omen per 2 stacks lost. Apply 3 Void. Deal 3.

or_unwritten.flavour: Strength not foretold is strength that never was.
or_unwritten.note: The Oracle scrapes a line off the wax tablet; a foe's spikes fall away.

or_dread_vision.name: Dread Vision
or_dread_vision.text: If the target has Hex, apply 1 Void. Deal 1, plus 2 per Void on the target.

up.text: If the target has Hex, apply 1 Void. Deal 2, plus 3 per Void on the target.

or_dread_vision.flavour: It sees what I see. It does not survive it.
or_dread_vision.note: A foe stares into the Oracle's open robe and the stars stare back.

or_stop_time.name: Stop Time
or_stop_time.text: Costs 1 less once 3 cards are in the Ordo. Delay every foe. Deal 3 to each. Bank 2. Exhaust.

up.text: Costs 1 less once 3 cards are in the Ordo. Delay every foe. Deal 5 to each. Bank 2. Exhaust.

or_stop_time.flavour: Between one grain and the next, I walk among them.
or_stop_time.note: Every foe hangs motionless in falling sand; the Oracle walks between.

or_deja_vu.name: Deja Vu
or_deja_vu.text: Echo. Retain. Deal 2 times this card's place in the Ordo, at most 10.

up.text: Echo. Retain. Deal 2, plus 2 times this card's place in the Ordo, at most 12.

or_deja_vu.flavour: This has happened. It will happen again, harder.
or_deja_vu.note: The same red thread strikes a foe twice in the same place.

or_stolen_hour.name: Stolen Hour
or_stolen_hour.text: Spend all your Ward. Gain 1 Thrift per 4 Ward spent, at most 3. Next round, +1 vigour. Exhaust.

up.text: Spend all your Ward. Gain 1 Thrift per 3 Ward spent, at most 3. Next round, +1 vigour. Exhaust.

or_stolen_hour.flavour: The stars that shielded me now count the hours for me.
or_stolen_hour.note: Stars peel off the Oracle's robe and become grains in the hourglass.

or_scatter_the_bones.name: Cast Lots
or_scatter_the_bones.text: Spend all your Omen. Deal 2 to every foe, plus 1 per Omen spent, and 3 more to each foe that bleeds.

up.text: Spend all your Omen. Deal 4 to every foe, plus 1 per Omen spent, and 3 more to each foe that bleeds.

or_scatter_the_bones.flavour: Every bone a foe. Every foe a bone.
or_scatter_the_bones.note: The Augur flings the whole pouch; bones strike every foe at once.

or_forestalled.name: Door Bar
or_forestalled.text: Deal 4. If the target means to attack, Stun it. Otherwise, Delay it.

up.text: Deal 7. If the target means to attack, Stun it. Otherwise, Delay it.

or_forestalled.flavour: The blow you meant is already spent. You just have not felt it.
or_forestalled.note: A foe's swing stops dead against a hand it never saw.

or_augury_of_birds.name: Augury
or_augury_of_birds.text: Rank 4 only. Gain 1 Omen per 5 damage the foes mean to deal this round. Next round, draw 1 more.

up.text: Rank 4 only. Gain 1 Omen per 4 damage the foes mean to deal this round. Next round, draw 1 more.

or_augury_of_birds.flavour: Watch which way the crows fly from the battle.
or_augury_of_birds.note: From the back rank, the Augur watches a flight of black birds.

or_rubric_capital.name: Rubric Capital
or_rubric_capital.text: Spend all your Omen. Prime 2, plus 2 per Omen spent.

up.text: Spend all your Omen. Prime 4, plus 2 per Omen spent.

or_rubric_capital.flavour: What the bones foretold, the rubric writes in red.
or_rubric_capital.note: A great red illuminated capital, its knotwork full of knucklebones.

or_red_harvest.name: Red Harvest
or_red_harvest.text: Deal 6, plus 4 per Prime spent this round, and 4 more on a Handoff. If it kills, Prime 6.

up.text: Deal 8, plus 5 per Prime spent this round, and 4 more on a Handoff. If it kills, Prime 8.

or_red_harvest.flavour: Reap one. The thread runs on to the next.
or_red_harvest.note: The Fatebinder's red thread cuts down a foe and snaps toward another.

or_written_ahead.name: Written Ahead
or_written_ahead.text: Retain. Prime 3, plus 2 per vigour carried into this round, at most 9. Next round, draw 1 more.

up.text: Retain. Prime 5, plus 2 per vigour carried into this round, at most 11. Next round, draw 1 more.

or_written_ahead.flavour: Tomorrow's page is already inked. I only turn it.
or_written_ahead.note: The Fatebinder writes on a page that has not been bound yet.

or_eclipse.name: Eclipse
or_eclipse.text: Apply 1 Volatile Void to every foe, plus 1 per different course on it.

up.text: Apply 2 Volatile Void to every foe, plus 1 per different course on it.

or_eclipse.flavour: For a moment there are no stars at all.
or_eclipse.note: Every light in the room goes out; only the courses on the foes glow.

or_rewind.name: Winding Key
or_rewind.text: A hero is cleansed of 3 ailments, then heals half their missing HP. Exhaust.

up.text: A hero is cleansed of 5 ailments, then heals half their missing HP. Exhaust.

or_rewind.flavour: Back. Back. Before the wound. Stay there.
or_rewind.note: Sand runs upward in the hourglass; an ally's wound closes.

or_painted_eye.name: Painted Eye
or_painted_eye.text: The target becomes Vulnerable and Marked. Deal 2.

up.text: The target becomes Vulnerable and Marked. Deal 5.

or_painted_eye.flavour: One eye painted on the blindfold. It never closes.
or_painted_eye.note: The painted eye on the Oracle's blindfold opens wide on one foe.

or_stopped_clock.name: Stopped Clock
or_stopped_clock.text: Rank 4 only. Delay the target. If it means to attack, gain 1 Omen.

up.text: Rank 4 only. Delay the target. Deal 2. If it means to attack, gain 1 Omen.

or_stopped_clock.flavour: The clock on my chest stopped the day I walled myself in.
or_stopped_clock.note: From the back rank, the Chronomancer stops the brass clock's hands with a finger.

or_broken_pendulum.name: Hitch
or_broken_pendulum.text: Echo. Delay the target. Deal 1, plus 1 per vigour spent before this in the Ordo, at most 7.

up.text: Echo. Delay the target. Deal 3, plus 1 per vigour spent before this in the Ordo, at most 10.

or_broken_pendulum.flavour: It does not keep time any more. It takes it.
or_broken_pendulum.note: The broken pendulum staff cracks across a foe, then again a beat later.

or_accelerate.name: Whip
or_accelerate.text: Another hero gains 1 Thrift and 1 Momentum.

up.text: Another hero gains 1 Thrift and 2 Momentum.

or_accelerate.note: The Chronomancer taps an ally's shoulder; their outline blurs forward.

or_clock_face.name: Dial
or_clock_face.text: Next round, +1 vigour. If any vigour is left unspent this round, gain 2 Ward.

up.text: Gain 1 Ward. Next round, +1 vigour. If any vigour is left unspent this round, gain 2 more Ward.

or_clock_face.flavour: Twelve hours on the brass. I keep one back for us.
or_clock_face.note: The brass clock face on the chest glows; one numeral is missing.

or_repetition.name: Repetition
or_repetition.text: Echo. Deal 1 to every foe, plus 1 per other card you have played this round. Apply 1 Void to every foe.

up.text: Echo. Deal 2 to every foe, plus 1 per other card you have played this round. Apply 1 Void to every foe.

or_repetition.note: A ring of afterimages of the Oracle's pointing hand surrounds the foes.

or_run_back_the_sand.name: Sand Funnel
or_run_back_the_sand.text: A hero heals 3. Next round, a Night Lamp is added to their hand.

up.text: A hero heals 5. Next round, a Night Lamp is added to their hand.

or_run_back_the_sand.flavour: A minute ago you were whole. Go back there.
or_run_back_the_sand.note: Grains of sand rise from an ally's wound back into the hourglass.

or_read_the_signs.name: Weathercock
or_read_the_signs.text: Rank 4 only. Deal 2. Gain 2 Omen, 1 more if the target means to attack, and 1 more if this is first in the Ordo.

up.text: Rank 4 only. Deal 4. Gain 2 Omen, 1 more if the target means to attack, and 1 more if this is first in the Ordo.

or_read_the_signs.flavour: From the back, every raised arm is a sentence I can read.
or_read_the_signs.note: From the rear rank, the Augur's feathered head tilts, listening.

or_wring_the_bird.name: Sacrifice

up.text: Gain 4 Omen. Lose 1 HP. Exhaust.

or_wring_the_bird.flavour: A small life for a long look.
or_wring_the_bird.note: The Augur's trembling hands over a dead wren, blood on the feathers.

or_foretold_ruin.name: Foretold Ruin
or_foretold_ruin.text: Deal 3, or 8 if the target means to attack you. If it does, gain 1 Omen.

up.text: Deal 4, or 11 if the target means to attack you. If it does, gain 1 Omen.

or_foretold_ruin.flavour: You came for the blind one. The blind one saw you first.
or_foretold_ruin.note: A diving foe reaches the back rank and meets a fistful of bone.

or_knucklebone_charm.name: Knucklebone Charm
or_knucklebone_charm.text: A hero gains 4 Block, plus 1 per Omen you hold, and 1 Ward.

up.text: A hero gains 6 Block, plus 1 per Omen you hold, and 1 Ward.

or_knucklebone_charm.flavour: Wear it. The bones know where you will be hit.
or_knucklebone_charm.note: The Augur ties a knucklebone charm around an ally's wrist.

or_rebuke_the_seen.name: Rebuke
or_rebuke_the_seen.text: Deal 6 to every foe that means to attack, or 9 if this is first in the Ordo. Apply 1 Void to each of them.

up.text: Deal 8 to every foe that means to attack, or 11 if this is first in the Ordo. Apply 1 Void to each of them.

or_rebuke_the_seen.flavour: I saw you raise your hands. All of you.
or_rebuke_the_seen.note: Every foe with a raised weapon is struck by a falling star.

or_reading_the_knots.name: Knotwork
or_reading_the_knots.text: Deal 3. Gain 1 Omen, plus 1 per 2 Hex on the target.

up.text: Deal 5. Gain 1 Omen, plus 1 per 2 Hex on the target.

or_reading_the_knots.flavour: The witch's knots are a script. I read it aloud.
or_reading_the_knots.note: The Augur traces a Hexweaver's knotted cord on a foe like a line of text.

or_severance.name: Severance
or_severance.text: Deal 8. Execute 6, plus 6 per Prime spent this round.

up.text: Deal 10. Execute 8, plus 6 per Prime spent this round.

or_severance.flavour: The thread was always this short. I only showed you.
or_severance.note: The Fatebinder's quill-knife cuts a red thread above a foe; it drops.

or_red_knot.name: Tangle
or_red_knot.text: Prime 2, plus 1 per other hero who has acted before this in the Ordo. Gain 1 stress.

up.text: Prime 3, plus 1 per other hero who has acted before this in the Ordo. Gain 1 stress.

or_red_knot.note: A tight red knot on a thread already full of them.

or_needle_and_thread.name: Needlework
or_needle_and_thread.text: Prime 5. Another hero gains 1 Focus and 3 Block.

up.text: Prime 6. Another hero gains 2 Focus and 4 Block.

or_needle_and_thread.flavour: Stitched to your fate. Hold still.
or_needle_and_thread.note: A red needle stitches a line of rubric onto an ally's sleeve.

or_woven_mantle.name: Woven Mantle
or_woven_mantle.text: Every hero gains 3 Block, plus 2 per other hero who has acted before this in the Ordo, at most 6 each.

up.text: Every hero gains 4 Block, plus 3 per other hero who has acted before this in the Ordo, at most 8 each.

or_woven_mantle.flavour: A cloak of every fate we have bent today.
or_woven_mantle.note: A red-script mantle settles over the whole company.

or_scarlet_line.name: Scarlet Line
or_scarlet_line.text: Deal 2, plus 4 per Prime spent this round, and 3 more if the target was moved this round.

up.text: Deal 3, plus 5 per Prime spent this round, and 4 more if the target was moved this round.

or_scarlet_line.flavour: Pulled out of line, it stands on mine.
or_scarlet_line.note: A red line drawn on the floor; a dragged foe stands on it.

or_spill_the_ink.name: Spilt Ink
or_spill_the_ink.text: Prime 5, plus 1 per vigour spent before this in the Ordo, at most 10. Next round, +1 vigour.

up.text: Prime 7, plus 1 per vigour spent before this in the Ordo, at most 12. Next round, +1 vigour.

or_spill_the_ink.flavour: The ink horn tips. A whole chapter, written at once.
or_spill_the_ink.note: Red ink floods across the floor and runs toward an ally's feet.

or_the_last_hour.name: Snuffer
or_the_last_hour.text: Next round, +1 vigour. Rite: whenever you play an Echo card, Prime 5 and Bank 1. Exhaust.

up.text: Next round, +1 vigour. Rite: whenever you play an Echo card, Prime 5, Bank 1 and deal 2 to every foe. Exhaust.

or_the_last_hour.flavour: The last hour lasts as long as I say.
or_the_last_hour.note: The brass clock face cracks; every hand points to the same hour.

or_the_turned_glass.name: Turned Glass
or_the_turned_glass.text: Gain 2 Ward. Rite: at the start of each round, Delay the front foe and gain 1 Omen. Exhaust.

up.text: Gain 2 Ward. Rite: at the start of each round, Delay the front foe, deal 4 to it, and gain 1 Omen. Exhaust.

or_the_turned_glass.flavour: I turned the glass once, at the door. It has never run out.
or_the_turned_glass.note: A giant hourglass stands over the company, its sand frozen mid-fall.

or_cassandra.name: Antlers
or_cassandra.text: Gain 2 Omen. Rite: twice a round, when a foe hits another hero, it takes 3, plus 1 per Omen you hold, and becomes Marked. Exhaust.

up.text: Gain 2 Omen. Every foe that means to attack becomes Vulnerable. Rite: twice a round, when a foe hits another hero, it takes 3, plus 1 per Omen you hold, and becomes Marked. Exhaust.

or_cassandra.flavour: I told them all. None of them listened. Every one of them paid.
or_cassandra.note: A foe strikes the Bulwark and recoils, a bone driven into its own arm.

or_the_bone_pouch.name: Bone Pouch
or_the_bone_pouch.text: Gain 3 Omen. Rite: at the start of each round, every hero gains 1 Block per Omen you hold (at most 5) and 1 Ward per 2 Omen (at most 2). Exhaust.

up.text: Gain 3 Omen. Rite: at the start of each round, gain 1 Omen, then every hero gains 1 Block per Omen you hold (at most 5) and 1 Ward per 2 Omen (at most 2). Exhaust.

or_the_bone_pouch.flavour: Every bone in it once warned someone. Now they warn us.
or_the_bone_pouch.note: The Augur's pouch hangs open; little bones circle the company like moons.

or_the_rubric.name: Book of Hours
or_the_rubric.text: Prime 4. Rite: whenever you play a card, Prime 2, and 2 more if that card was played on a Handoff. Exhaust.

up.text: Prime 4. Rite: whenever you play a card, Prime 2, and 2 more if that card was played on a Handoff, and the most wounded hero gains 2 Block. Exhaust.

or_the_rubric.flavour: Every line I write in red, the world reads twice.
or_the_rubric.note: Red script crawls off the Fatebinder's arms onto every hero's weapon.

or_the_severed_thread.name: Severed Thread
or_the_severed_thread.text: Deal 6, plus 4 per Prime spent this round. If 3 or more Primes have been spent this round, Execute the target at the damage this dealt.

up.text: Deal 6, plus 4 per Prime spent this round. If 3 or more Primes have been spent this round, Execute the target at the damage this dealt. If it kills, Prime 6.

or_the_severed_thread.flavour: The third knot is the one that cuts.
or_the_severed_thread.note: Three red threads pulled taut from three heroes meet at one foe's throat.

ve_draw_breath.name: Draw Breath
ve_draw_breath.text: Take 1 stack of a hero's largest course. If it carried none, take 1 stack of the front foe's largest course instead. Gain 2 Block.

up.text: Take up to 2 stacks of a hero's largest course. If it carried none, take up to 2 stacks of the front foe's largest course instead. Gain 2 Block.

ve_draw_breath.flavour: In through the open hand. Whatever burns them settles here.
ve_draw_breath.note: The Vessel breathes in, palm turned to a hero, and a bead of fire crosses onto the vermilion band.

ve_shelter.name: Shelter
ve_shelter.text: Guard an adjacent hero this round.

up.text: Guard an adjacent hero this round. Gain 2 Block.

ve_shelter.flavour: Stand behind me. It cannot hurt me the way it hurts you.
ve_shelter.note: The Hearth Vessel steps half a pace aside, long sleeve raised before a hunched hero.

ve_breathe_out.name: Breathe Out
ve_breathe_out.text: Give 1 stack of your largest held course to the target, Volatile on a Handoff. Deal 3.

up.text: Give 1 stack of your largest held course to the target, Volatile on a Handoff. Deal 5.

ve_breathe_out.flavour: The breath goes out, and what it carried goes with it.
ve_breathe_out.note: The Mouth Vessel exhales toward a foe; a bead of deep blue leaves the band and crosses.

ve_weigh.name: Weigh
ve_weigh.text: Even out your held stacks across the courses you hold. Gain 1 Block. Bank 1.

up.text: Even out your held stacks across the courses you hold. Gain 3 Block. Bank 1.

ve_weigh.flavour: Six pans on one beam. None of them may sink.
ve_weigh.note: The Whole Vessel holds both palms level; the seals on the bands slide until they match.

ve_open_hand.name: Open Hand
ve_open_hand.text: Deal 5. Give 1 stack of your largest held course to the target.

up.text: Deal 7. Give 1 stack of your largest held course to the target.

ve_open_hand.flavour: An open hand, lifted. What it held crosses over.
ve_open_hand.note: The Vessel lifts an open inked palm toward a foe and a bead of vermilion leaves the skin.

ve_bear_it.name: Reliquary
ve_bear_it.text: Gain 4 Block, plus 1 per different course you hold.

up.text: Gain 6 Block, plus 1 per different course you hold.

ve_bear_it.flavour: It settles on the skin and waits. So do I.
ve_bear_it.note: A blow lands on the upright Vessel; the seals on the bands do not stir.

ve_take_into_me.name: Communion
ve_take_into_me.text: Take up to 4 stacks of a hero's largest course. That hero heals 2.

up.text: Take up to 5 stacks of a hero's largest course. That hero heals 3.

ve_take_into_me.flavour: What would burn you only settles on me.
ve_take_into_me.note: The Vessel lays a palm on a scorched hero's shoulder; the burn climbs into the vermilion band.

ve_give_back.name: Ewer
ve_give_back.text: Give up to 4 stacks of your largest held course to the target. Gain 2 Block.

up.text: Give up to 5 stacks of your largest held course to the target. Gain 3 Block.

ve_give_back.flavour: It was yours before it was mine. Take it home.
ve_give_back.note: The Vessel turns a palm outward and the deep blue band empties onto a foe as a skin of water.

ve_six_breaths.name: Six Breaths
ve_six_breaths.text: Hold 1 stack of each course you do not hold. Gain 2 Block. Exhaust.

up.text: Hold 1 stack of each course you do not hold. Gain 2 Block.

ve_six_breaths.flavour: Six breaths, one for each ink. On the sixth the body is whole.
ve_six_breaths.note: The Vessel breathes in slowly and all six bands brighten, from the fingertips to the jaw.

ve_lift.name: Lift
ve_lift.text: Take all of an adjacent hero's largest course. That hero gains 2 Block, plus 1 per stack taken.

up.text: Take all of an adjacent hero's largest course. That hero gains 4 Block, plus 1 per stack taken.

ve_lift.flavour: Lean on me. Give me the heavy part.
ve_lift.note: The Vessel slips an arm under a stooped hero; rime lifts from their mail onto the pale blue band.

ve_stand_near.name: Chimney Corner
ve_stand_near.text: Guard an adjacent hero this round. Gain 3 Block.

up.text: Guard an adjacent hero this round. Gain 5 Block.

ve_stand_near.flavour: Whatever is thrown at you, throw it at me.
ve_stand_near.note: The Vessel stands at a hero's shoulder as a foe's spit of fire bends toward the inked arm.

ve_banked_coals.name: Banked Coals
ve_banked_coals.text: Gain 1 Block, plus 1 per stack you hold, at most 8 in all. Bank 1.

up.text: Gain 2 Block, plus 1 per stack you hold, at most 12 in all. Bank 2.

ve_banked_coals.flavour: Banked coals keep the house warm all night.
ve_banked_coals.note: The Vessel stands still while the held seals glow under the robe like coals under ash.

ve_weight_of_it.name: Millstone
ve_weight_of_it.text: Deal 2, plus 1 per stack you hold, at most 9 in all.

up.text: Deal 3, plus 1 per stack you hold, at most 12 in all.

ve_weight_of_it.flavour: You laid all of this on them. Feel what it weighs.
ve_weight_of_it.note: The Vessel lowers one open palm onto a foe and the foe sags as if under a millstone.

ve_hearthstone.name: Fireside
ve_hearthstone.text: An adjacent hero gains 3 Block and Regen 1, plus 1 Regen per 2 different courses you hold.

up.text: An adjacent hero gains 4 Block and Regen 2, plus 1 Regen per 2 different courses you hold.

ve_hearthstone.flavour: Sit by me. The stone keeps the heat long after the fire.
ve_hearthstone.note: A hero warms raw hands at the Vessel's banded forearm as at a hearthstone.

ve_warm_hands.name: Brazier
ve_warm_hands.text: Take 1 stack of every course on a hero. That hero heals 1, plus 1 per stack taken.

up.text: Take 1 stack of every course on a hero. That hero heals 3, plus 1 per stack taken.

ve_warm_hands.flavour: Every sickness has a colour. I take a little of each.
ve_warm_hands.note: The Vessel cups a hero's face in both hands; thin threads of six inks run up the wrists.

ve_shoulder_it.name: Burden
ve_shoulder_it.text: Take all of an adjacent hero's largest course. Gain 3 Block. If that hero has Taunt, they gain 4 Block.

up.text: Take all of an adjacent hero's largest course. Gain 4 Block. If that hero has Taunt, they gain 6 Block.

ve_shoulder_it.flavour: You hold the door. I will hold what comes through it.
ve_shoulder_it.note: The Vessel stands at the Bulwark's back, drawing a green rot off the door-shield into the skin.

ve_come_to_me.name: Clarion

up.text: Gain Taunt and 6 Block.

ve_come_to_me.flavour: Here. Lay it on me. I am the only one it cannot hurt.
ve_come_to_me.note: The Vessel opens both arms in the orans pose and every foe turns toward the inked palms.

ve_spit.name: Holy Water
ve_spit.text: Give 1 Volatile stack of your largest held course to the target. Deal 2.

up.text: Give 1 Volatile stack of your largest held course to the target. Deal 3.

ve_spit.flavour: A drop is enough, if it lands on the right ink.
ve_spit.note: The Vessel flicks two fingers and one bright bead flies from the band into a foe's settled ink.

ve_swallow.name: Swallow
ve_swallow.text: Take all of the target's largest course. Gain 2 Block, plus 1 per stack taken.

up.text: Take all of the target's largest course. Gain 4 Block, plus 1 per stack taken.

ve_swallow.flavour: Courses settle on me and wait. Yours will wait too.
ve_swallow.note: A foe's steam drains off its hide and settles as seals along the Vessel's forearm.

ve_mouthful.name: Manna
ve_mouthful.text: Take 1 stack of every course on the target. Deal 2, plus 1 per stack taken.

up.text: Take 1 stack of every course on the target. Deal 4, plus 1 per stack taken.

ve_mouthful.flavour: A taste of each. The body remembers every one.
ve_mouthful.note: The Vessel touches a many-coloured foe and a thread of each colour follows the hand back.

ve_retch.name: Libation
ve_retch.text: Give up to 3 stacks of your largest held course to the target, then up to 2 stacks of your largest held course to each foe beside it.

up.text: Give up to 4 stacks of your largest held course to the target, then up to 3 stacks of your largest held course to each foe beside it.

ve_retch.flavour: Too much at once. It goes back where it came from, and further.
ve_retch.note: The Vessel's open hand sweeps along the foes' line and green rot spatters across three of them.

ve_taste.name: Salt
ve_taste.text: If the target carries 2 or more different courses, draw 1 more card next round. Take up to 2 stacks of its largest course. Deal 2.

up.text: If the target carries 2 or more different courses, draw 1 more card next round. Take up to 2 stacks of its largest course. Deal 4.

ve_taste.flavour: Salt, smoke, copper. I know what you are made of now.
ve_taste.note: The Vessel touches a fingertip to a foe's stained hide, then to its own unclenched lips.

ve_other_half.name: Diptych
ve_other_half.text: Give up to 2 Volatile stacks of your largest held course to the target. If the company has set off a Conjunction this round, deal 5.

up.text: Give up to 3 Volatile stacks of your largest held course to the target. If the company has set off a Conjunction this round, deal 6.

ve_other_half.flavour: Every course is half of something. I carry the missing half.
ve_other_half.note: A foe wears a skin of water; the Vessel's gold band empties onto it and the water lights.

ve_soak_the_mark.name: Baptism
ve_soak_the_mark.text: Deal 3. Give up to 2 Water to the target. If it is Marked, also give it up to 2 Volatile Water.

up.text: Deal 4. Give up to 3 Water to the target. If it is Marked, also give it up to 3 Volatile Water.

ve_soak_the_mark.flavour: Wet the place the blade will find. Lightning loves water.
ve_soak_the_mark.note: The Vessel lays a wet palm on the spot the Duelist marked; the deep blue band runs dry.

ve_second_mouthful.name: Honey
ve_second_mouthful.text: Deal 3. Give the target up to 2 stacks of your largest held course, and up to 2 more, Volatile, if the action before this hit it too.

up.text: Deal 4. Give the target up to 3 stacks of your largest held course, and up to 2 more, Volatile, if the action before this hit it too.

ve_second_mouthful.flavour: The first lays the table. The second lights it.
ve_second_mouthful.note: The Vessel's second palm follows the first onto the same foe, and the inks meet.

ve_bitter_gift.name: Bitter Cup
ve_bitter_gift.text: Give up to 2 Toxin and up to 2 Void to the target. Deal 1 per 2 Hex on it.

up.text: Give up to 3 Toxin and up to 3 Void to the target. Deal 1 per 2 Hex on it.

ve_bitter_gift.flavour: Rot and hollow, laid on a cursed thing. It will not mend.
ve_bitter_gift.note: Green and violet-black drip from the Vessel's palm onto a foe already bound in the Hexweaver's knots.

ve_ink_band.name: Ink Band
ve_ink_band.text: Take 1 stack of every course on the front foe. Gain 5 Block.

up.text: Take 1 stack of every course on the front foe. Gain 7 Block.

ve_ink_band.flavour: Vermilion, pale blue, gold, deep blue, green, violet-black. In that order.
ve_ink_band.note: A bare band on the Vessel's arm fills with ink, edged in a hairline of gold.

ve_rule_line.name: Rule Line
ve_rule_line.text: Deal 1, plus 2 per different course you hold.

up.text: Deal 3, plus 2 per different course you hold.

ve_rule_line.flavour: Straight as a scribe's rule. Each line a colour, each colour a cut.
ve_rule_line.note: The Vessel draws a level hand across a foe and six thin lines of ink open on its hide.

ve_balance_the_scale.name: Balance
ve_balance_the_scale.text: Even out your held stacks across the courses you hold. Draw 1 more card next round.

up.text: Even out your held stacks across the courses you hold. Gain 3 Block. Draw 1 more card next round.

ve_balance_the_scale.flavour: Too much of one, too little of another. She kept them level.
ve_balance_the_scale.note: The Vessel holds both palms out, level, and the seals drift along the bands to match.

ve_nimbus.name: Nimbus
ve_nimbus.text: Gain 4 Block. If you hold 2 or more courses, all in equal stacks, every other hero gains 1 Ward.

up.text: Gain 5 Block. If you hold 2 or more courses, all in equal stacks, every other hero gains 2 Ward.

ve_nimbus.flavour: A broken ring of six arcs. When they are equal, it closes.
ve_nimbus.note: The six-part ink ring behind the Vessel's head brightens arc by arc over the company.

ve_illumination.name: Illumination
ve_illumination.text: Handoff: Prime 1, plus 1 per different course you hold, at most 5 in all. Gain 1 stress.

up.text: Handoff: Prime 2, plus 1 per different course you hold, at most 6 in all. Gain 1 stress.

ve_illumination.flavour: Gold on the margin, so the eye goes where it must.
ve_illumination.note: Faint script in the Vessel's bands lights up, and a hero's blade catches the colours.

ve_copy_the_page.name: Transcribe
ve_copy_the_page.text: Deal 2. Hold 1 stack of each course the target carries.

up.text: Deal 4. Hold 1 stack of each course the target carries.

ve_copy_the_page.flavour: A scholar's habit. Read it once and it is written in you.
ve_copy_the_page.note: The Vessel studies a foe's stained hide; the same colours write themselves onto the bands.

ve_drink_the_dregs.name: Dregs
ve_drink_the_dregs.text: Gain 2 Block. Dosed: hold 1 stack of each course you do not hold.

up.text: Gain 4 Block. Dosed: hold 1 stack of each course you do not hold.

ve_drink_the_dregs.flavour: Whatever the healer left in the cup, I will hold.
ve_drink_the_dregs.note: The Vessel drains the last of an Alchemist's flask and the empty bands fill with colour.

ve_sponge.name: Sponge
ve_sponge.text: Take every course stack from every hero. Gain 1 Block per stack taken, at most 10.

up.text: Take every course stack from every hero. Gain 2 Block, plus 1 per stack taken, at most 14 in all.

ve_sponge.flavour: Wring it out of them. Let it soak into me.
ve_sponge.note: Colour drains off every hero at once and runs up the Vessel's bands like water up a cloth.

ve_unclench.name: Almsgiving
ve_unclench.text: Costs 1 less if 2 or more other heroes are already in the Ordo. Give everything you hold to the target. Every hero heals 1 per 2 stacks given, at most 5, and sheds 4 stress.

up.text: Costs 1 less if 2 or more other heroes are already in the Ordo. Give everything you hold to the target. Every hero heals 1 per 2 stacks given, at most 7, and sheds 6 stress.

ve_unclench.flavour: Let go. It was never mine to keep.
ve_unclench.note: The Vessel opens a clenched fist for the first time; every seal flies off the skin toward a foe.

ve_warm_room.name: Warming Room
ve_warm_room.text: Each hero beside you gains 1 Block, plus 1 per different course you hold. If this is first in the Ordo, each of them also gains 1 Thrift.

up.text: Each hero beside you gains 2 Block, plus 1 per different course you hold. Gain 3 Block. If this is first in the Ordo, each hero beside you also gains 1 Thrift.

ve_warm_room.flavour: One room in the Guesthouse is always warm. The Vessel stands in it.
ve_warm_room.note: The heroes on either side lean in toward the Vessel as toward a stove in a cold room.

ve_heavy_air.name: Thurible
ve_heavy_air.text: Deal 1 per 2 stacks you hold to every foe, at most 5 each. Bank 1.

up.text: Deal 1, plus 1 per 2 stacks you hold, to every foe, at most 6 each. Bank 1.

ve_heavy_air.flavour: The room grows heavy with everything I carry.
ve_heavy_air.note: The air around the still Vessel thickens with colour and the foes' line bows under it.

ve_keep_watch.name: Keep Watch
ve_keep_watch.text: Guard an adjacent hero this round and take every course stack on it. Bank 1.

up.text: Guard an adjacent hero this round and take every course stack on it. Gain 3 Block. Bank 1.

ve_keep_watch.flavour: Sleep. I sleep standing, and I will stand here.
ve_keep_watch.note: The Vessel stands asleep beside a resting hero, drawing the fever off them in thin threads.

ve_bare_skin.name: Stigmata
ve_bare_skin.text: Gain Taunt, and 1 Thorns plus 1 per different course you hold.

up.text: Gain Taunt and 4 Block, and 1 Thorns plus 1 per different course you hold.

ve_bare_skin.flavour: Strike the inked skin if you like. Every band bites back.
ve_bare_skin.note: A foe's claw rakes the Vessel's sleeve and comes away stained in six colours.

ve_pass_through.name: Pass Through
ve_pass_through.text: Take all of a hero's largest course. Give up to 3 stacks of your largest held course to the front foe. Put a Settle into that hero's next hand.

up.text: Take all of a hero's largest course. That hero heals 2. Give up to 3 Volatile stacks of your largest held course to the front foe. Put a Settle into that hero's next hand.
