ve_pass_through.flavour: In through one hand, out through the other. I am only the door.
ve_pass_through.note: One palm rests on a hero, the other opens at the front foe; the colour runs between them.

ve_exhale.name: Exhale
ve_exhale.text: Give 1 Volatile stack of every course you hold to the target, one course after another. Then deal 3, plus 2 per Conjunction the company has set off this round.

up.text: Give 1 Volatile stack of every course you hold to the target, one course after another. Then deal 4, plus 2 per Conjunction the company has set off this round.

ve_exhale.flavour: One long breath, and every colour in it.
ve_exhale.note: The Vessel breathes out and a ribbon of six inks crosses to a foe, flaring where they meet.

ve_open_palm.name: Benediction
ve_open_palm.text: Deal 5. If a Primed action has resolved this round, this one included, give up to 2 Volatile stacks of your largest held course to the target.

up.text: Deal 6. If a Primed action has resolved this round, this one included, give up to 3 Volatile stacks of your largest held course to the target.

ve_open_palm.flavour: Told where to strike, the hand does not hesitate.
ve_open_palm.note: The Vessel's palm strikes where the Oracle's thread points, and the held ink bursts on contact.

ve_conduit.name: Conduit
ve_conduit.text: Deal 3. Take every course stack on the target, then give up to 2 stacks of your largest held course to each foe beside it. Handoff: then give each of them 1 Volatile stack more.

up.text: Deal 4. Take every course stack on the target, then give up to 3 stacks of your largest held course to each foe beside it. Handoff: then give each of them 1 Volatile stack more.

ve_conduit.flavour: From one to another, through me. I keep nothing.
ve_conduit.note: Colour drains from one foe up the Vessel's arm and pours out of the other palm onto its neighbours.

ve_draw_it_out.name: Crosier
ve_draw_it_out.text: Pull the target 1 rank forward. Take up to 3 stacks of its largest course. Deal 3.

up.text: Pull the target 1 rank forward. Take up to 3 stacks of its largest course. Deal 5.

ve_draw_it_out.flavour: Come closer. What you carry is too heavy for the back of the line.
ve_draw_it_out.note: The Vessel beckons and a rear foe stumbles forward, its colour trailing toward the open hand.

ve_spit_through.name: Hyssop
ve_spit_through.text: Strip the target's Ward. Deal 3. Give up to 3 stacks of your largest held course to the target.

up.text: Strip the target's Ward. Deal 4. Give up to 4 stacks of your largest held course to the target.

ve_spit_through.flavour: A ward keeps out what is thrown. This is poured.
ve_spit_through.note: A foe's glimmering ward cracks under the Vessel's palm and the held ink runs through.

ve_split_tongue.name: Pentecost
ve_split_tongue.text: Handoff: give 1 Volatile stack of your largest held course to each foe. Deal 2 to every foe.

up.text: Handoff: give 1 Volatile stack of your largest held course to each foe. Deal 3 to every foe.

ve_split_tongue.flavour: One word, said to all of them at once.
ve_split_tongue.note: The Vessel speaks a single syllable and a bead of colour lands on every foe in the line.

ve_bite.name: Tongs
ve_bite.text: Conjoin the target. Take up to 2 stacks of its largest course. Deal 2.

up.text: Conjoin the target. Take up to 2 stacks of its largest course. Deal 4.

ve_bite.flavour: Two inks laid side by side. One touch, and they wake.
ve_bite.note: The Vessel pinches the seam where two of a foe's colours meet and they flare together.

ve_open_page.name: Lectern
ve_open_page.text: Draw 1 more card next round. If you are Whole, also gain 1 vigour next round.

up.text: Draw 2 more cards next round. If you are Whole, also gain 1 vigour next round.

ve_open_page.flavour: The page lies open. Every colour is on it, and none has run.
ve_open_page.note: The Vessel stands with one palm turned up like a lectern, six inks bright on the wrist.

ve_balanced_hands.name: Scales
ve_balanced_hands.text: Deal 3. If you hold 2 or more courses, all in equal stacks, deal 5 more. If this is neither first nor last in the Ordo, deal 2 more.

up.text: Deal 4. If you hold 2 or more courses, all in equal stacks, deal 6 more. If this is neither first nor last in the Ordo, deal 3 more.

ve_balanced_hands.flavour: Neither hand heavier. Neither hand slower.
ve_balanced_hands.note: Both of the Vessel's palms meet a foe at once, the bands on each arm exactly matched.

ve_even_breath.name: Plainsong
ve_even_breath.text: Even out your held stacks across the courses you hold. Gain 2 Block, plus 1 per different course you hold. Gain 1 more Block per vigour left unspent this round, at most 3.

up.text: Even out your held stacks across the courses you hold. Gain 4 Block, plus 1 per different course you hold. Gain 1 more Block per vigour left unspent this round, at most 4.

ve_even_breath.flavour: In for six. Hold for six. Out for six.
ve_even_breath.note: The Vessel's breath slows and the seals on every band settle to the same size.

ve_gather_the_inks.name: Gleaning
ve_gather_the_inks.text: Take 1 stack of every course on every foe. Gain 1 Block per stack taken, at most 8. If you took 4 or more, Prime 2.

up.text: Take 1 stack of every course on every foe. Gain 2 Block, plus 1 per stack taken, at most 12 in all. If you took 4 or more, Prime 2.

ve_gather_the_inks.flavour: A drop from every pot on the scribe's table.
ve_gather_the_inks.note: Thin threads of colour rise from every foe and gather into the Vessel's open hands.

ve_gilt_edge.name: Gilt Edge
ve_gilt_edge.text: Another hero gains 1 Focus, plus 1 per 2 different courses you hold. If you hold 4 or more different courses, it also gains 1 Thrift.

up.text: Another hero gains 2 Focus, plus 1 per 2 different courses you hold, and draws 1 more card next round. If you hold 4 or more different courses, it also gains 1 Thrift.

ve_gilt_edge.flavour: Gild the edge of their page, and their next word lands true.
ve_gilt_edge.note: The Vessel traces a gold hairline along a hero's sigil and it brightens.

ve_upright.name: Upright
ve_upright.text: Gain 4 Block and 1 Anchor. If you have not moved this round, Prime 1, plus 1 per different course you hold.

up.text: Gain 6 Block and 1 Anchor. If you have not moved this round, Prime 1, plus 1 per different course you hold.

ve_upright.flavour: The only one in the company who does not stoop.
ve_upright.note: The Vessel stands straight as a column among hunched heroes, feet bare and planted.

ve_the_weighing.name: The Weighing
ve_the_weighing.text: Costs 1 less if 2 or more other heroes are already in the Ordo. Even out your held stacks across the courses you hold. Deal 2 per different course you hold. If you are Whole, deal 12 more. Deal 2 more per other hero who has acted before this card this round.

up.text: Costs 1 less if 2 or more other heroes are already in the Ordo. Even out your held stacks across the courses you hold. Deal 3 per different course you hold. If you are Whole, deal 12 more. Deal 2 more per other hero who has acted before this card this round.

ve_the_weighing.flavour: She weighed every course against the others. None was found wanting.
ve_the_weighing.note: The Vessel holds a level palm over a foe and six inks press down on it with equal weight.

ve_mantle.name: Mantle
ve_mantle.text: Take every course stack from every other hero. Gain 4 Block. Rite: at the end of this round and the next, take every course stack from every other hero. Exhaust.

up.text: Take every course stack from every other hero. Gain 7 Block. Rite: at the end of this round and the next, take every course stack from every other hero. Exhaust.

ve_mantle.flavour: Under the robe there is room for all of it.
ve_mantle.note: The Vessel's undyed robe spreads like a mantle over the company and their colours run onto it.

ve_lay_it_down.name: Bier
ve_lay_it_down.text: Deal 2, plus 1 per stack you hold, at most 15 in all. Then give up to 2 stacks of every course you hold to the target, Volatile if this is last in the Ordo.

up.text: Deal 3, plus 1 per stack you hold, at most 18 in all. Then give up to 2 stacks of every course you hold to the target, Volatile if this is last in the Ordo.

ve_lay_it_down.flavour: I carried it this far. Here is where I set it down.
ve_lay_it_down.note: The Vessel kneels for the first time and presses both palms to a fallen foe; the bands pale.

ve_six_seals.name: Six Seals
ve_six_seals.text: Every hero gains 2 Block, plus 1 per different course you hold.

up.text: Every hero gains 3 Block, plus 1 per different course you hold.

ve_six_seals.flavour: A seal for each course, pressed over each of them.
ve_six_seals.note: Six coloured seals lift off the Vessel's bands and settle on the company's armour.

ve_drink_the_spill.name: Chalice
ve_drink_the_spill.text: Rite: the first two times each round the company sets off a Conjunction on a foe, take 1 stack of every course left on it. Exhaust.

up.text: Hold 1 stack of each course you do not hold. Rite: the first two times each round the company sets off a Conjunction on a foe, take 1 stack of every course left on it. Exhaust.

ve_drink_the_spill.flavour: When the inks meet and burst, something always spills. I drink it.
ve_drink_the_spill.note: A Conjunction flares on a foe, and the leftover colour streams off it into the Vessel's palm.

ve_return_it.name: Mirror of Justice
ve_return_it.text: Gain 4 Block. Rite: the first two times each round a foe hits you, give it 1 Volatile stack of your largest held course. Exhaust.

up.text: Gain 4 Block. Rite: the first two times each round a foe hits you, give it 2 Volatile stacks of your largest held course. Exhaust.

ve_return_it.flavour: Strike me and you touch every course I hold.
ve_return_it.note: A foe's blow lands on the inked forearm and a bright seal leaps back along its arm.

ve_illuminated_initial.name: Illuminated Initial
ve_illuminated_initial.text: Deal 1 per different course you hold. If this is first in the Ordo, deal 2 more. Prime half the damage dealt.

up.text: Deal 1, plus 1 per different course you hold. If this is first in the Ordo, deal 3 more. Prime half the damage dealt.

ve_illuminated_initial.flavour: The first letter of the page, in every colour. The rest follows from it.
ve_illuminated_initial.note: The Vessel's strike leaves a great illuminated letter on a foe, and a hero reads the gap.

ve_take_their_place.name: Vicar
ve_take_their_place.text: Swap places with an adjacent hero and take every course stack on it. Gain Taunt and 4 Block.

up.text: Swap places with an adjacent hero and take every course stack on it. Gain Taunt and 7 Block.

ve_take_their_place.flavour: Step back. This place is mine now.
ve_take_their_place.note: The Vessel steps into a wounded hero's place in the line, arms open, as the foes turn.

ve_speak_to_all.name: Pulpit
ve_speak_to_all.text: Give 1 stack of every course you hold to each foe. Deal 1 to every foe, plus 1 per 3 vigour spent this round.

up.text: Give 1 stack of every course you hold to each foe. Deal 3 to every foe, plus 1 per 3 vigour spent this round.

ve_speak_to_all.flavour: She spoke once, and every course in the world answered.
ve_speak_to_all.note: The Vessel speaks with both palms out and each foe takes a different set of colours.

ve_sealed_skin.name: Sealed Skin
ve_sealed_skin.text: Gain 2 Block, plus 1 per stack you hold, at most 14 in all. Gain 1 Thorns per different course you hold.

up.text: Gain 3 Block, plus 1 per stack you hold, at most 18 in all. Gain 1 Thorns per different course you hold.

ve_sealed_skin.flavour: Every seal on the skin is a ward and a warning.
ve_sealed_skin.note: The held seals on the Vessel's bands stand up like rivets as a foe closes.

ve_swallow_whole.name: Last Rites
ve_swallow_whole.text: Take every course stack on the target. Deal 4. Execute 2 per stack taken.

up.text: Take every course stack on the target. Deal 6. Execute 2 per stack taken.

ve_swallow_whole.flavour: Take every course out of it, and nothing is left to hold it up.
ve_swallow_whole.note: Every colour drains out of a doomed foe into the Vessel, and the grey husk folds.

ve_keep_the_hours.name: Hour Candle
ve_keep_the_hours.text: Even out your held stacks across the courses you hold. Gain 2 Block, plus 1 per different course you hold. Rite: at the end of each round, even out your held stacks, then Bank 1. Exhaust.

up.text: Even out your held stacks across the courses you hold. Gain 4 Block, plus 1 per different course you hold. Rite: at the end of each round, even out your held stacks, then Bank 1. Exhaust.

ve_keep_the_hours.flavour: Every hour of the night, the same six breaths, the same six inks.
ve_keep_the_hours.note: The Vessel sleeps standing through the night watch while the bands brighten in turn, hour by hour.

ve_carry_them.name: Laden Basket
ve_carry_them.text: Take every course stack from every hero. Every hero gains 1 Block per stack taken, at most 6.

up.text: Take every course stack from every hero. Every hero gains 1 Block per stack taken, at most 6.

ve_carry_them.flavour: All of you. Every colour you wear, I will carry home.
ve_carry_them.note: The Hearth Vessel draws the whole company's colours up the bands in one long breath.

ve_stoke.name: Stoke
ve_stoke.text: Hold 1 Fire. If any vigour is left unspent this round, each hero beside you gains 2 Block.

up.text: Hold 1 Fire. If any vigour is left unspent this round, each hero beside you gains 3 Block.

ve_stoke.flavour: A hearth needs a coal. I keep one lit.
ve_stoke.note: A single bead of fire wakes on the vermilion band and the heroes beside it lean closer.

ve_lend_weight.name: Plummet
ve_lend_weight.text: Prime 3, plus 1 per stack you hold, at most 12 in all. Handoff: Prime 2 more.

up.text: Prime 4, plus 1 per stack you hold, at most 14 in all. Handoff: Prime 3 more.

ve_lend_weight.flavour: Lean your blow on me. I am heavier than I look.
ve_lend_weight.note: The Hearth Vessel sets a palm on a hero's back as the hero swings, the bands dimming as they lend.

ve_spread_arms.name: Cope
ve_spread_arms.text: Guard both heroes beside you this round. Gain 3 Block.

up.text: Guard both heroes beside you this round. Gain 5 Block.

ve_spread_arms.flavour: Arms open, palms out. Everything aimed at them comes to me.
ve_spread_arms.note: The Hearth Vessel stands in the orans pose between two heroes, the long sleeves over both.

ve_warm_breath.name: Posset
ve_warm_breath.text: Every hero heals 1 per 2 different courses you hold and sheds 2 stress.

up.text: Every hero heals 1, plus 1 per 2 different courses you hold, and sheds 3 stress.

ve_warm_breath.flavour: A slow breath, warm as a kitchen. Even the frightened ones sleep.
ve_warm_breath.note: The Hearth Vessel breathes out over the company and faint colour warms their faces.

ve_full_weight.name: Winepress
ve_full_weight.text: Deal 2, plus 1 per stack you hold, at most 12 in all. If 2 or more vigour is left unspent this round, deal 3 more.

up.text: Deal 4, plus 1 per stack you hold, at most 16 in all. If 2 or more vigour is left unspent this round, deal 4 more.

ve_full_weight.flavour: Everything you laid on them, all at once.
ve_full_weight.note: The Hearth Vessel presses a palm to a foe and every seal on the bands bears down with it.

ve_chew.name: Grind
ve_chew.text: Deal 2, or 4 on a Handoff. Take all of the target's largest course, then give it up to 3 Volatile stacks of your largest held course.

up.text: Deal 3, or 5 on a Handoff. Take all of the target's largest course, then give it up to 4 Volatile stacks of your largest held course.

ve_chew.flavour: Taken in, turned over, given back. It never tastes the same twice.
ve_chew.note: The Mouth Vessel draws a foe's colour into the palm and pushes it straight back, flaring.

ve_double_spit.name: Cruet
ve_double_spit.text: Double the target's largest course. Give it 1 Volatile stack of your largest held course. Deal 2.

up.text: Double the target's largest course. Give it 2 Volatile stacks of your largest held course. Deal 2.

ve_double_spit.flavour: Once to wake it. Once to finish it.
ve_double_spit.note: Two bright beads leave the Mouth Vessel's fingertips one after the other.

ve_far_spit.name: Long Spoon
ve_far_spit.text: Give up to 2 Volatile stacks of your largest held course to the target. Deal 4, and 2 more if it stands in rank 3 or 4.

up.text: Give up to 2 Volatile stacks of your largest held course to the target. Deal 6, and 2 more if it stands in rank 3 or 4.

ve_far_spit.flavour: The back of the line is not far enough.
ve_far_spit.note: A bead of colour arcs over the front foes and bursts on the one hiding at the back.

ve_chain_word.name: Litany
ve_chain_word.text: Deal 2. Give up to 2 Volatile stacks of your largest held course to the target. If the company has set off 2 or more Conjunctions this round, draw 1 more card next round.

up.text: Deal 4. Give up to 2 Volatile stacks of your largest held course to the target. If the company has set off 2 or more Conjunctions this round, draw 1 more card next round.

ve_chain_word.flavour: One word sets off the next, and the next, down the line.
ve_chain_word.note: The Mouth Vessel speaks, and flare after flare runs across the foes like a lit fuse.

ve_flood_the_line.name: Flood
ve_flood_the_line.text: Give up to X stacks of your largest held course to each foe, Volatile if X is 4 or more. Deal 2 per point of X to every foe.

up.text: Give up to X stacks of your largest held course to each foe, Volatile if X is 3 or more. Deal 2 per point of X to every foe.

ve_flood_the_line.flavour: What I held for one, I pour out for all.
ve_flood_the_line.note: The Mouth Vessel tips both open palms and one colour floods the whole line of foes.

ve_gorge.name: Brazen Laver
ve_gorge.text: Take every course stack on the target. Gain 1 Block per stack taken, at most 10. Put a Temporary Holy Water into your next hand.

up.text: Take every course stack on the target. Gain 2 Block, plus 1 per stack taken, at most 14 in all. Put a Temporary Holy Water into your next hand.

ve_gorge.flavour: Every course it carried, swallowed. It stands there grey.
ve_gorge.note: A foe's colours pour off it into the Mouth Vessel, leaving it the grey of old ash.

ve_keep_her_quiet.name: Silence
ve_keep_her_quiet.text: Give 1 Water to the target, then all your held Void, Volatile. If you gave 3 or more stacks in all, its next action keeps only its first effect.

up.text: Give 1 Water to the target, then all your held Void, Volatile. Its next action keeps only its first effect.

ve_keep_her_quiet.flavour: She was loud once. The whole world heard her. Keep her quiet.
ve_keep_her_quiet.note: The Whole Vessel lays a violet-black palm over a foe's mouth and the hollow spreads.

ve_six_bands.name: Armlet
ve_six_bands.text: Take 1 stack of every course on every other hero. Gain 2 Block. Then, if you are Whole, draw 1 more card next round.

up.text: Take 1 stack of every course on every other hero. Gain 4 Block. Then, if you are Whole, draw 1 more card next round.

ve_six_bands.flavour: Fingertip to jaw, six bands, and every one of them full.
ve_six_bands.note: The Whole Vessel's six bands fill one after another, from the fingertips to the jaw.

ve_level_hands.name: Mason's Level
ve_level_hands.text: Even out your held stacks across the courses you hold. Prime 3, plus 1 per different course you hold.

up.text: Even out your held stacks across the courses you hold. Prime 5, plus 1 per different course you hold.

ve_level_hands.flavour: A level hand gives a level blow.
ve_level_hands.note: The Whole Vessel holds both palms level and a hero's weapon catches all six colours.

ve_six_rays.name: Six Rays
ve_six_rays.text: Deal 1, plus 1 per different course you hold, to every foe. If you are Whole, deal 3 more to every foe. If 2 or more other heroes have acted before this card this round, deal 2 more to every foe.

up.text: Deal 2, plus 1 per different course you hold, to every foe. If you are Whole, deal 4 more to every foe. If 2 or more other heroes have acted before this card this round, deal 3 more to every foe.

ve_six_rays.flavour: Six rays from a broken ring. The god had them. So does the Vessel.
ve_six_rays.note: The broken nimbus behind the Whole Vessel's head throws six thin rays of ink across the foes.

ve_gilded_page.name: Gilding
ve_gilded_page.text: Give 1 stack of every course you hold to the target. Deal 3, plus 1 per different course on it.

up.text: Give 1 stack of every course you hold to the target. Deal 4, plus 2 per different course on it.

ve_gilded_page.flavour: Write every colour on it, then read it aloud.
ve_gilded_page.note: The Whole Vessel presses an inked palm to a foe and leaves a print in all six colours.

ve_still_centre.name: Still Centre
ve_still_centre.text: Gain 2 Block per stack of the course you hold least. Bank 1.

up.text: Gain 2 Block, plus 2 per stack of the course you hold least. Bank 1.

ve_still_centre.flavour: The scale is still when every pan is full.
ve_still_centre.note: The Whole Vessel stands at the still centre of the fight, every band filled to the same line.

ve_hearth_kept.name: Hearth Kept
ve_hearth_kept.text: Rite: at the start of each round, take every course stack from every other hero, then every other hero gains 2 Block per stack taken, at most 10. Exhaust.

up.text: Every other hero gains 1 Ward. Rite: at the start of each round, take every course stack from every other hero, then every other hero gains 2 Block per stack taken, at most 10. Exhaust.

ve_hearth_kept.flavour: The fire is banked, the door is barred, and nothing burns in this house but me.
ve_hearth_kept.note: The Hearth Vessel stands at the Guesthouse hearth at dawn, drawing the night's ills off the sleepers.

ve_weight_of_the_world.name: World's Weight
ve_weight_of_the_world.text: Rite: the first time each round a foe hits another hero, deal 1 per stack you hold to that foe. Exhaust.

up.text: Gain 6 Block. Rite: the first time each round a foe hits another hero, deal 1 per stack you hold to that foe. Exhaust.

ve_weight_of_the_world.flavour: She carried the world's courses once. Now I do, and it is heavy.
ve_weight_of_the_world.note: The Hearth Vessel lifts one palm and the front foe is crushed flat under six colours of weight.

ve_unstopped_mouth.name: Endless Flagon
ve_unstopped_mouth.text: Rite: at the end of each round, take every course stack from every other hero, then give up to 3 Volatile stacks of your largest held course to the front foe. Exhaust.

up.text: Take every course stack from every other hero. Rite: at the end of each round, take every course stack from every other hero, then give up to 3 Volatile stacks of your largest held course to the front foe. Exhaust.

ve_unstopped_mouth.flavour: Whatever they spit at you, I swallow, and spit back hotter.
ve_unstopped_mouth.note: The Mouth Vessel stands behind the company as every course on them streams through it at the foes.

ve_mothers_tongue.name: Mother Tongue
ve_mothers_tongue.text: Rite: three times a round, when the company sets off a Conjunction on a foe, give 1 Volatile stack of your largest held course to each foe beside it. Exhaust.

up.text: Hold 1 stack of each course you do not hold. Rite: three times a round, when the company sets off a Conjunction on a foe, give 1 Volatile stack of your largest held course to each foe beside it. Exhaust.

ve_mothers_tongue.flavour: She spoke the first word, and the courses answered in every mouth at once.
ve_mothers_tongue.note: A Conjunction flares on one foe and the Mouth Vessel's speech carries it to the foes on either side.

ve_whole_conjunction.name: The Whole Conjunction
ve_whole_conjunction.text: If you are Whole, deal 8 and the most wounded hero gains 1 Thrift. Give 1 stack of every course you hold to the target, then everything else you hold, Volatile.

up.text: If you are Whole, deal 8 and the most wounded hero gains 1 Thrift. Give 1 stack of every course you hold to the target, then everything else you hold, Volatile. Then hold 1 stack of each course you do not hold.

ve_whole_conjunction.flavour: All six in one body, without letting them fuse. Until now.
ve_whole_conjunction.note: The Whole Vessel opens both palms and all six bands pour into one foe in a single blinding knot.

ve_mothers_place.name: Mother's Place
ve_mothers_place.text: Rite: three times a round, when the company sets off a Conjunction on a foe, hold 1 stack of each course you do not hold, then, if you are Whole, deal 5 to that foe. Exhaust.

up.text: Hold 1 stack of each course you do not hold. Rite: three times a round, when the company sets off a Conjunction on a foe, hold 1 stack of each course you do not hold, then, if you are Whole, deal 5 to that foe. Exhaust.

ve_mothers_place.flavour: She held every course apart and let none of them fuse. The seat is taken again.
ve_mothers_place.note: The Whole Vessel stands where the Mother of Courses stood, the broken nimbus closing behind its head.

t_ve_spit.name: Holy Water
t_ve_spit.text: Give 1 Volatile stack of your largest held course to the target. Deal 2. Temporary.
t_ve_spit.flavour: A drop is enough, if it lands on the right ink.
t_ve_spit.note: The Vessel flicks two fingers and one bright bead flies from the band into a foe's settled ink.

t_ve_settle.name: Settle
t_ve_settle.flavour: What would burn you only settles on me. Rest a moment.
t_ve_settle.note: A hero breathes out slowly, shoulders easing, while the Vessel's palm lifts from their back.

t_barrow_fleas.name: Plague Fleas
t_barrow_fleas.text: Unplayable. On arrival and each time it is drawn: gain 1 Toxin and Blight (no healing this round). When drawn, draw a replacement. Removed at fight end.
t_barrow_fleas.flavour: He was paid by the tail. The fleas came free.
t_barrow_fleas.note: The Rat-Catcher's pole swings over a hero, and a dark dust of fleas falls from the rats.

w_barrow_grave_cold.name: Grave Cold
w_barrow_grave_cold.text: Deal 2, plus 1 per ailment stack on the target. Apply 1 Toxin.

up.text: Deal 3, plus 1 per ailment stack on the target. Apply 2 Toxin.

w_barrow_grave_cold.flavour: The cold kept everything in the barrow fresh. The plague too.
w_barrow_grave_cold.note: A hero's blade comes away from a Draugr furred with grey-green mould.

w_barrow_burial_axe.name: Burial Axe
w_barrow_burial_axe.text: Deal 3. Execute 4, plus 2 per other hero who has acted before this card this round.

up.text: Deal 4. Execute 6, plus 2 per other hero who has acted before this card this round.

w_barrow_burial_axe.flavour: Buried with its axe so it could keep fighting. Borrow it, and end that.
w_barrow_burial_axe.note: A hero wrenches a bearded axe from a grave niche and swings it at a rising Draugr.

w_barrow_vinegar_rag.name: Vinegar Rag
w_barrow_vinegar_rag.text: A hero removes 2 ailment stacks, then gains 1 Ward per ailment stack it still has (up to 3).

up.text: A hero removes 3 ailment stacks, then gains 1 Ward per ailment stack it still has (up to 4).

w_barrow_vinegar_rag.flavour: The pest-house watch tied vinegar over their mouths. It kept out the smell.
w_barrow_vinegar_rag.note: A hero ties a vinegar-soaked rag over a sick companion's mouth among the mounds.

w_barrow_the_long_winter.name: The Long Winter
w_barrow_the_long_winter.text: Apply 2 Frost to every foe. Conjoin every foe.

up.text: Apply 3 Frost to every foe. Conjoin every foe.

w_barrow_the_long_winter.flavour: He sealed his kingdom in to stop the plague. The winter came in with it.
w_barrow_the_long_winter.note: Rime spreads across the barrow hall, whitening the funeral feast and its guests.

w_baths_ladle.name: Ladle
w_baths_ladle.text: Apply 1 Volatile Fire. Deal 2, plus 4 more if the foe is Vulnerable.

up.text: Apply 1 Volatile Fire. Deal 3, plus 6 more if the foe is Vulnerable.

w_baths_ladle.flavour: One ladleful for the guest. One more for anyone who complains.
w_baths_ladle.note: A hero swinging a long copper ladle of boiling water at a Scalded Attendant.

w_baths_cold_plunge.name: Cold Plunge
w_baths_cold_plunge.text: Deal 4. Turn the foe's Water into Frost.

up.text: Deal 6. Turn the foe's Water into Frost.

w_baths_cold_plunge.flavour: The frigidarium is the one pool that never heated. Nobody goes in.
w_baths_cold_plunge.note: A Boiled Brute shoved into the cold pool, steam bursting off him as the water rimes.

w_baths_fresh_towel.name: Fresh Towel
w_baths_fresh_towel.text: Remove all Fire from a hero. They heal 2, plus 1 per Fire removed.

up.text: Remove all Fire from a hero. They heal 4, plus 1 per Fire removed.

w_baths_fresh_towel.flavour: Take it from the bottom of the pile. The top ones have skin on them.
w_baths_fresh_towel.note: A hero pressing a clean linen towel to a scalded arm on the marble bench.

w_baths_open_valve.name: Open the Valve
w_baths_open_valve.text: Deal 2 to every foe per Conjunction set off this round (at most 8), and 2 more if the company spent all its vigour this round.

up.text: Deal 3 to every foe per Conjunction set off this round (at most 12), and 2 more if the company spent all its vigour this round.

w_baths_open_valve.flavour: Every pool in the temple boils from one boiler. Turn its wheel the other way.
w_baths_open_valve.note: A hero hauling on the bronze stopcock wheel as steam rolls out over the foes.

t_coast_glare.name: Lens Glare
t_coast_glare.text: Unplayable. When drawn: discard a random card from your hand.
t_coast_glare.flavour: He keeps the light burning in the wrong place.
t_coast_glare.note: The Lighthouse Keeper's false beam fills a hero's eyes; the cards in their hand go white.

w_coast_breaking_sea.name: Breaking Sea
w_coast_breaking_sea.text: Apply 1 Water to every foe, and 2 more to each foe that carries Lightning.

up.text: Apply 2 Water to every foe, and 2 more to each foe that carries Lightning.

w_coast_breaking_sea.flavour: The storm never ends, and the sea comes over the rocks with it.
w_coast_breaking_sea.note: A wave breaks over the wreckers on the strand; the ones already crackling drown in the spray.

w_coast_wreckers_lamp.name: Wreckers' Lamp
w_coast_wreckers_lamp.text: Pull the target forward 1 and apply 2 Water, or 3 if this is first in the Ordo. If it is Marked, apply 1 Volatile Lightning.

up.text: Pull the target forward 1 and apply 3 Water, or 4 if this is first in the Ordo. If it is Marked, apply 1 Volatile Lightning.

w_coast_wreckers_lamp.flavour: It lights a lamp on the cliff and waits for the ships to come in.
w_coast_wreckers_lamp.note: A hero swings a wrecker's storm lantern on the cliff; a Storm Harpy drops toward it into the surf.

w_coast_call_the_bolt.name: Call the Bolt
w_coast_call_the_bolt.text: Deal 4 to every foe. Apply 1 Volatile Lightning to each Soaked foe.

up.text: Deal 6 to every foe. Apply 1 Volatile Lightning to each Soaked foe.

w_coast_call_the_bolt.flavour: The false lights became true lightning.
w_coast_call_the_bolt.note: A bolt comes down on the wet rocks and runs through every soaked body on the strand.

w_coast_lash_it_down.name: Lash It Down
w_coast_lash_it_down.text: Retain. Gain 1 Block, plus 2 per card left in your hand (max 11).

up.text: Retain. Gain 3 Block, plus 2 per card left in your hand (max 13).

w_coast_lash_it_down.flavour: On this coast the sea takes whatever is not tied down.
w_coast_lash_it_down.note: A hero lashes a satchel to their belt with tarred line as a false beam sweeps the gallery.

t_drowned_sewn_shut.name: Sewn Shut
t_drowned_sewn_shut.text: Cut the stitches: shed 2 stress. Exhaust. Until it is played it comes back with every reshuffle; removed at fight end.
t_drowned_sewn_shut.flavour: The order sewed her mouth shut with waxed cord. She has kept the needle.
t_drowned_sewn_shut.note: The Abbess of Salt drawing a length of waxed cord through a hero's hand like a seam.

w_drowned_undertow.name: Undertow
w_drowned_undertow.text: Deal 2, plus 1 per Water on the foe. Apply 1 Volatile Void.

up.text: Deal 3, plus 1 per Water on the foe. Apply 2 Volatile Void.

w_drowned_undertow.flavour: The sea does not strike. It waits for you to breathe in.
w_drowned_undertow.note: A drowned thrall in the nave, a clean black hole opening in the water around its chest.

w_drowned_wring_out.name: Wring Out
w_drowned_wring_out.text: Remove all Water from a hero. They gain 1 Block, plus 2 per Water removed.

up.text: Remove all Water from a hero. They gain 4 Block, plus 2 per Water removed.

w_drowned_wring_out.flavour: Wring out your cloak. Wring out your lungs. Keep moving.
w_drowned_wring_out.note: A hero on the flooded stair twisting seawater out of a sodden cloak.

w_drowned_bells_silent.name: Silent Bells
w_drowned_bells_silent.text: Every hero sheds 3 stress per Conjunction set off this round. If 2 or more vigour is left unspent this round, every hero sheds 3 more.

up.text: Every hero sheds 4 stress per Conjunction set off this round. If 2 or more vigour is left unspent this round, every hero sheds 4 more.

w_drowned_bells_silent.flavour: For one breath the belfry is quiet. Take it.
w_drowned_bells_silent.note: The company in the belfry, the great bell hanging still and silent above them.

w_drowned_deep_pressure.name: Deep Pressure
w_drowned_deep_pressure.text: Deal 3. Double the Water on the foe.

up.text: Deal 5. Double the Water on the foe.

w_drowned_deep_pressure.flavour: Every fathom down, the water weighs twice as much.
w_drowned_deep_pressure.note: A Barnacle Knight pressed to its knees by black water pouring through the nave roof.

t_fleet_broth.name: Ship's Broth
t_fleet_broth.text: Unplayable. On arrival and each time it is drawn: gain 1 Frost and 3 stress. When drawn, draw a replacement. Removed at fight end.
t_fleet_broth.flavour: The stores ran out in the second month. The pot did not.
t_fleet_broth.note: The Galley Cook ladles frozen broth into a hero's bowl; something in it has a knuckle.

w_fleet_ice_breaker.name: Ice Breaker
w_fleet_ice_breaker.text: Deal 5. If the target has Frost, deal 4 more.

up.text: Deal 7. If the target has Frost, deal 5 more.

w_fleet_ice_breaker.flavour: The ice holds them still. It holds them brittle too.
w_fleet_ice_breaker.note: A hero's blow breaks a rimed Deckhand off the rail in white shards.

w_fleet_keelhaul.name: Keelhaul
w_fleet_keelhaul.text: Deal 2. Pull the target forward 1, or 2 on a Handoff. If it is now in rank 1, apply 2 Water.

up.text: Deal 3. Pull the target forward 1, or 2 on a Handoff. If it is now in rank 1, apply 3 Water.

w_fleet_keelhaul.flavour: Under the keel and up the other side, if the ice allows.
w_fleet_keelhaul.note: A hero hauls a Frozen Whaler across the deck on his own harpoon line.

w_fleet_frozen_to_the_rail.name: Frozen Rail
w_fleet_frozen_to_the_rail.text: Gain 3 Block, plus 2 per Frost on you.

up.text: Gain 5 Block, plus 2 per Frost on you.

w_fleet_frozen_to_the_rail.flavour: The marine was posted to keep order on deck. The cold kept him there.
w_fleet_frozen_to_the_rail.note: A hero braces against a rimed rail, frost locking the shield in place.

w_fleet_the_sea_freezes.name: The Sea Freezes
w_fleet_the_sea_freezes.text: Deal 3 to every foe. Apply 1 Water to every foe. Conjoin every foe that has Frost.

up.text: Deal 4 to every foe. Apply 2 Water to every foe. Conjoin every foe that has Frost.

w_fleet_the_sea_freezes.flavour: The fleet sailed north to kill it. The sea closed over them all.
w_fleet_the_sea_freezes.note: Black water floods across the floe and whitens round the crew's ankles.

w_foundry_arc_weld.name: Arc Weld
w_foundry_arc_weld.text: Deal 3. Apply 2 Lightning. If the action before this one was another hero's and hit the same foe, apply 1 Volatile Fire.

up.text: Deal 4. Apply 3 Lightning. If the action before this one was another hero's and hit the same foe, apply 1 Volatile Fire.

w_foundry_arc_weld.flavour: It welds with its hammer. It welds with you, too.
w_foundry_arc_weld.note: Two heroes strike the same Arc-Smith in turn; the second blow closes the arc in a white-gold flash.

w_foundry_melt_down.name: Melt Down
w_foundry_melt_down.text: Spend all your Block. Deal 3, plus 1 per Block spent (max 15).

up.text: Spend all your Block. Deal 5, plus 1 per Block spent (max 18).

w_foundry_melt_down.flavour: Plasma goes through Block like a pour through wax.
w_foundry_melt_down.note: A hero's shield glows white at the rim and the hero drives the molten edge into a Slag Slave.

w_foundry_quench.name: Quench and Temper
w_foundry_quench.text: Remove all Fire from yourself. If you removed any, gain 1 Armor for the fight. Gain 3 Block. Exhaust.

up.text: Remove all Fire from yourself. If you removed any, gain 1 Armor for the fight. Gain 6 Block. Exhaust.

w_foundry_quench.flavour: The smiths quench what the fire has softened. It comes out harder.
w_foundry_quench.note: A burning hero plunges an arm into the slack tub; steam bursts up white round the anvil line.

w_foundry_out_of_the_splash.name: Leap Clear
w_foundry_out_of_the_splash.text: Swap with an adjacent hero. Each of you gains 2 Ward.

up.text: Swap with an adjacent hero. Each of you gains 3 Ward.

w_foundry_out_of_the_splash.flavour: Burn runs along the line. Do not stand in the line.
w_foundry_out_of_the_splash.note: A hero shoulders a companion aside as a gout of burning bronze splashes where they stood.

t_garden_fools_spore.name: Fool's Spore
t_garden_fools_spore.text: Unplayable. Each time it is drawn, deal 5 to each hero beside you. Temporary.
t_garden_fools_spore.flavour: The rot thinks he is very funny.
t_garden_fools_spore.note: A hero's arm swings wide in a puff of pale-yellow spore and strikes the companion beside them.

w_garden_deadhead.name: Deadhead
w_garden_deadhead.text: Remove all Regen from the foe. Deal 2, plus 1 per Regen removed. If 2 or more vigour is left unspent this round, deal 2 more.

up.text: Remove all Regen from the foe. Deal 3, plus 2 per Regen removed. If 2 or more vigour is left unspent this round, deal 3 more.

w_garden_deadhead.flavour: He prunes what grows wrong. Learn from him.
w_garden_deadhead.note: A hero snips a swelling bloom from a foe's shoulder with the Gardener's dropped shears.

w_garden_take_the_rot.name: Uproot
w_garden_take_the_rot.text: Deal 3. Move every ailment from the other hero who carries the most onto the foe.

up.text: Deal 5. Move every ailment from the other hero who carries the most onto the foe.

w_garden_take_the_rot.flavour: The garden gives. Give it back.
w_garden_take_the_rot.note: A hero presses a palm to a foe's bark; spore and black dust crawl off a companion and onto it.

w_garden_blight_seed.name: Blight Seed
w_garden_blight_seed.text: Deal 3. If the foe has Toxin, apply 2 Volatile Void.

up.text: Deal 5. If the foe has Toxin, apply 3 Volatile Void.

w_garden_blight_seed.flavour: Where the seed lands, nothing grows back. Not even the rot.
w_garden_blight_seed.note: A hero thumbs a black seed into a spore-swollen wound; the bark around it goes grey and still.

w_garden_nothing_regrows.name: Nothing Regrows
w_garden_nothing_regrows.text: Rite: whenever the company sets off a Conjunction, that foe loses all its Block and Regen. Exhaust.

up.text: Rite: whenever the company sets off a Conjunction, that foe loses all its Block and Regen. Exhaust.

w_garden_nothing_regrows.flavour: The blooms open, and the eyes turn toward you. Close them.
w_garden_nothing_regrows.note: The company stands in a ring of grey, dead loam; the hedge around them has stopped growing.

w_hive_paralysing_sting.name: Paralysing Sting
w_hive_paralysing_sting.text: Deal 2 per Toxin on the target (max 10). If it has Toxin, apply 1 Volatile Lightning.

up.text: Deal 3, plus 2 per Toxin on the target (max 13). If it has Toxin, apply 1 Volatile Lightning.

w_hive_paralysing_sting.flavour: Their venom stops the heart, then the will.
w_hive_paralysing_sting.note: A hero drives a lightning-scorched stinger into a swollen, venom-green foe; it locks mid-step.

w_hive_lightning_rod.name: Lightning Rod
w_hive_lightning_rod.text: Remove all Lightning from the most wounded hero. Apply 1 Volatile Lightning to the target, plus 1 per Lightning removed (max 3).

up.text: Remove all Lightning from the most wounded hero. Apply 2 Volatile Lightning to the target, plus 1 per Lightning removed (max 5).

w_hive_lightning_rod.flavour: Lightning struck the plain, and the insects built towers to catch it.
w_hive_lightning_rod.note: A hero plants an iron rod between a stung companion and a foe; the white-violet fern jumps across.

w_hive_take_the_sting.name: Take the Sting
w_hive_take_the_sting.text: Gain 2 Block, plus 2 per ailment on you (max 12).

up.text: Gain 4 Block, plus 2 per ailment on you (max 15).

w_hive_take_the_sting.flavour: Let the cheap card take the paralysis. Then play the one that matters.
w_hive_take_the_sting.note: A twitching hero raises a battered pot lid as the wasps come down on him.

w_hive_spire_storm.name: Spire Storm
w_hive_spire_storm.text: Each foe takes 1 per Toxin on it (max 6), then gains 1 Volatile Lightning, and 1 more if the company spent all its vigour this round.

up.text: Each foe takes 2, plus 1 per Toxin on it (max 8), then gains 1 Volatile Lightning, and 1 more if the company spent all its vigour this round.

w_hive_spire_storm.flavour: The storm came, and the hive caught it, and the plain went still.
w_hive_spire_storm.note: Lightning forks down a spire and runs through every swollen body round its foot at once.

t_mire_offering.name: Hag's Offering
t_mire_offering.text: Libation it up: gain 1 Toxin. Exhaust. Until it is played it comes back with every reshuffle; removed at fight end.
t_mire_offering.flavour: The hags fed her for centuries. She is giving some of it back.
t_mire_offering.note: The Mire Mother's mouth opens and a wet bundle of charms and bones lands at a hero's feet.

w_mire_poisoned_shallows.name: Poisoned Shallows
w_mire_poisoned_shallows.text: Deal 3. Turn the foe's Water into Toxin. Apply 1 Volatile Water.

up.text: Deal 5. Turn the foe's Water into Toxin. Apply 1 Volatile Water.

w_mire_poisoned_shallows.flavour: The fen keeps everything. It ripens what it keeps.
w_mire_poisoned_shallows.note: A hero's boot breaking the skin of a bile-green pool under a Bog Body's feet.

w_mire_wade_out.name: Wade Out
w_mire_wade_out.text: A hero removes 2 ailment stacks. If they moved this round, they gain 7 Block.

up.text: A hero removes 3 ailment stacks. If they moved this round, they gain 9 Block.

w_mire_wade_out.flavour: Walk where the hag walks. Never stand where she stood.
w_mire_wade_out.note: A hero stepping out of a poisoned rank onto a sunken plank, mud to the knee.

w_mire_flood_cuttings.name: Flood the Cuttings
w_mire_flood_cuttings.text: Deal 1 to every foe. Apply 1 Volatile Water to every foe with Toxin.

up.text: Deal 3 to every foe. Apply 1 Volatile Water to every foe with Toxin.

w_mire_flood_cuttings.flavour: Break the dyke and let the fen in. It knows where the poison is.
w_mire_flood_cuttings.note: Black water pouring through a broken turf dyke into the peat cuttings where the foes stand.

w_mire_into_the_pool.name: Into the Pool
w_mire_into_the_pool.text: Push the foe back 1, or 2 if this is first in the Ordo. Deal 1, plus 1 per Toxin on it.

up.text: Push the foe back 1, or 2 if this is first in the Ordo. Deal 1, plus 2 per Toxin on it.

w_mire_into_the_pool.flavour: Every rank of the Rotmire is poisoned. Choose which one they stand in.
w_mire_into_the_pool.note: A hero shoving an Eel-Catcher backward off the duckboards into a pool that blisters as he lands.

t_pits_lamp.name: Lit Lamp
t_pits_lamp.flavour: She hands every miner his lamp at the start of the shift. Everyone takes one.
t_pits_lamp.note: The Lamp-Room Girl holds out one more lit lamp from her yoke toward the hero.

w_pits_gas_pocket.name: Gas Pocket
w_pits_gas_pocket.text: Deal 1 for each course stack on the target (max 12). Apply 1 Volatile Fire.

up.text: Deal 2, plus 1 for each course stack on the target (max 14). Apply 1 Volatile Fire.

w_pits_gas_pocket.flavour: The air itself became fuel, and every poison is a fuse.
w_pits_gas_pocket.note: A hero tosses a lamp into a yellow drift of gas round a foe; the gallery flashes lamp orange.

w_pits_blasting_charge.name: Blasting Charge
w_pits_blasting_charge.text: Remove all Toxin from the target. Deal 2 per Toxin removed (max 14), and 3 more if this is last in the Ordo. Each foe beside it takes 1 per Toxin removed (max 7).

up.text: Remove all Toxin from the target. Deal 2, plus 2 per Toxin removed (max 16), and 4 more if this is last in the Ordo. Each foe beside it takes 1 per Toxin removed (max 8).

w_pits_blasting_charge.flavour: It ground the brimstone for the world's powder.
w_pits_blasting_charge.note: A powder keg wedged against a gas-swollen foe goes up, the blast throwing its neighbours aside.

w_pits_throw_it_back.name: Throw It Back
w_pits_throw_it_back.text: Move the largest ailment of the most afflicted other hero onto the target. Deal 2. Apply 1 Volatile Fire.

up.text: Move the largest ailment of the most afflicted other hero onto the target. Deal 4. Apply 1 Volatile Fire.

w_pits_throw_it_back.flavour: Its lungs are full of yellow gas. Keep it away from the lamp.
w_pits_throw_it_back.note: A coughing hero spits the yellow gas back into a Gas-Lung Miner's face as the lamp swings in.

w_pits_wet_hood.name: Wet Hood
w_pits_wet_hood.text: Remove all Fire from a hero. They gain 1 Ward and 2 Block, plus 1 per Fire removed (max 8).

up.text: Remove all Fire from a hero. They gain 1 Ward and 3 Block, plus 2 per Fire removed (max 13).

w_pits_wet_hood.flavour: Somebody had to go in first with the flame. He wore the hood soaked.
w_pits_wet_hood.note: A hero pulls a steaming, water-soaked sacking hood over a burning companion's head.

w_pyre_penitent_lash.name: Penitent's Lash
w_pyre_penitent_lash.text: Lose 3 HP. Deal 1 per Scar you carry, up to 7, ignoring Block. If no vigour is left unspent this round, gain 1 Thrift.

up.text: Lose 3 HP. Deal 1 per Scar you carry, up to 11, ignoring Block. If no vigour is left unspent this round, gain 1 Thrift.

w_pyre_penitent_lash.flavour: It whips itself between swings at you. It does not notice the difference.
w_pyre_penitent_lash.note: A hero lays a chain flail across their own back, then across a Pyre Knight's shield, ash flying.

w_pyre_saints_ash.name: Saint's Ash
w_pyre_saints_ash.text: Remove all Fire from a hero. They gain 1 Ward, plus 1 per Fire removed.

up.text: Remove all Fire from a hero. They gain 2 Ward, plus 1 per Fire removed.

w_pyre_saints_ash.flavour: A pinch of her, sealed in lead. Genuine, this time.
w_pyre_saints_ash.note: A hero breaks a lead vial over a burning companion; grey ash settles and the black flame gutters out.

w_pyre_fire_unending.name: The Fire Unending
w_pyre_fire_unending.text: Rite: at the end of each round, every foe takes 1 per course on it, ignoring Block, and you lose 2 HP. Exhaust.

up.text: Rite: at the end of each round, every foe takes 1 per course on it, ignoring Block. Exhaust.

w_pyre_fire_unending.flavour: It gives no light, and it does not go out. It does not care whose it is.
w_pyre_fire_unending.note: A hero touches a black taper to the floor; violet-edged flame runs under foes and company alike.

w_pyre_black_wax.name: Black Wax
w_pyre_black_wax.text: Apply 1 Void. Deal 2, plus 1 per ailment on the foe, ignoring Block.

up.text: Apply 2 Void. Deal 3, plus 1 per ailment on the foe, ignoring Block.

w_pyre_black_wax.flavour: Where the black wax lands it leaves clean round holes.
w_pyre_black_wax.note: A hero tips a Recanter's candle over a foe; black wax runs and punches holes where it lands.

w_rime_fire_setting.name: Fire-Setting
w_rime_fire_setting.text: Deal 2. Apply 2 Fire, or 3 on a Handoff. If the target has Frost, Conjoin it.

up.text: Deal 3. Apply 3 Fire, or 4 on a Handoff. If the target has Frost, Conjoin it.

w_rime_fire_setting.flavour: Stack the fire against the stone, then the cold water. The rock does the rest.
w_rime_fire_setting.note: A hero drives a burning bundle into a rimed Thrall; the ice on its back cracks orange.

w_rime_wedge_and_feather.name: Wedge and Feather
w_rime_wedge_and_feather.text: Deal 1, plus 2 per Armor the target has.

up.text: Deal 3, plus 2 per Armor the target has.

w_rime_wedge_and_feather.flavour: Iron wedges, iron feathers, and a mallet. Every plate has a seam.
w_rime_wedge_and_feather.note: A hero hammers an iron wedge into the seam of a Shieldmaiden's obsidian plate.

w_rime_shield_wall.name: Shield Wall
w_rime_shield_wall.text: Guard another hero this round. It gains 1 Block, plus 1 per ailment stack on it.

up.text: Guard another hero this round. It gains 3 Block, plus 1 per ailment stack on it.

w_rime_shield_wall.flavour: The hold's shieldmaidens stood rim to rim. The glass cut them as well.
w_rime_shield_wall.note: A hero steps in front of a burning companion, shield up against the steam.

w_rime_the_glacier_splits.name: The Glacier Splits
w_rime_the_glacier_splits.text: Deal 3 to every foe, and 2 more to each foe that carries Fire. Then apply 1 Volatile Frost to every foe.

up.text: Deal 4 to every foe, and 3 more to each foe that carries Fire. Then apply 1 Volatile Frost to every foe.

w_rime_the_glacier_splits.flavour: The miners dug down and met the fire coming up. The glacier split between.
w_rime_the_glacier_splits.note: A crack runs the length of the glacier floor under the foes, steam bursting through.

w_silence_cold_eye.name: The Cold Eye
w_silence_cold_eye.text: Apply 1 Frost, plus 1 per Void on the target (max 4). Apply 1 Volatile Void.

up.text: Apply 2 Frost, plus 1 per Void on the target (max 5). Apply 1 Volatile Void.

w_silence_cold_eye.flavour: The eye opens and warmth drains away.
w_silence_cold_eye.note: A hero meets the black star's stare and turns it on a foe; the foe whitens from the edges in.

w_silence_say_it_aloud.name: Say It Aloud
w_silence_say_it_aloud.text: Remove all Void from a hero. They gain 1 Block per Void removed (max 6) and shed 6 stress.

up.text: Remove all Void from a hero. They gain 2 Block, plus 1 per Void removed (max 8), and shed 8 stress.

w_silence_say_it_aloud.flavour: A black star rose and took all the warmth and all the sound.
w_silence_say_it_aloud.note: A hero shouts into a companion's face across the snow, and for a moment there is sound.

w_silence_hold_your_breath.name: Hold Your Breath
w_silence_hold_your_breath.text: Lose all your Block. Gain 1 Ward per 4 Block lost (max 3). If 2 or more vigour is left unspent this round, gain 1 more Ward.

up.text: Lose all your Block. Gain 1 Ward, plus 1 per 4 Block lost (max 4). If 2 or more vigour is left unspent this round, gain 1 more Ward.

w_silence_hold_your_breath.flavour: Nothing makes a sound here. Make none.
w_silence_hold_your_breath.note: A hero lowers a rimed shield and goes utterly still under the black sun.

w_silence_star_comes_down.name: Falling Star
w_silence_star_comes_down.text: Each foe takes 1 per course stack on it (max 3). Every foe: apply 1 Frost, then 1 Volatile Void.

up.text: Each foe takes 2, plus 1 per course stack on it (max 5). Every foe: apply 1 Frost, then 1 Volatile Void.

w_silence_star_comes_down.flavour: The black star came down to see what was making all the noise.
w_silence_star_comes_down.note: The black disc fills the sky over the tundra, and every foe below it goes white.

w_sky_struck_out.name: Struck Out
w_sky_struck_out.text: Remove all Void from the foe. Deal 3 per Void removed, ignoring Block.

up.text: Remove all Void from the foe. Deal 4 per Void removed, ignoring Block.

w_sky_struck_out.flavour: It wrote down every soul. It has started crossing them out.
w_sky_struck_out.note: A hero draws the Recording Angel's quill through a foe; the void in it burns out along the stroke.

w_sky_gold_leaf.name: Gold Leaf
w_sky_gold_leaf.text: A hero gains 2 Ward, plus 1 per different course on them.

up.text: A hero gains 3 Ward, plus 2 per different course on them.

w_sky_gold_leaf.flavour: Gold leaf cracked over black. It still holds, for a while.
w_sky_gold_leaf.note: A hero presses a flake of heaven's gold over a companion's crackling burns.

w_sky_through_the_tear.name: Through the Tear
w_sky_through_the_tear.text: Deal 1. Apply 1 Void, plus 1 per other hero who has acted before this card this round (max 4), then Conjoin.

up.text: Deal 3. Apply 1 Void, plus 1 per other hero who has acted before this card this round (max 4), then Conjoin.

w_sky_through_the_tear.flavour: Something leans in through the tear. Show it where to look.
w_sky_through_the_tear.note: A hero pulls a foe through a rent in the sky; violet burns branch across it as it passes.

w_sky_something_leans_closer.name: Something Leans Closer
w_sky_something_leans_closer.text: Rite: up to 3 times a round, when the company sets off a Conjunction, deal 1 to that foe, plus 1 per Conjunction set off this round (this one included), ignoring Block. Exhaust.

up.text: Rite: up to 3 times a round, when the company sets off a Conjunction, deal 2 to that foe, plus 1 per Conjunction set off this round (this one included), ignoring Block. Exhaust.

w_sky_something_leans_closer.flavour: The tears in the sky widen, and something leans closer. It likes what it sees.
w_sky_something_leans_closer.note: The company under a widening tear; an eye the size of a cathedral window looks down on the foes.

w_spire_stop_the_watch.name: Stop the Watch
w_spire_stop_the_watch.text: If the target means to attack, Delay it and gain 3 Block.

up.text: If the target means to attack, Delay it and gain 6 Block.

w_spire_stop_the_watch.flavour: They mostly succeeded. The clocks still tick inside the ice.
w_spire_stop_the_watch.note: A hero closes a frosted pocket watch, and the foe across from them freezes mid-stride.

w_spire_unwind.name: Unwind
w_spire_unwind.text: Remove all Frost from a hero. They gain 1 Ward, plus 1 per Frost removed (max 4).

up.text: Remove all Frost from a hero. They gain 2 Ward, plus 1 per Frost removed (max 5).

w_spire_unwind.flavour: Wind it back far enough and the frost was never there.
w_spire_unwind.note: A hero turns a brass key in a companion's back plate; rime falls from their sleeves.

w_spire_second_hand.name: Minute Hand
w_spire_second_hand.text: Prime 1, plus 1 per card in the Ordo so far, this one included (max 5). Exhaust.

up.text: Prime 2, plus 1 per card in the Ordo so far, this one included (max 6). Exhaust.

w_spire_second_hand.flavour: Idle is the second hand ticking and stopping.
w_spire_second_hand.note: A hero counts beats under their breath beside the stopped orrery, hand raised for the next strike.

w_spire_midnight.name: Midnight
w_spire_midnight.text: Costs 1 less if 3 or more cards are already in the Ordo. Every foe: apply 1 Frost, then 1 Volatile Lightning. Then deal 2 to every foe per Conjunction set off this round (max 8).

up.text: Costs 1 less if 3 or more cards are already in the Ordo. Every foe: apply 1 Frost, then 1 Volatile Lightning. Then deal 3 to every foe per Conjunction set off this round (max 12).

w_spire_midnight.flavour: When it strikes twelve, the world stops. It is one minute to.
w_spire_midnight.note: The great clock's hands meet at twelve, and aurora light locks every foe in the hall in place.
